entry.summary: DuoMo recovers world-space human motion from unconstrained videos using two diffusion models: one for camera-space estimation from video and another for lifting to world coordinates with global consistency, addressing the trade-off between generalization and consistency.

entry.title: Generalized non-exponential Gaussian splatting

author.name: S\'ebastien Speierer, Adrian Jarabo

entry.summary: This paper generalizes 3D Gaussian Splatting to non-exponential alpha-blending operators inspired by non-exponential radiative transfer, defining sub-linear, linear, and super-linear versions that exhibit faster-than-exponential transmittance decay.

entry.title: Agentic Self-Evolutionary Replanning for Embodied Navigation

author.name: Guoliang Li, Ruihua Han, Chengyang Li, He Li, Shuai Wang, Wenchao Ding, Hong Zhang, Chengzhong Xu

entry.summary: SERP proposes self-evolutionary replanning for embodied navigation where the robot evolves its action model at runtime through in-context learning from recent experiences, shifting from frozen to evolving models for navigation replanning.

entry.title: Engineering Reasoning and Instruction (ERI) Benchmark: A Large Taxonomy-driven Dataset for Foundation Models and Agents

author.name: MZ Naser, Ahmad Bani Awwad, Zoie McCreery, Radwa Eissa, Ahmad Naser, Gianluca Cusatis, Andrew Metcalf, Kapil Madathil, Jamal Abdalla, Venkatesh Kodur, Mohammad Reza Saeb

entry.summary: Introduces the Engineering Reasoning and Instruction (ERI) benchmark spanning 9 engineering fields, 55 subdomains, 7 intent types, and 3 difficulty tiers, yielding 57,750 records. Evaluates 7 LLMs and finds significant performance gaps especially on calculation and professional-level tasks.

entry.title: SpatialText: A Pure-Text Cognitive Benchmark for Spatial Understanding in Large Language Models

author.name: Peiyao Jiang, Zequn Qin, Xi Li

entry.summary: Introduces SpatialText, a theory-driven diagnostic benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs construct genuine spatial mental models rather than relying on statistical language heuristics, isolating text-based spatial cognition from visual perception.

entry.title: Generalized Discrete Diffusion with Self-Correction

author.name: Linxuan Wang, Ziyi Wang, Yikun Bai, Wei Deng, Guang Lin, Qifan Song

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Correcting Discrete Diffusion (SCDD), reformulating pretraining-based self-correction for discrete diffusion models with a cleaner formulation than GIDD, improving generalization and reasoning performance.

entry.title: PRISM: Exploring Heterogeneous Pretrained EEG Foundation Model Transfer to Clinical Differential Diagnosis

author.name: Jeet Bandhu Lahiri, Parshva Runwal, Arvasu Kulkarni, Mahir Jain, Aditya Ray Mishra, Siddharth Panwar, Sandeep Singh

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM, a study comparing narrow-source vs. geographically diverse pretraining for EEG foundation models. Finds diverse pretraining dramatically improves out-of-distribution clinical tasks, revealing that narrow-source models encode recording artifacts rather than neural physiology.

entry.title: MIRAGE: Knowledge Graph-Guided Cross-Cohort MRI Synthesis for Alzheimer's Disease Prediction

author.name: Guanchen Wu, Zhe Huang, Yuzhang Xie, Runze Yan, Akul Chopra, Deqiang Qiu, Xiao Hu, Fei Wang, Carl Yang

entry.summary: Introduces MIRAGE, a framework that addresses missing MRI data in Alzheimer's diagnosis by using biomedical knowledge graphs and cross-modal latent distillation to synthesize MRI representations from electronic health records.

entry.title: iGVLM: Dynamic Instruction-Guided Vision Encoding for Question-Aware Multimodal Understanding

author.name: HanZpeng Liu, Yaqian Li, Zidan Wang, Shuoxi Zhang, Zihao Bo, Rinyoichi Takezoe, Kaiwen Long, Kun He

entry.summary: Proposes iGVLM, a framework for instruction-guided visual encoding in VLMs using a dual-branch architecture where a dynamic conditioning branch modulates visual features based on the textual task, addressing the static vision encoder bottleneck.

entry.title: Next Embedding Prediction Makes World Models Stronger

author.name: George Bredis, Nikita Balagansky, Daniil Gavrilov, Ruslan Rakhimov

entry.summary: Introduces NE-Dreamer, a decoder-free model-based RL agent that predicts next-step encoder embeddings from latent state sequences, achieving strong results on DMC and DMLab tasks involving memory and spatial reasoning.

entry.title: OCR or Not? Rethinking Document Information Extraction in the MLLMs Era with Real-World Large-Scale Datasets

author.name: Jiyuan Shen, Peiyue Yuan, Atin Ghosh, Yifan Mai, Daniel Dahlmeier

entry.summary: Conducts large-scale benchmarking of MLLMs on business document information extraction, finding that powerful MLLMs may not need OCR preprocessing—image-only input can achieve comparable performance.

entry.title: IoUCert: Robustness Verification for Anchor-based Object Detectors

author.name: Benedikt Br\"uckner, Alejandro Mercado, Yanghao Zhang, Panagiotis Kouvaros, Alessio Lomuscio

entry.summary: Introduces IoUCert, a formal verification framework for anchor-based object detectors that handles non-linear coordinate transformations and IoU metrics. Proposes a coordinate transformation that avoids precision-degrading relaxations for verifying object localization robustness.

entry.title: Information Routing in Atomistic Foundation Models: How Equivariance Creates Linearly Disentangled Representations

author.name: Joshua Steier

entry.summary: Introduces Composition Projection Decomposition (CPD) to analyze how atomistic foundation models organize information, finding that tensor product equivariant architectures produce linearly disentangled representations of composition and geometry, while other architectures entangle them nonlinearly.

entry.title: Spectral Regularization for Diffusion Models

author.name: Satish Chandran, Nicolas Roque dos Santos, Yunshu Wu, Greg Ver Steeg, Evangelos Papalexakis

entry.summary: Proposes spectral regularization for diffusion models using Fourier and wavelet-domain losses to encourage frequency balance in generated samples, without modifying the diffusion process or architecture. Shows consistent improvements on image and audio generation.

entry.title: Towards Parameter-Free Temporal Difference Learning

author.name: Yunxiang Li, Mark Schmidt, Reza Babanezhad, Sharan Vaswani

entry.summary: Proposes parameter-free TD(0) using an exponential step-size schedule that eliminates need for problem-dependent quantities like minimum eigenvalue of feature covariance or mixing time. Achieves standard convergence rates without tuning.

entry.title: Adapting Time Series Foundation Models through Data Mixtures

author.name: Thomas L. Lee, Edoardo M. Ponti, Amos Storkey

entry.summary: Proposes methods for fine-tuning time series foundation models (TSFMs) on new domains using data mixture strategies and LoRA modules. Finds that combining per-dataset LoRA modules via learned mixing weights outperforms naive approaches for zero-shot forecasting.

entry.title: On the Topology of Neural Network Superlevel Sets

author.name: Bahman Gharesifard

entry.summary: Shows that neural networks with activations satisfying a Riccati-type ODE produce Pfaffian outputs, enabling architecture-only bounds on topological complexity (Betti numbers) of superlevel sets, independent of weights.

entry.title: SOLAR: SVD-Optimized Lifelong Attention for Recommendation

author.name: Chenghao Zhang, Chao Feng, Yuanhao Pu, Xunyong Yang, Wenhui Yu, Xiang Li, Yongqi Liu, Lantao Hu, Kaiqiao Zhan, Han Li, Kun Gai

entry.summary: Introduces SVD-Attention for recommendation systems that exploits low-rank structure in user behavior sequences, reducing linear attention complexity while maintaining expressiveness, with deployment validation at scale.

entry.title: Uni-Skill: Building Self-Evolving Skill Repository for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Senwei Xie, Yuntian Zhang, Ruiping Wang, Xilin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Uni-Skill, a framework for robotic manipulation with a self-evolving skill library that can request new skill implementations when existing ones are insufficient, using a VerbNet-inspired repository.

entry.title: A Covering Framework for Offline POMDPs Learning using Belief Space Metric

author.name: Youheng Zhu, Yiping Lu

entry.summary: Introduces a covering framework for offline POMDP learning that exploits belief space metric structure to relax coverage assumptions, mitigating exponential blowups in horizon and memory length for off-policy evaluation.

entry.title: HAMMER: Harnessing MLLM via Cross-Modal Integration for Intention-Driven 3D Affordance Grounding

author.name: Lei Yao, Yong Chen, Yuejiao Su, Yi Wang, Moyun Liu, Lap-Pui Chau

entry.summary: Proposes HAMMER, a framework leveraging multimodal LLMs for intention-driven 3D affordance grounding, aggregating interaction intentions from images into contact-aware embeddings to predict textual affordance labels for 3D objects.

entry.title: CAWM-Mamba: A unified model for infrared-visible image fusion and compound adverse weather restoration

author.name: Huichun Liu, Xiaosong Li, Zhuangfan Huang, Tao Ye, Yang Liu, Haishu Tan

entry.summary: Proposes CAWM-Mamba, the first end-to-end framework jointly performing infrared-visible image fusion and compound adverse weather restoration (handling co-occurring haze+rain, rain+snow, etc.) with unified shared weights.

entry.title: Mind the Way You Select Negative Texts: Pursuing the Distance Consistency in OOD Detection with VLMs

author.name: Zhikang Xu, Qianqian Xu, Zitai Wang, Cong Hua, Sicong Li, Zhiyong Yang, Qingming Huang

entry.summary: Proposes InterNeg for OOD detection with VLMs, addressing inconsistency between intra-modal distance (used by current methods) and inter-modal distance (what CLIP is optimized for) by selecting negative texts that maintain distance consistency.

entry.title: OmniFashion: Towards Generalist Fashion Intelligence via Multi-Task Vision-Language Learning

author.name: Zhengwei Yang, Andi Long, Hao Li, Zechao Hu, Kui Jiang, Zheng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces OmniFashion with FashionX, a million-scale fashion dataset with exhaustive annotations, and a unified VLM framework bridging retrieval, recommendation, recognition, and dialogue for fashion intelligence.

entry.title: ScribeTokens: Fixed-Vocabulary Tokenization of Digital Ink

author.name: Douglass Wang

entry.summary: ScribeTokens proposes a fixed 10-token vocabulary for digital ink tokenization that decomposes pen movement into unit pixel steps, enabling BPE compression. It dramatically outperforms continuous vector representations on handwritten text generation (17.33% vs 70.29% CER) while matching them on recognition.

entry.title: HDINO: A Concise and Efficient Open-Vocabulary Detector

author.name: Hao Zhang, Yiqun Wang, Qinran Lin, Runze Fan, Yong Li

entry.summary: HDINO is a concise open-vocabulary object detector that eliminates dependence on manually curated fine-grained datasets and resource-intensive cross-modal feature extraction, using a two-stage training strategy on the DINO model with noise-aware semantic alignment.

entry.title: The Dresden Dataset for 4D Reconstruction of Non-Rigid Abdominal Surgical Scenes

author.name: Reuben Docea, Rayan Younis, Yonghao Long, Maxime Fleury, Jinjing Xu, Chenyang Li, Andr\'e Schulze, Ann Wierick, Johannes Bender, Micha Pfeiffer, Qi Dou, Martin Wagner, Stefanie Speidel

entry.summary: The Dresden Dataset (D4D) provides paired endoscopic video and structured-light geometry for evaluating 3D reconstruction of deforming abdominal tissue in surgical conditions, using da Vinci Xi stereo endoscope and Zivid structured-light camera across multiple deformation types.

entry.title: Any Resolution Any Geometry: From Multi-View To Multi-Patch

author.name: Wenqing Cui, Zhenyu Li, Mykola Lavreniuk, Jian Shi, Ramzi Idoughi, Xiangjun Tang, Peter Wonka

entry.summary: URGT (Ultra Resolution Geometry Transformer) adapts the VGGT framework into a multi-patch transformer for high-resolution monocular depth-normal estimation, partitioning images into patches with coarse priors and jointly processing them for global coherence.

entry.title: CMoE: Contrastive Mixture of Experts for Motion Control and Terrain Adaptation of Humanoid Robots

author.name: Shihao Ma, Hongjin Chen, Zijun Xu, Yi Zhao, Ke Wu, Ruichen Yang, Leyao Zou, Zhongxue Gan, Wenchao Ding

entry.summary: CMoE integrates contrastive learning with mixture of experts for humanoid robot locomotion across diverse terrains, addressing the problem of uniform expert activation that weakens terrain specialization in vanilla MoE.

entry.title: AI companies and the 99% lethal autonomous weapons myth

author.name: User_Luke

entry.summary: Argues AI companies cannot meaningfully claim red lines on autonomous weapons when the distinction between 'fully autonomous' and '99% autonomous' weapons systems is semantically vast but practically negligible, especially given existing legal frameworks like DODD 3000.09.

entry.title: MedFeat: Model-Aware and Explainability-Driven Feature Engineering with LLMs for Clinical Tabular Prediction

author.name: Zizheng Zhang, Yiming Li, Justin Xu, Jinyu Wang, Rui Wang, Lei Song, Jiang Bian, David W Eyre, Jingjing Fu

entry.summary: Presents MedFeat, a feedback-driven LLM-based feature engineering framework for clinical tabular prediction that incorporates model awareness and SHAP-based explainability to guide feature discovery.

entry.title: TagaVLM: Topology-Aware Global Action Reasoning for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Jiaxing Liu, Zexi Zhang, Xiaoyan Li, Boyue Wang, Yongli Hu, Baocai Yin

entry.summary: TagaVLM proposes an end-to-end framework for Vision-Language Navigation that explicitly injects topological graph structures into VLM backbones, addressing the architectural mismatch between static VLM pretraining and dynamic, spatially-structured navigation tasks.

entry.title: MIBURI: Towards Expressive Interactive Gesture Synthesis

author.name: M. Hamza Mughal, Rishabh Dabral, Vera Demberg, Christian Theobalt

entry.summary: MIBURI is the first online, causal framework for generating expressive full-body gestures and facial expressions synchronized with real-time spoken dialogue for embodied conversational agents, bridging the gap between LLM-based agents and physical embodiment.

entry.title: Articulation in Motion: Prior-free Part Mobility Analysis for Articulated Objects By Dynamic-Static Disentanglement

author.name: Hao Ai, Wenjie Chang, Jianbo Jiao, Ales Leonardis, Ofek Eyal

entry.summary: Articulation in Motion (AiM) presents a framework for prior-free part mobility analysis of articulated objects, inferring part decomposition, articulation kinematics, and interactive 3D replicas from video without requiring knowledge of the number of parts.

entry.title: Look Forward to Walk Backward: Efficient Terrain Memory for Backward Locomotion with Forward Vision

author.name: Shixin Luo, Songbo Li, Yuan Hao, Yaqi Wang, Jun Zheng, Jun Wu, Qiuguo Zhu

entry.summary: LF2WB enables legged robots to walk backward safely on complex terrain by building an associative memory during forward motion from depth cameras, then retrieving it for backward locomotion without rearward vision.

entry.title: VL-KGE: Vision-Language Models Meet Knowledge Graph Embeddings

author.name: Athanasios Efthymiou, Stevan Rudinac, Monika Kackovic, Nachoem Wijnberg, Marcel Worring

entry.summary: Proposes VL-KGE, a framework that leverages Vision-Language Models to create aligned multimodal knowledge graph embeddings, handling heterogeneous entities with diverse modality availability rather than assuming uniform modality across all entities.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Robots via Retrieve-Reason-Act

author.name: Izat Temiraliev, Diji Yang, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes retrieval-augmented robots that use information retrieval to acquire procedural knowledge (e.g., furniture assembly instructions) from the web in zero-shot settings, going beyond retrieving past trajectories or safety rules.

entry.title: Rethinking Code Similarity for Automated Algorithm Design with LLMs

author.name: Rui Zhang, Zhichao Lu

entry.summary: Proposes BehaveSim, a behavior-based code similarity metric for LLM-based Automated Algorithm Design that captures algorithmic similarity rather than syntactic or output equivalence, enabling distinction between genuine innovation and syntactic variation.

entry.title: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning via Multi-task Averaging of Kernel Mean Embeddings

author.name: Jean-Baptiste Fermanian (PREMEDICAL), Batiste Le Bars (MAGNET, CRIStAL), Aur\'elien Bellet (PREMEDICAL)

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive personalized federated learning using kernel mean embeddings with multi-task averaging, learning collaborative weights from data rather than specifying them a priori.

entry.title: Temporal Imbalance of Positive and Negative Supervision in Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Jinge Ma, Fengqing Zhu

entry.summary: Identifies 'temporal imbalance' as an overlooked cause of prediction bias in class-incremental learning—earlier classes receive disproportionately strong negative supervision toward the end of training, causing asymmetric precision/recall.

entry.title: Quantum-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Few-Shot AIGC Detection via Phase-Structured Reparameterization

author.name: Kaiyang Xing, Han Fang, Zhaoyun Chen, Zhonghui Li, Yang Yang, Weiming Zhang, Guoping Guo

entry.summary: Proposes Q-LoRA, integrating quantum neural network structures into LoRA adapters for few-shot AIGC detection. Identifies phase-aware representations and norm-constrained transformations as key inductive biases, then distills these into a classical 'PhaseLoRA' that matches performance without quantum overhead.

entry.title: MASPOB: Bandit-Based Prompt Optimization for Multi-Agent Systems with Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Zhi Hong, Qian Zhang, Jiahang Sun, Zhiwei Shang, Mingze Kong, Xiangyi Wang, Yao Shu, Zhongxiang Dai

entry.summary: Proposes MASPOB, a bandit-based prompt optimization framework for multi-agent LLM systems that uses graph neural networks to capture topology-induced coupling among prompts, addressing the combinatorial explosion of optimizing prompts for multiple agents.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning with Symbolic Reward Machines

author.name: Thomas Krug, Daniel Neider

entry.summary: Proposes Symbolic Reward Machines (SRMs) that process environment observations directly without requiring manual labeling functions, overcoming key limitations of traditional Reward Machines in RL. Introduces QSRM and LSRM algorithms for broader applicability in standard RL frameworks.

entry.title: MoECLIP: Patch-Specialized Experts for Zero-shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Jun Yeong Park, JunYoung Seo, Minji Kang, Yu Rang Park

entry.summary: Proposes MoECLIP, a Mixture-of-Experts architecture for zero-shot anomaly detection that dynamically routes image patches to specialized LoRA experts. Achieves patch-level adaptation while preserving CLIP's generalization capability.

entry.title: Real-Time Generative Policy via Langevin-Guided Flow Matching for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Tianze Zhu, Yinuo Wang, Wenjun Zou, Tianyi Zhang, Likun Wang, Letian Tao, Feihong Zhang, Yao Lyu, Shengbo Eben Li

entry.summary: Proposes DACER-F, combining flow matching with online RL for autonomous driving, enabling competitive action generation in a single inference step. Uses Langevin dynamics and Q-function gradients to balance exploration and exploitation.

entry.title: Deep learning-guided evolutionary optimization for protein design

author.name: Erik Hartman, Di Tang, Johan Malmstr\"om

entry.summary: Presents BoGA (Bayesian Optimization Genetic Algorithm), a framework combining evolutionary search with Bayesian optimization for protein design, demonstrating data-efficient optimization of protein sequences.

entry.title: Contextual Latent World Models for Offline Meta Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Mohammadreza Nakheai, Aidan Scannell, Kevin Luck, Joni Pajarinen

entry.summary: Introduces contextual latent world models for offline meta-RL that condition latent dynamics models on inferred task representations, enforcing task-conditioned temporal consistency for better task representation learning from fixed datasets.

entry.title: HELIOS: Harmonizing Early Fusion, Late Fusion, and LLM Reasoning for Multi-Granular Table-Text Retrieval

author.name: Sungho Park, Joohyung Yun, Jongwuk Lee, Wook-Shin Han

entry.summary: HELIOS combines early fusion, late fusion, and LLM reasoning for table-text retrieval, using edge-based bipartite subgraph retrieval for fine-grained alignment and an LLM verifier for complex reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Topological Causal Effects

author.name: Kwangho Kim, Hajin Lee

entry.summary: Develops a framework for topological causal inference that defines treatment effects through differences in topological structure of potential outcomes using persistence diagrams, with a doubly robust estimator.

entry.title: Conformal Graph Prediction with Z-Gromov Wasserstein Distances

author.name: Gabriel Melo, Thibaut de Saivre, Anna Calissano, Florence d'Alch\'e-Buc

entry.summary: Proposes conformal prediction for graph-valued outputs using Z-Gromov-Wasserstein distances, providing distribution-free coverage guarantees for supervised graph prediction problems.

entry.title: Combinatorial Sparse PCA Beyond the Spiked Identity Model

author.name: Syamantak Kumar, Purnamrita Sarkar, Kevin Tian, Peiyuan Zhang

entry.summary: Demonstrates explicit counterexamples where standard combinatorial sparse PCA algorithms fail beyond the spiked identity model, and proposes a new thresholding algorithm that works under general covariance assumptions.

entry.title: Exact Functional ANOVA Decomposition for Categorical Inputs Models

author.name: Baptiste Ferrere (IMT, SINCLAIR AI Lab), Nicolas Bousquet (SINCLAIR AI Lab), Fabrice Gamboa (IMT, ANITI), Jean-Michel Loubes (IMT, REGALIA, ANITI), Joseph Mur\'e

entry.summary: Derives closed-form functional ANOVA decomposition for categorical inputs without assumptions, connecting to SHAP values and discrete Fourier analysis, enabling efficient computation of main effects and interactions.

entry.title: Eval4Sim: An Evaluation Framework for Persona Simulation

author.name: Eliseo Bao, Anxo Perez, Xi Wang, Javier Parapar

entry.summary: Proposes Eval4Sim, an evaluation framework for persona-grounded LLM simulations that measures alignment with human conversational patterns across adherence, naturalness, and diversity dimensions, going beyond LLM-as-a-judge approaches.

entry.title: ORCA: Orchestrated Reasoning with Collaborative Agents for Document Visual Question Answering

author.name: Aymen Lassoued, Mohamed Ali Souibgui, Yousri Kessentini

entry.summary: Proposes ORCA, a multi-agent framework for document visual question answering with a reasoning agent that decomposes queries, a routing mechanism for task-specific agents, and iterative refinement.

entry.title: NeighborMAE: Exploiting Spatial Dependencies between Neighboring Earth Observation Images in Masked Autoencoders Pretraining

author.name: Liang Zeng, Valerio Marsocci, Wufan Zhao, Andrea Nascetti, Maarten Vergauwen

entry.summary: Proposes NeighborMAE, a masked autoencoder pretraining method that learns spatial dependencies by jointly reconstructing neighboring Earth Observation images, exploiting the continuity of the Earth's surface.

entry.title: EIMC: Efficient Instance-aware Multi-modal Collaborative Perception

author.name: Kang Yang, Peng Wang, Lantao Li, Tianci Bu, Chen Sun, Deying Li, Yongcai Wang

entry.summary: Proposes EIMC, an efficient multi-modal collaborative perception method for autonomous driving that injects lightweight collaborative voxels early in the fusion pipeline, using heatmap-driven consensus to minimize bandwidth.

entry.title: Synthetic-Child: An AIGC-Based Synthetic Data Pipeline for Privacy-Preserving Child Posture Estimation

author.name: Taowen Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes Synthetic-Child, a privacy-preserving synthetic data pipeline for child posture estimation using SMPL-X body models in Blender with dual ControlNet conditioning, requiring zero real child photographs.

entry.title: VLMFusionOcc3D: VLM Assisted Multi-Modal 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction

author.name: A. Enes Doruk, Hasan F. Ates

entry.summary: Proposes VLMFusionOcc3D, a multimodal framework for 3D semantic occupancy prediction that uses VLM linguistic priors via gated cross-attention and LoRA-adapted CLIP embeddings to resolve semantic ambiguity in autonomous driving.

entry.title: Towards an Incremental Unified Multimodal Anomaly Detection: Augmenting Multimodal Denoising From an Information Bottleneck Perspective

author.name: Kaifang Long, Lianbo Ma, Jiaqi Liu, Liming Liu, Guoyang Xie

entry.summary: Addresses incremental unified multimodal anomaly detection by analyzing how spurious/redundant features worsen catastrophic forgetting, using information bottleneck perspective to improve multimodal denoising.

entry.title: FiDeSR: High-Fidelity and Detail-Preserving One-Step Diffusion Super-Resolution

author.name: Aro Kim, Myeongjin Jang, Chaewon Moon, Youngjin Shin, Jinwoo Jeong, Sang-hyo Park

entry.summary: Proposes FiDeSR, a one-step diffusion framework for image super-resolution with detail-aware training weighting and low/high-frequency adaptive enhancers during inference for flexible enhancement control.

entry.title: R3GW: Relightable 3D Gaussians for Outdoor Scenes in the Wild

author.name: Margherita Lea Corona, Wieland Morgenstern, Peter Eisert, Anna Hilsmann

entry.summary: R3GW presents a method for learning relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting representations of outdoor scenes from unconstrained photo collections with varying lighting conditions. It separates scenes into relightable foreground and non-reflective sky background using distinct Gaussian sets.

entry.title: SemanticDialect: Semantic-Aware Mixed-Format Quantization for Video Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Wonsuk Jang, Thierry Tambe

entry.summary: SemanticDialect proposes a mixed-format quantization approach for video Diffusion Transformers that selects per-block optimal quantization formats from a formatbook, using lookup tables for efficient selection. It also introduces activation decomposition to reduce quantization error.

entry.title: Semi-Supervised Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Julio Silva-Rodr\'iguez, Ender Konukoglu

entry.summary: This paper proposes semi-supervised few-shot adaptation for vision-language models in medical imaging, addressing class imbalances in extremely low-shot regimes by leveraging unlabeled data alongside few annotated examples through multi-modal linear probes.

entry.title: CASSR: Continuous A-Star Search through Reachability for real time footstep planning

author.name: Jiayi Wang, Steve Tonneau

entry.summary: CASSR is a footstep planning framework that recursively propagates convex, continuous kinematic constraints within A* search, planning 30-step sequences in under 125ms, outperforming discrete A* by 100x and MIP solvers.

entry.title: Mass Surveillance w/ LLMs is the Default Outcome. Contracts Won't Change That.

author.name: Logan Riggs

entry.summary: Argues that mass surveillance using LLMs is the default outcome regardless of contract terms between AI companies and the Department of War, because the government can simply switch vendors. Advocates for legislative action, particularly reforming the Third Party Doctrine.

entry.title: GLEAN: Grounded Lightweight Evaluation Anchors for Contamination-Aware Tabular Reasoning

author.name: Qizhi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GLEAN, a lightweight evaluation protocol for tabular reasoning that integrates contamination-aware probes, retrieval-reasoning diagnostics, and structured error attribution under tight hardware constraints.

entry.title: TC-Pad\'e: Trajectory-Consistent Pad\'e Approximation for Diffusion Acceleration

author.name: Benlei Cui, Shaoxuan He, Bukun Huang, Zhizeng Ye, Yunyun Sun, Longtao Huang, Hui Xue, Yang Yang, Jingqun Tang, Zhou Zhao, Haiwen Hong

entry.summary: TC-Padé proposes a Padé approximation-based feature prediction framework for diffusion model acceleration, addressing error accumulation and trajectory drift in low-step regimes (20-30 steps) where existing polynomial-based caching methods fail.

entry.title: ALARM: Automated MLLM-Based Anomaly Detection in Complex-EnviRonment Monitoring with Uncertainty Quantification

author.name: Congjing Zhang, Feng Lin, Xinyi Zhao, Pei Guo, Wei Li, Lin Chen, Chaoyue Zhao, Shuai Huang

entry.summary: ALARM is a framework for MLLM-based visual anomaly detection in complex environments with uncertainty quantification, integrating reasoning chains, self-reflection, and MLLM ensemble for robust performance based on a rigorous probabilistic inference pipeline.

entry.title: Tensegrity Robot Endcap-Ground Contact Estimation with Symmetry-aware Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network

author.name: Wenzhe Tong, Yicheng Jiang, Chi Zhang, Maani Ghaffari, Xiaonan Huang

entry.summary: A symmetry-aware heterogeneous graph neural network for tensegrity robot contact estimation that incorporates the robot's dihedral D3 symmetry into message passing, improving sample efficiency and integration with contact-aided invariant EKF.

entry.title: DreamFlow: Local Navigation Beyond Observation via Conditional Flow Matching in the Latent Space

author.name: Jiwon Park, Dongkyu Lee, I Made Aswin Nahrendra, Jaeyoung Lim, Hyun Myung

entry.summary: DreamFlow extends robot local navigation by using conditional flow matching in latent space to predict spatial structures beyond the robot's field of view, addressing local minima and limited sensing in cluttered environments.

entry.title: Beyond Factual Correctness: Mitigating Preference-Inconsistent Explanations in Explainable Recommendation

author.name: Chengkai Wang, Baisong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes PURE, a preference-aware reasoning framework for explainable recommendation that addresses preference-inconsistent explanations - where generated explanations are factually correct but misaligned with user preferences.

entry.title: Spatial Autoregressive Modeling of DINOv3 Embeddings for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection

author.name: Ertunc Erdil, Nico Schulthess, Guney Tombak, Ender Konukoglu

entry.summary: This paper uses spatial autoregressive modeling of DINOv3 patch embeddings for unsupervised anomaly detection, capturing neighborhood relationships between patches that existing methods ignore, while reducing memory and computational overhead compared to memory bank approaches.

entry.title: Watch Your Step: Learning Semantically-Guided Locomotion in Cluttered Environment

author.name: Denan Liang, Yuan Zhu, Ruimeng Liu, Thien-Minh Nguyen, Shenghai Yuan, Lihua Xie

entry.summary: SemLoco is an RL framework for legged robots to avoid stepping on specific objects in cluttered environments using semantic understanding, combining two-stage RL with pixel-wise foothold safety inference.

entry.title: Federated Inference: Toward Privacy-Preserving Collaborative and Incentivized Model Serving

author.name: Jungwon Seo, Ferhat Ozgur Catak, Chunming Rong, Jaeyeon Jang

entry.summary: Proposes Federated Inference (FI) as a distinct collaborative paradigm where independently trained models collaborate at inference time without sharing data or parameters. Formalizes FI as a protected collaborative computation and analyzes core design dimensions and structural trade-offs between privacy and performance.

entry.title: AgentAssay: Token-Efficient Regression Testing for Non-Deterministic AI Agent Workflows

author.name: Varun Pratap Bhardwaj

entry.summary: Presents AgentAssay, a framework for regression testing non-deterministic AI agent workflows with stochastic three-valued verdicts, five-dimensional coverage metrics, and mutation testing operators, achieving 78-100% cost reduction.

entry.title: FinTexTS: Financial Text-Paired Time-Series Dataset via Semantic-Based and Multi-Level Pairing

author.name: Jaehoon Lee, Suhwan Park, Tae Yoon Lim, Seunghan Lee, Jun Seo, Dongwan Kang, Hwanil Choi, Minjae Kim, Sungdong Yoo, SoonYoung Lee, Yongjae Lee, Wonbin Ahn

entry.summary: Introduces FinTexTS, a financial text-paired time-series dataset using semantic-based and multi-level pairing to capture complex market interdependencies, going beyond simple keyword matching to pair news with stock data.

entry.title: OrchMAS: Orchestrated Reasoning with Multi Collaborative Heterogeneous Scientific Expert Structured Agents

author.name: Yichao Feng, Haoran Luo, Zhenghong Lin, Yiqun Sun, Pengfei Wei, Lawrence B. Hsieh, Anh Tuan Luu

entry.summary: Proposes OrchMAS, a multi-agent framework for scientific reasoning using heterogeneous expert agents with dynamic orchestration, addressing limitations of static prompts and homogeneous model reliance in existing multi-agent systems.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Artificial Intelligence: A Task-Directed Survey in the Black-Box Models Era

author.name: Giovanni Pio Delvecchio, Lorenzo Molfetta, Gianluca Moro

entry.summary: Provides a task-directed survey of neuro-symbolic AI methods in the era of black-box models, examining how NeSy approaches integrate with modern connectionist systems across NLP and computer vision tasks.

entry.title: AI-for-Science Low-code Platform with Bayesian Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework

author.name: Zihang Zeng, Jiaquan Zhang, Pengze Li, Yuan Qi, Xi Chen

entry.summary: Presents a Bayesian adversarial multi-agent framework for AI-for-Science as a low-code platform, coordinating Task Manager, Code Generator, and Evaluator agents with adversarial loops for scientific code generation.

entry.title: Can Computational Reducibility Lead to Transferable Models for Graph Combinatorial Optimization?

author.name: Semih Cant\"urk, Thomas Sabourin, Frederik Wenkel, Michael Perlmutter, Guy Wolf

entry.summary: Explores computational reducibility for transferable neural solvers across combinatorial optimization tasks, showing that pretraining strategies based on problem reductions enable effective transfer between MVC, MIS, and MaxClique.

entry.title: Detecting Structural Heart Disease from Electrocardiograms via a Generalized Additive Model of Interpretable Foundation-Model Predictors

author.name: Ya Zhou, Zhaohong Sun, Tianxiang Hao, Xiangjie Li

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable framework for detecting structural heart disease from ECGs by combining ECG foundation model features within a generalized additive model (GAM), enabling transparent risk attribution while maintaining predictive performance.

entry.title: Credibility Governance: A Social Mechanism for Collective Self-Correction under Weak Truth Signals

author.name: Wanying He, Yanxi Lin, Ziheng Zhou, Xue Feng, Min Peng, Qianqian Xie, Zilong Zheng, Yipeng Kang

entry.summary: Proposes Credibility Governance, a mechanism that dynamically reallocates influence in opinion aggregation based on which agents and viewpoints consistently track evolving evidence, addressing manipulation vulnerabilities in online platforms.

entry.title: Improving Diffusion Planners by Self-Supervised Action Gating with Energies

author.name: Yuan Lu, Dongqi Han, Yansen Wang, Dongsheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE, an inference-time re-ranking method for diffusion planners in offline RL that uses JEPA-based latent consistency signals to penalize dynamically inconsistent plans, improving execution reliability.

entry.title: ShareVerse: Multi-Agent Consistent Video Generation for Shared World Modeling

author.name: Jiayi Zhu, Jianing Zhang, Yiying Yang, Wei Cheng, Xiaoyun Yuan

entry.summary: Presents ShareVerse, a multi-agent video generation framework for shared world modeling built on CARLA simulation, using spatial concatenation of multi-view videos and camera data to ensure cross-agent consistency.

entry.title: Faster, Cheaper, More Accurate: Specialised Knowledge Tracing Models Outperform LLMs

author.name: Prarthana Bhattacharyya, Joshua Mitton, Ralph Abboud, Simon Woodhead

entry.summary: Demonstrates that specialized knowledge tracing models outperform LLMs for predicting student responses, being faster, cheaper, and more accurate than general-purpose LLMs for this domain-specific task.

entry.title: cPNN: Continuous Progressive Neural Networks for Evolving Streaming Time Series

author.name: Federico Giannini, Giacomo Ziffer, Emanuele Della Valle

entry.summary: Introduces Continuous Progressive Neural Networks (cPNN) for streaming time series that simultaneously handles concept drift, temporal dependencies, and catastrophic forgetting. Extends Progressive Neural Networks to continuous settings for evolving data streams.

entry.title: Efficient Sparse Selective-Update RNNs for Long-Range Sequence Modeling

author.name: Bojian Yin, Shurong Wang, Haoyu Tan, Sander Bohte, Federico Corradi, Guoqi Li

entry.summary: Proposes Selective-Update RNNs (suRNNs) that learn to preserve memory by skipping updates when input is redundant, addressing the memory decay problem in standard RNNs. Uses neuron-level binary gating for efficient selective updates.

entry.title: A Unified Revisit of Temperature in Classification-Based Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Logan Frank, Jim Davis

entry.summary: Provides a unified study of temperature's role in knowledge distillation, showing it is closely linked to optimizer choice, teacher pretraining, and other training components. Aims to provide principled guidelines for temperature selection.

entry.title: Post Hoc Extraction of Pareto Fronts for Continuous Control

author.name: Raghav Thakar, Gaurav Dixit, Kagan Tumer

entry.summary: Proposes post-hoc extraction of Pareto fronts from pre-trained specialist RL policies for multi-objective continuous control, avoiding the need for full MORL training from scratch.

entry.title: Rethinking Time Series Domain Generalization via Structure-Stratified Calibration

author.name: Jinyang Li, Shuhao Mei, Xiaoyu Xiao, Shuhang Li, Ruoxi Yun, Jinbo Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a structure-stratified calibration framework for time series domain generalization that explicitly identifies structural groups of dynamical systems before alignment, avoiding negative transfer from spurious correspondences.

entry.title: Torus embeddings

author.name: Dan Stowell

entry.summary: Proposes torus embeddings for deep learning that match the natural topology of integer-with-overflow arithmetic in computers, showing that adapting frameworks to create torus-based representations can improve efficiency without sacrificing quality.

entry.title: Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Skin Tone Classification in the Wild

author.name: Vitor Pereira Matias, M\'arcus Vin\'icius Lobo Costa, Jo\~ao Batista Neto, Tiago Novello de Brito

entry.summary: Introduces STW, a large-scale open-access dataset for skin tone classification, and presents a comprehensive framework addressing train-test leakage, dataset imbalance, and limitations of the Fitzpatrick scale for fairness analysis.

entry.title: FlashEvaluator: Expanding Search Space with Parallel Evaluation

author.name: Chao Feng, Yuanhao Pu, Chenghao Zhang, Shanqi Liu, Shuchang Liu, Xiang Li, Yongqi Liu, Lantao Hu, Kaiqiao Zhan, Han Li, Kun Gai

entry.summary: Proposes FlashEvaluator for the Generator-Evaluator framework that enables cross-sequence comparison and parallel processing of all candidate sequences in a single forward pass, improving both accuracy and efficiency.

entry.title: ChemFlow:A Hierarchical Neural Network for Multiscale Representation Learning in Chemical Mixtures

author.name: Jinming Fan, Chao Qian, Wilhelm T. S. Huck, William E. Robinson, Shaodong Zhou

entry.summary: ChemFlow is a hierarchical graph neural network for predicting physicochemical properties of molecular mixtures, integrating atomic, functional group, and molecular levels with composition-modulated cross-level information exchange.

entry.title: Scalable Uncertainty Quantification for Black-Box Density-Based Clustering

author.name: Nicola Bariletto, Stephen G. Walker

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for uncertainty quantification in clustering by combining martingale posteriors with density-based clustering and neural density estimators, with frequentist consistency guarantees.

entry.title: Beyond Caption-Based Queries for Video Moment Retrieval

author.name: David Pujol-Perich, Albert Clap\'es, Dima Damen, Sergio Escalera, Michael Wray

entry.summary: Investigates degradation of video moment retrieval methods when trained on caption-based queries but evaluated on search queries, identifying language gap and multi-moment gap issues with decoder-query collapse in DETR architectures.

entry.title: ForestPersons: A Large-Scale Dataset for Under-Canopy Missing Person Detection

author.name: Deokyun Kim, Jeongjun Lee, Jungwon Choi, Jonggeon Park, Giyoung Lee, Yookyung Kim, Myungseok Ki, Juho Lee, Jihun Cha

entry.summary: Introduces ForestPersons, a large-scale dataset (96,482 images, 204,078 annotations) for detecting missing persons under forest canopy from under-canopy perspectives, addressing limitations of UAV-based aerial detection.

entry.title: HiLoRA: Hierarchical Low-Rank Adaptation for Personalized Federated Learning

author.name: Zihao Peng, Nan Zou, Jiandian Zeng, Guo Li, Ke Chen, Boyuan Li, Tian Wang

entry.summary: HiLoRA proposes a hierarchical LoRA framework for federated learning with Vision Transformers, placing adapters at root, cluster, and leaf levels to capture global, subgroup, and client-specific knowledge. This addresses the overlooked latent client structures in real-world federated settings, improving shared representation learning and adaptation to unseen clients.

entry.title: Intrinsic Geometry-Appearance Consistency Optimization for Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Kaiqiang Xiong, Rui Peng, Jiahao Wu, Zhanke Wang, Jie Liang, Xiaoyun Zheng, Feng Gao, Ronggang Wang

entry.summary: This paper presents MVD-HuGaS for free-view 3D human rendering from a single image using a multi-view human diffusion model with intrinsic geometry-appearance consistency optimization for Gaussian splatting.

entry.title: Safe Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via Combined Model and Learning-based Control

author.name: Alexander Schperberg, Yeping Wang, Stefano Di Cairano

entry.summary: This paper proposes a whole-body controller for legged robots combining model-based admittance control for the arm with RL for locomotion, enabling compliant behavior during physical interaction while tracking end-effector velocities jointly.

entry.title: IMR-LLM: Industrial Multi-Robot Task Planning and Program Generation using Large Language Models

author.name: Xiangyu Su, Juzhan Xu, Oliver van Kaick, Kai Xu, Ruizhen Hu

entry.summary: IMR-LLM uses LLMs for industrial multi-robot task planning and program generation, constructing disjunctive graphs and using deterministic solvers for efficient high-level plans, then generating robot programs via process trees.

entry.title: Tracing Back Error Sources to Explain and Mitigate Pose Estimation Failures

author.name: Loris Schneider, Yitian Shi, Rosa Wolf, Carolin Brenner, Rudolph Triebel, Rania Rayyes

entry.summary: A modular uncertainty-aware framework for pose estimation that decomposes errors into specific sources and applies targeted mitigation strategies, using ICP as a lightweight estimator for robotic grasping.

entry.title: From Language to Action: Can LLM-Based Agents Be Used for Embodied Robot Cognition?

author.name: Shinas Shaji, Fabian Huppertz, Alex Mitrevski, Sebastian Houben

entry.summary: This paper investigates using LLM-based agents as core components for planning and execution reasoning in a cognitive robot architecture, evaluating the extent to which LLMs can reliably bridge high-level language to low-level perception and control.

entry.title: An Alignment Journal: Coming Soon

author.name: Dan MacKinlay

entry.summary: Announces incubation of a new peer-reviewed academic journal dedicated to AI alignment research, with innovations including paid attributed review, reviewer-written synthesis abstracts, and targeted automation to address the undersupply of peer review in alignment.

entry.title: Direct Reward Fine-Tuning on Poses for Single Image to 3D Human in the Wild

author.name: Seunguk Do, Minwoo Huh, Joonghyuk Shin, Jaesik Park

entry.summary: Introduces DrPose, a direct reward fine-tuning algorithm for single-view 3D human reconstruction that trains multi-view diffusion models using pose-based rewards without expensive 3D assets, addressing unnatural poses in reconstructed humans.

entry.title: AnchorDrive: LLM Scenario Rollout with Anchor-Guided Diffusion Regeneration for Safety-Critical Scenario Generation

author.name: Zhulin Jiang, Zetao Li, Cheng Wang, Ziwen Wang, Chen Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes AnchorDrive, a two-stage framework combining LLMs for controllable scenario generation with diffusion models for realistic trajectory synthesis, creating safety-critical driving scenarios for autonomous vehicle evaluation.

entry.title: See and Remember: A Multimodal Agent for Web Traversal

author.name: Xinjun Wang, Shengyao Wang, Aimin Zhou, Hao Hao

entry.summary: Proposes V-GEMS, a multimodal agent architecture for web traversal combining visual grounding for ambiguous elements with an explicit memory stack for state tracking, preventing navigation loops and enabling valid backtracking.

entry.title: TikZilla: Scaling Text-to-TikZ with High-Quality Data and Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Christian Greisinger, Steffen Eger

entry.summary: Introduces TikZilla for scaling text-to-TikZ generation with high-quality data and reinforcement learning, addressing the mismatch between text descriptions and rendered figures by exposing models to rendered semantics.

entry.title: Agentic AI-based Coverage Closure for Formal Verification

author.name: Sivaram Pothireddypalli, Ashish Raman, Deepak Narayan Gadde, Aman Kumar

entry.summary: Presents an agentic AI workflow using LLMs for automating coverage analysis in formal hardware verification, identifying gaps and generating formal properties to accelerate IC verification.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Architectural Physics Embedding for Large-Scale Wave Field Reconstruction

author.name: Huiwen Zhang, Feng Ye, Chu Ma

entry.summary: Proposes physics-informed neural networks with architectural physics embedding for large-scale wave field reconstruction, embedding physical principles directly in the architecture rather than just the loss function.

entry.title: From Fewer Samples to Fewer Bits: Reframing Dataset Distillation as Joint Optimization of Precision and Compactness

author.name: My H. Dinh, Aditya Sant, Akshay Malhotra, Keya Patani, Shahab Hamidi-Rad

entry.summary: Proposes QuADD, a quantization-aware dataset distillation framework that jointly optimizes sample count and numerical precision under fixed bit budgets, showing that trading samples for precision can improve efficiency.

entry.title: Robust Heterogeneous Analog-Digital Computing for Mixture-of-Experts Models with Theoretical Generalization Guarantees

author.name: Mohammed Nowaz Rabbani Chowdhury, Hsinyu Tsai, Geoffrey W. Burr, Kaoutar El Maghraoui, Liu Liu, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a retraining-free framework for running Mixture-of-Experts models on analog in-memory computing hardware, with theoretical guarantees for identifying noise-sensitive experts that should be computed digitally.

entry.title: ITO: Images and Texts as One via Synergizing Multiple Alignment and Training-Time Fusion

author.name: HanZpeng Liu, Yaqian Li, Zidan Wang, Shuoxi Zhang, Zonglin Zhao, Zihao Bo, Rinyoichi Takezoe, Kaiwen Long, Kun He

entry.summary: Proposes ITO, a contrastive pretraining framework that uses multimodal multiple alignment and a training-time fusion module (discarded at inference) to produce better-aligned image-text representations while maintaining dual-encoder efficiency.

entry.title: CoFL: Continuous Flow Fields for Language-Conditioned Navigation

author.name: Haokun Liu, Zhaoqi Ma, Yicheng Chen, Masaki Kitagawa, Wentao Zhang, Jinjie Li, Moju Zhao

entry.summary: Presents CoFL, an end-to-end policy mapping BEV observations and language instructions to continuous flow fields for robot navigation, with trajectories obtained by numerical integration of predicted velocity fields.

entry.title: Enhancing Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Domain-aware Fourier Features: Towards Improved Performance and Interpretable Results

author.name: Alberto Mi\~no Calero, Luis Salamanca, Konstantinos E. Tatsis

entry.summary: Proposes Domain-aware Fourier Features (DaFFs) for physics-informed neural networks that encode geometry and boundary conditions, eliminating the need for explicit boundary condition loss terms and simplifying optimization.

entry.title: MA-CoNav: A Master-Slave Multi-Agent Framework with Hierarchical Collaboration and Dual-Level Reflection for Long-Horizon Embodied VLN

author.name: Ling Luo, Qianqian Bai

entry.summary: Proposes MA-CoNav, a multi-agent collaborative navigation framework with a master-slave hierarchy that decouples perception, planning, and execution for long-horizon vision-language navigation tasks. Addresses cognitive overload of single-agent approaches through distributed cognition.

entry.title: Type-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Dependency Closure for Solver-Executable Industrial Optimization Modeling

author.name: Y. Zhong, R. Huang, M. Wang, Z. Guo, YC. Li, M. Yu, Z. Jin

entry.summary: Proposes a type-aware RAG method for industrial optimization modeling that constructs typed knowledge bases from heterogeneous sources and enforces dependency closure to generate solver-executable code from natural language requirements.

entry.title: Personalized Multi-Agent Average Reward TD-Learning via Joint Linear Approximation

author.name: Leo (Muxing), Wang, Pengkun Yang, Lili Su

entry.summary: Studies personalized multi-agent average reward TD learning with shared linear representation, showing how subspace decomposition filters conflicting signals and achieves linear speedup in cooperative learning.

entry.title: Causal Learning Should Embrace the Wisdom of the Crowd

author.name: Ryan Feng Lin, Yuantao Wei, Huiling Liao, Xiaoning Qian, Shuai Huang

entry.summary: Argues for a new paradigm in causal learning that integrates crowdsourcing, interactive expert elicitation, and LLM-based simulation to leverage human causal knowledge at scale for learning causal structures.

entry.title: From Heuristic Selection to Automated Algorithm Design: LLMs Benefit from Strong Priors

author.name: Qi Huang, Furong Ye, Ananta Shahane, Thomas B\"ack, Niki van Stein

entry.summary: Shows that providing high-quality algorithmic code examples substantially improves LLM-driven algorithm design through token-wise attribution analysis. Proposes leveraging prior benchmark algorithms as strong priors for LLM optimization.

entry.title: LAGO: A Local-Global Optimization Framework Combining Trust Region Methods and Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Eliott Van Dieren, Tommaso Vanzan, Fabio Nobile

entry.summary: LAGO combines gradient-enhanced Bayesian Optimization with trust region methods through an adaptive competition mechanism, separating global exploration from local refinement for derivative-free optimization.

entry.title: I-CAM-UV: Integrating Causal Graphs over Non-Identical Variable Sets Using Causal Additive Models with Unobserved Variables

author.name: Hirofumi Suzuki, Kentaro Kanamori, Takuya Takagi, Thong Pham, Takashi Nicholas Maeda, Shohei Shimizu

entry.summary: Proposes I-CAM-UV for integrating causal graphs from multiple datasets with non-identical variable sets, leveraging Causal Additive Models with Unobserved Variables to handle confounders across datasets.

entry.title: Learning Demographic-Conditioned Mobility Trajectories with Aggregate Supervision

author.name: Jessie Z. Li, Zhiqing Hong, Toru Shirakawa, Serina Chang

entry.summary: Proposes ATLAS, a weakly supervised approach for generating demographic-conditioned mobility trajectories using only unlabeled trajectories and region-level census data, without individual demographic labels.

entry.title: Sequence-Level Unsupervised Training in Speech Recognition: A Theoretical Study

author.name: Zijian Yang, J\"org Barkoczi, Ralf Schl\"uter, Hermann Ney

entry.summary: Develops a theoretical framework for unsupervised speech recognition grounded in classification error bounds, introducing two conditions for success and proposing a single-stage sequence-level cross-entropy loss.

entry.title: Functional Properties of the Focal-Entropy

author.name: Jaimin Shah, Martina Cardone, Alex Dytso

entry.summary: Provides an information-theoretic study of focal-entropy (distributional analogue of focal-loss), establishing conditions for finiteness, convexity, continuity, and showing the focal-entropy minimizer can depart significantly from the data distribution.

entry.title: Convex and Non-convex Federated Learning with Stale Stochastic Gradients: Diminishing Step Size is All You Need

author.name: Xinran Zheng, Tara Javidi, Behrouz Touri

entry.summary: Shows that diminishing step sizes are sufficient for distributed SGD with delayed gradients, matching delay-adaptive step size performance, and recovers optimal SGD rates for both convex and nonconvex settings.

entry.title: Scale-invariant Gaussian derivative residual networks

author.name: Andrzej Perzanowski, Tony Lindeberg

entry.summary: Presents provably scale-invariant Gaussian derivative residual networks that address the out-of-distribution problem of scale generalization by adding residual connections to scale-covariant Gaussian derivative layers.

entry.title: Variance reduction in lattice QCD observables via normalizing flows

author.name: Ryan Abbott, Denis Boyda, Yang Fu, Daniel C. Hackett, Gurtej Kanwar, Fernando Romero-L\'opez, Phiala E. Shanahan, Julian M. Urban

entry.summary: Uses normalizing flows for variance reduction in lattice QCD observables, achieving 10-60x variance reduction in glueball correlation functions and hadron structure matrix elements in SU(3) Yang-Mills theory.

entry.title: Shape Derivative-Informed Neural Operators with Application to Risk-Averse Shape Optimization

author.name: Xindi Gong, Dingcheng Luo, Thomas O'Leary-Roseberry, Ruanui Nicholson, Omar Ghattas

entry.summary: Shape-DINO is a derivative-informed neural operator for learning PDE solutions on varying geometries, using diffeomorphic mappings to a reference domain to accelerate PDE-constrained shape optimization under uncertainty.

entry.title: Interpreting Speaker Characteristics in the Dimensions of Self-Supervised Speech Features

author.name: Kyle Janse van Rensburg, Benjamin van Niekerk, Herman Kamper

entry.summary: Investigates how self-supervised speech models (WavLM) structure their representations, finding that individual principal dimensions encode specific speaker characteristics like pitch, gender, intensity, and formant frequencies.

entry.title: AutoFFS: Adversarial Deformations for Facial Feminization Surgery Planning

author.name: Paul Friedrich, Florentin Bieder, Florian M. Thieringer, Philippe C. Cattin

entry.summary: Proposes AutoFFS for facial feminization surgery planning using adversarial free-form deformations on skull morphologies, generating counterfactual shapes through targeted adversarial attacks on sex classifiers.

entry.title: Aligning Fetal Anatomy with Kinematic Tree Log-Euclidean PolyRigid Transforms

author.name: Yingcheng Liu, Athena Taymourtash, Yang Liu, Esra Abaci Turk, William M. Wells, Leo Joskowicz, P. Ellen Grant, Polina Golland

entry.summary: Introduces a differentiable volumetric fetal body model using a novel Kinematic Tree-based Log-Euclidean PolyRigid transform that resolves Lie algebra ambiguities for articulated motion, evaluated on 53 fetal MRI volumes with fewer folding artifacts.

entry.title: E2E-GNet: An End-to-End Skeleton-based Geometric Deep Neural Network for Human Motion Recognition

author.name: Mubarak Olaoluwa, Hassen Drira

entry.summary: Proposes E2E-GNet, an end-to-end geometric deep neural network for skeleton-based motion recognition that operates in non-Euclidean space with differentiable log map projection and distortion-aware optimization.

entry.title: SGMA: Semantic-Guided Modality-Aware Segmentation for Remote Sensing with Incomplete Multimodal Data

author.name: Lekang Wen, Liang Liao, Jing Xiao, Mi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SGMA for semantic segmentation of remote sensing data with incomplete multimodal inputs, using semantic-guided modality-aware mechanisms to handle missing sensors, multimodal imbalance, and cross-modal heterogeneity.

entry.title: ProGIC: Progressive and Lightweight Generative Image Compression with Residual Vector Quantization

author.name: Hao Cao, Chengbin Liang, Wenqi Guo, Zhijin Qin, Jungong Han

entry.summary: ProGIC proposes a progressive generative image compression codec using residual vector quantization (RVQ), enabling coarse-to-fine reconstruction and progressive bitstreams with a lightweight backbone based on depthwise-separable convolutions.

entry.title: Improving Anomaly Detection with Foundation-Model Synthesis and Wavelet-Domain Attention

author.name: Wensheng Wu, Zheming Lu, Ziqian Lu, Zewei He, Xuecheng Sun, Zhao Wang, Jungong Han, Yunlong Yu

entry.summary: This paper proposes FMAS, a foundation model-based anomaly synthesis pipeline for generating realistic anomalous samples without fine-tuning, paired with WDAM, a wavelet domain attention module for anomaly detection that exploits frequency-domain characteristics.

entry.title: Learning Therapist Policy from Therapist-Exoskeleton-Patient Interaction

author.name: Grayson Snyder, Lorenzo Vianello, Levi Hargrove, Matthew L. Elwin, Jose Pons

entry.summary: This paper proposes learning therapist interaction policies from data collected during therapist-exoskeleton-patient interactions using VAE for shared latent manifolds and GMM for interaction modeling, aiming to support therapists in rehabilitation.

entry.title: Wukong-Omni: Design, Modeling and Control of a Multi-mode Robot for Air, Land, and Underwater Exploration with All-in-One Propulsion Unit

author.name: Yufan Liu, Rixi Yu, Junjie Li, Yishuai Zeng, Zhenting Wen, Cheng Li, Haifei Zhu, Shikang Lian, Wei Meng, Fumin Zhang

entry.summary: Wukong-Omni is a novel multimode robot operating across land, air, and underwater using a unified propulsion system, achieving 100% improvement in propulsion efficiency and 150% increase in maximum thrust through optimized motor reuse.

entry.title: cuNRTO: GPU-Accelerated Nonlinear Robust Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Jiawei Wang, Arshiya Taj Abdul, Evangelos A. Theodorou

entry.summary: cuNRTO presents GPU-accelerated nonlinear robust trajectory optimization using CUDA implementations of Douglas-Rachford splitting for SOCP subproblems, enabling parallel computation for robust decision-making under uncertainty.

entry.title: COOL-MC: Verifying and Explaining RL Policies for Platelet Inventory Management

author.name: Dennis Gross

entry.summary: Applies COOL-MC (combining RL with probabilistic model checking and explainable RL) to verify and explain a trained policy for platelet inventory management, constructing a policy-induced Markov chain for formal verification.

entry.title: LLMs for High-Frequency Decision-Making: Normalized Action Reward-Guided Consistency Policy Optimization

author.name: Yang Zhao, Zihao Li, Zhiyu Jiang, Dandan Ma, Ganchao Liu, Wenzhe Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes NAR-CP (Normalized Action Reward guided Consistency Policy Optimization) for using LLMs in high-frequency decision-making tasks, addressing policy misalignment between sub-tasks and composite tasks through reward normalization and consistency optimization.

entry.title: Agentified Assessment of Logical Reasoning Agents

author.name: Zhiyu Ni, Yifeng Xiao, Zheng Liang

entry.summary: Presents a framework for evaluating logical reasoning agents using an assessor agent that issues tasks, enforces budgets, and records structured failures, with a case study on auto-formalization of first-order logic using Z3.

entry.title: Odin: Multi-Signal Graph Intelligence for Autonomous Discovery in Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Muyukani Kizito, Elizabeth Nyambere

entry.summary: Presents Odin, a graph intelligence engine for autonomous discovery in knowledge graphs using COMPASS score combining structural importance, semantic plausibility, temporal relevance, and community-aware guidance.

entry.title: Contextual Invertible World Models: A Neuro-Symbolic Agentic Framework for Colorectal Cancer Drug Response

author.name: Christopher Baker, Karen Rafferty, Hui Wang

entry.summary: Presents a neuro-symbolic framework for colorectal cancer drug response prediction that integrates a machine learning world model with an LLM-based agentic reasoning layer, addressing the small-N large-P problem in precision oncology.

entry.title: GLoRIA: Gated Low-Rank Interpretable Adaptation for Dialectal ASR

author.name: Pouya Mehralian, Melissa Farasyn, Anne Breitbarth, Anne-Sophie Ghyselen, Hugo Van hamme

entry.summary: Proposes GLoRIA, a parameter-efficient ASR adaptation framework that uses location metadata to modulate low-rank updates for dialectal speech recognition, achieving SOTA on the GCND corpus with under 10% parameter updates.

entry.title: GPUTOK: GPU Accelerated Byte Level BPE Tokenization

author.name: Venu Gopal Kadamba, Kanishkha Jaisankar

entry.summary: Presents a GPU-accelerated byte-level BPE tokenizer following GPT-2's merge rules, achieving 1.7x speedup over tiktoken and 7.6x over HuggingFace's tokenizer for long sequences.

entry.title: AlphaFree: Recommendation Free from Users, IDs, and GNNs

author.name: Minseo Jeon, Junwoo Jung, Daewon Gwak, Jinhong Jung

entry.summary: Proposes AlphaFree, a recommendation system that eliminates dependencies on per-user embeddings, raw ID features, and GNNs, using only item interaction patterns for generalization to unseen users and interactions.

entry.title: Scores Know Bobs Voice: Speaker Impersonation Attack

author.name: Chanwoo Hwang, Sunpill Kim, Yong Kiam Tan, Tianchi Liu, Seunghun Paik, Dongsoo Kim, Mondal Soumik, Khin Mi Mi Aung, Jae Hong Seo

entry.summary: Proposes an inversion-based generative attack framework for speaker recognition systems that uses score-based optimization in a speaker-discriminative latent space for more efficient impersonation attacks.

entry.title: StegaFFD: Privacy-Preserving Face Forgery Detection via Fine-Grained Steganographic Domain Lifting

author.name: Guoqing Ma, Xun Lin, Hui Ma, Ajian Liu, Yizhong Liu, Wenzhong Tang, Shan Yu, Chenqi Kong, Yi Yu

entry.summary: Proposes StegaFFD, using steganographic techniques to hide face images for privacy-preserving face forgery detection, making protected images look natural rather than obviously anonymized.

entry.title: Interpretable Motion-Attentive Maps: Spatio-Temporally Localizing Concepts in Video Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Youngjun Jun, Seil Kang, Woojung Han, Seong Jae Hwang

entry.summary: Introduces interpretable motion-attentive saliency maps for Video Diffusion Transformers, proposing methods to spatially localize motion concepts and identify when/which objects move.

entry.title: Beyond One-Size-Fits-All: Adaptive Subgraph Denoising for Zero-Shot Graph Learning with Large Language Models

author.name: Fengzhi Li, Liang Zhang, Yuan Zuo, Ruiqing Zhao, YanSong Liu, Yunfei Ma, Fanyu Meng, Junlan Feng

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive subgraph denoising for zero-shot graph learning with LLMs, addressing the problem that task-agnostic subgraph extraction introduces structural noise that hurts LLM reasoning.

entry.title: Learning graph topology from metapopulation epidemic encoder-decoder

author.name: Xin Li, Jonathan Cohen, Shai Pilosof, Rami Puzis

entry.summary: Proposes encoder-decoder deep learning architectures that infer metapopulation mobility graphs from epidemic time-series data, addressing the joint inference of epidemic parameters and mobility networks.

entry.title: EdgeFLow: Serverless Federated Learning via Sequential Model Migration in Edge Networks

author.name: Yuchen Shi, Qijun Hou, Pingyi Fan, Khaled B. Letaief

entry.summary: Proposes EdgeFLow, a federated learning framework that replaces cloud servers with sequential model migration between edge base stations, eliminating cloud-based transmissions and reducing communication overhead.

entry.title: Addressing Missing and Noisy Modalities in One Solution: Unified Modality-Quality Framework for Low-quality Multimodal Data

author.name: Sijie Mai, Shiqin Han, Haifeng Hu

entry.summary: Proposes UMQ framework that jointly addresses missing and noisy modalities as a unified low-quality modality problem for multimodal affective computing, using a rank-guided quality estimator and quality-aware representation enhancement.

entry.title: Distributed Dynamic Invariant Causal Prediction in Environmental Time Series

author.name: Ziruo Hao, Tao Yang, Xiaofeng Wu, Bo Hu

entry.summary: Proposes DisDy-ICPT, a framework for distributed dynamic invariant causal prediction in environmental time series that learns dynamic causal relationships while mitigating spatial confounding without data communication.

entry.title: Breaking the Prototype Bias Loop: Confidence-Aware Federated Contrastive Learning for Highly Imbalanced Clients

author.name: Tian-Shuang Wu, Shen-Huan Lyu, Ning Chen, Yi-Xiao He, Bing Tang, Baoliu Ye, Qingfu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CAFedCL to break the prototype bias loop in federated contrastive learning by using confidence-aware aggregation that downweights high-variance local prototypes, plus generative augmentation for minority classes.

entry.title: Guiding Sparse Neural Networks with Neurobiological Principles to Elicit Biologically Plausible Representations

author.name: Patrick Inoue, Florian R\"ohrbein, Andreas Knoblauch

entry.summary: Introduces a biologically inspired learning rule that naturally integrates neurobiological principles (sparsity, lognormal weights, Dale's law) into neural networks, aiming to improve generalization and few-shot learning.

entry.title: OnDA: On-device Channel Pruning for Efficient Personalized Keyword Spotting

author.name: Matteo Risso, Alessio Burrello, Daniele Jahier Pagliari

entry.summary: Proposes on-device channel pruning for personalized keyword spotting, combining weight adaptation with architectural adaptation (structured pruning) during deployment, achieving up to 9.63x compression at iso-performance.

entry.title: Bias and Fairness in Self-Supervised Acoustic Representations for Cognitive Impairment Detection

entry.title: The elbow statistic: Multiscale clustering statistical significance

entry.title: HateMirage: An Explainable Multi-Dimensional Dataset for Decoding Faux Hate and Subtle Online Abuse

author.name: Sai Kartheek Reddy Kasu, Shankar Biradar, Sunil Saumya, Md. Shad Akhtar

entry.title: Retrieving Patient-Specific Radiomic Feature Sets for Transparent Knee MRI Assessment

author.name: Yaxi Chen, Simin Ni, Jingjing Zhang, Shaheer U. Saeed, Yipei Wang, Aleksandra Ivanova, Rikin Hargunani, Chaozong Liu, Jie Huang, Yipeng Hu

entry.title: OpenMarcie: Dataset for Multimodal Action Recognition in Industrial Environments

author.name: Hymalai Bello, Lala Ray, Joanna Sorysz, Sungho Suh, Paul Lukowicz

entry.summary: Presents OpenMarcie, a large-scale multimodal dataset for human action recognition in manufacturing environments, with wearable and camera data from 36 participants performing bicycle assembly/disassembly tasks.

entry.title: Beyond Anatomy: Explainable ASD Classification from rs-fMRI via Functional Parcellation and Graph Attention Networks

author.name: Syeda Hareem Madani, Noureen Bibi, Adam Rafiq Jeraj, Sumra Khan, Anas Zafar, Rizwan Qureshi

entry.title: ReCo-Diff: Residual-Conditioned Deterministic Sampling for Cold Diffusion in Sparse-View CT

author.name: Yong Eun Choi, Hyoung Suk Park, Kiwan Jeon, Hyun-Cheol Park, Sung Ho Kang

entry.title: TenExp: Mixture-of-Experts-Based Tensor Decomposition Structure Search Framework

author.name: Ting-Wei Zhou, Xi-Le Zhao, Sheng Liu, Wei-Hao Wu, Yu-Bang Zheng, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Proposes TenExp, a mixture-of-experts framework for automatic tensor decomposition structure search that dynamically selects and activates suitable decompositions in an unsupervised fashion.

entry.title: Multimodal-Prior-Guided Importance Sampling for Hierarchical Gaussian Splatting in Sparse-View Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Kaiqiang Xiong, Zhanke Wang, Ronggang Wang

entry.summary: This paper presents a multimodal-prior-guided importance sampling mechanism for hierarchical 3D Gaussian Splatting in sparse-view novel view synthesis, fusing photometric, semantic, and geometric cues to determine where to add fine Gaussians.

entry.title: VIRGi: View-dependent Instant Recoloring of 3D Gaussians Splats

author.name: Alessio Mazzucchelli, Ivan Ojeda-Martin, Fernando Rivas-Manzaneque, Elena Garces, Adrian Penate-Sanchez, Francesc Moreno-Noguer

entry.title: AWDiff: An a trous wavelet diffusion model for lung ultrasound image synthesis

author.name: Maryam Heidari (University of Bristol, UK), Nantheera Anantrasirichai (University of Bristol, UK), Steven Walker (Bristol Medical School, University of Bristol, UK), Rahul Bhatnagar (Bristol Medical School, University of Bristol, UK), Alin Achim (University of Bristol, UK)

entry.title: Biomechanically Accurate Gait Analysis: A 3d Human Reconstruction Framework for Markerless Estimation of Gait Parameters

author.name: Akila Pemasiri, Ethan Goan, Glen Lichtwark, Robert Schuster, Luke Kelly, Clinton Fookes

entry.title: PathSpace: Rapid continuous map approximation for efficient SLAM using B-Splines in constrained environments

entry.title: I Had Claude Read Every AI Safety Paper Since 2020, Here's the DB

entry.summary: Created a comprehensive database of AI safety papers since 2020 by having Claude read and encode them, designed so an AI can take in all encodings and decide which papers are relevant to a specific problem. Aimed at solving discoverability issues in AI safety research.

entry.title: Integrating Homomorphic Encryption and Synthetic Data in FL for Privacy and Learning Quality

author.name: Yenan Wang, Carla Fabiana Chiasserini, Elad Michael Schiller

entry.title: EduVQA: Benchmarking AI-Generated Video Quality Assessment for Education

entry.title: ProSMA-UNet: Decoder Conditioning for Proximal-Sparse Skip Feature Selection

entry.title: Self-supervised Domain Adaptation for Visual 3D Pose Estimation of Nano-drone Racing Gates by Enforcing Geometric Consistency

entry.title: SuperLocalMemory: Privacy-Preserving Multi-Agent Memory with Bayesian Trust Defense Against Memory Poisoning

entry.title: LLM-MLFFN: Multi-Level Autonomous Driving Behavior Feature Fusion via Large Language Model

author.name: Xiangyu Li, Tianyi Wang, Xi Cheng, Rakesh Chowdary Machineni, Zhaomiao Guo, Sikai Chen, Junfeng Jiao, Christian Claudel

entry.summary: Proposes a framework integrating LLM-based argument mining with quantitative argumentation reasoning and description logic ontologies for structured analysis of debate texts, extracting fuzzy argumentative knowledge bases.

entry.title: FEAST: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Hierarchical Food Classification for the FoodEx2 System

entry.title: Research Summary: March 03, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on AI safety mechanisms, fundamental theoretical advances, and practical efficiency gains for frontier model deployment.

  • A striking safety result shows GPT-5, Claude-4.5, and Qwen-3 can take consequential actions at low probabilities while remaining well-calibrated, posing tail-risk concerns at scale
  • Qwen3-Coder-Next delivers an 80B/3B-active MoE coding agent achieving state-of-the-art results via large-scale verifiable task synthesis
  • Mechanistic probing reveals instruction-tuned LLMs often determine answers before generating chain-of-thought, challenging assumptions about CoT faithfulness
  • Systematic evaluation finds current LLM agents show minimal scheming propensity despite having capability, providing a cautious baseline for safety monitoring

On the theory side, Adam is proven to converge without modification given problem-dependent hyperparameters, resolving a long-standing concern. Recursive self-invocation models prove any computable problem admits decomposition for bounded-context LLMs. GRPO—the technique behind DeepSeek-R1—is formally characterized as a U-statistic with finite-sample error bounds.

  • Thought Virus demonstrates viral propagation of subliminal biases across multi-agent networks from a single compromised node
  • CoDD breaks the factorization barrier in diffusion language models via coupled denoising with autoregressive backbone coordination
  • Attn-QAT enables end-to-end FP4 inference including attention, achieving stable 4-bit quantization-aware training for next-generation GPU deployment

entry.title: Adam Converges Without Any Modification On Update Rules

author.name: Yushun Zhang, Bingran Li, Congliang Chen, Zhi-Quan Luo, Ruoyu Sun

entry.summary: Proves that Adam converges with proper problem-dependent hyperparameters, resolving concerns raised by the classic divergence example. Shows convergence when β₂ is large and β₁ < √β₂, and identifies divergence regions for small β₂.

entry.title: Recursive Models for Long-Horizon Reasoning

author.name: Chenxiao Yang, Nathan Srebro, Zhiyuan Li

entry.summary: Proposes recursive models where an LLM can recursively invoke itself to solve subtasks in isolated contexts, proving any computable problem admits decomposition requiring exponentially smaller context per subtask.

entry.title: Decoding Answers Before Chain-of-Thought: Evidence from Pre-CoT Probes and Activation Steering

author.name: Kyle Cox, Darius Kianersi, Adri\`a Garriga-Alonso

entry.summary: Provides mechanistic evidence that instruction-tuned LLMs often determine their answer before generating chain-of-thought, using linear probes on residual stream activations with 0.9 AUC. Shows these directions are causally active via activation steering.

entry.title: Breaking the Factorization Barrier in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Ian Li, Zilei Shao, Benjie Wang, Rose Yu, Guy Van den Broeck, Anji Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Coupled Discrete Diffusion (CoDD), a hybrid framework that breaks the factorization barrier in diffusion language models by allowing simultaneous token predictions to be jointly dependent without requiring prohibitively large output parameterization.

entry.title: Thought Virus: Viral Misalignment via Subliminal Prompting in Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Moritz Weckbecker, Jonas M\"uller, Ben Hagag, Michael Mulet

entry.summary: Demonstrates that subliminal prompting (biasing LLMs via semantically unrelated tokens) can propagate through multi-agent networks - a single subliminally prompted agent spreads persistent bias throughout its entire network. Tests across 6 agents and two topologies.

entry.title: What Do Visual Tokens Really Encode? Uncovering Sparsity and Redundancy in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yingqi Fan, Junlong Tong, Anhao Zhao, Xiaoyu Shen

entry.summary: Introduces EmbedLens to analyze how visual tokens are structured in multimodal LLMs, revealing that ~40% of visual tokens are semantically dead/sink tokens while only ~60% carry image-specific meaning. Demonstrates significant redundancy.

entry.title: DUEL: Exact Likelihood for Masked Diffusion via Deterministic Unmasking

author.name: Gilad Turok, Chris De Sa, Volodymyr Kuleshov

entry.summary: DUEL introduces a framework for exact likelihood computation in masked diffusion models (MDMs) by formalizing deterministic position selection during unmasking. This gives MDMs proper perplexity evaluation for the first time, addressing a key gap where prior ELBO-based measures were loose bounds not aligned with test-time generation.

entry.title: Attn-QAT: 4-Bit Attention With Quantization-Aware Training

author.name: Peiyuan Zhang, Matthew Noto, Wenxuan Tan, Chengquan Jiang, Will Lin, Wei Zhou, Hao Zhang

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic study of 4-bit quantization-aware training for attention mechanisms, identifying key principles for stable FP4 attention and proposing Attn-QAT to enable end-to-end FP4 computation on emerging hardware.

entry.title: Reverse CAPTCHA: Evaluating LLM Susceptibility to Invisible Unicode Instruction Injection

author.name: Marcus Graves

entry.summary: Reverse CAPTCHA evaluates LLM susceptibility to invisible Unicode-encoded instructions, finding that tool use dramatically amplifies compliance with hidden instructions (Cohen's h up to 1.37) and models show provider-specific encoding preferences.

entry.title: LangGap: Diagnosing and Closing the Language Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Yuchen Hou, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: LangGap reveals that state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action models largely ignore language instructions, achieving >95% on standard benchmarks but failing when tasks require actual language understanding. Proposes the LangGap benchmark.

entry.title: The Expressive Limits of Diagonal SSMs for State-Tracking

author.name: Mehran Shakerinava, Behnoush Khavari, Siamak Ravanbakhsh, Sarath Chandar

entry.summary: Precisely characterizes the expressivity of diagonal state-space models for state-tracking tasks: k-layer DCD SSMs can express state-tracking of a group iff it has a subnormal series of length k with Abelian factors.

entry.title: Multi-Head Low-Rank Attention

author.name: Songtao Liu, Hongwu Peng, Zhiwei Zhang, Zhengyu Chen, Yue Guo

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Head Low-Rank Attention (MHLRA) to address the sharding bottleneck of Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) in distributed decoding, enabling better tensor parallelism for KV cache management.

entry.title: Context Awareness: Constitutional AI can mitigate Emergent Misalignement

author.name: Giuseppe Birardi

entry.summary: Empirical study showing that Constitutional AI-style character training reduces emergent misalignment (EM) across multiple persona types on Qwen 2.5 7B and Llama 3.1 8B. Finds that even safety-irrelevant personas (humor, poetry) confer protection, and custom metacommunicative constitutions achieve the lowest misalignment rates. Notes model-dependent effects where sarcasm training amplifies misalignment on Llama but not Qwen.

entry.title: How Well Does Agent Development Reflect Real-World Work?

author.name: Zora Zhiruo Wang, Sanidhya Vijayvargiya, Aspen Chen, Hanmo Zhang, Venu Arvind Arangarajan, Jett Chen, Valerie Chen, Diyi Yang, Daniel Fried, Graham Neubig

entry.summary: Systematically maps 43 agent benchmarks (72,342 tasks) to real-world occupations in the U.S. labor market, revealing substantial mismatches between programming-centric agent development and where human labor/economic value concentrate.

entry.title: What Is the Geometry of the Alignment Tax?

author.name: Robin Young
