entry.summary: Demonstrates how diffusion models can plagiarize copyrighted images even with watermark protection, using an 'anchors and shims' approach to evade copyright detection via cross-attention perturbation.

entry.title: Random Wins All: Rethinking Grouping Strategies for Vision Tokens

author.name: Qihang Fan, Yuang Ai, Huaibo Huang, Ran He

entry.summary: Challenges carefully designed token grouping methods for Vision Transformers by showing that random grouping achieves competitive or better performance, offering a simpler unified approach.

entry.title: pySpatial: Generating 3D Visual Programs for Zero-Shot Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Zhanpeng Luo, Ce Zhang, Silong Yong, Cunxi Dai, Qianwei Wang, Haoxi Ran, Guanya Shi, Katia Sycara, Yaqi Xie

entry.summary: pySpatial is a visual programming framework that equips MLLMs with spatial reasoning by generating Python code calling 3D reconstruction, camera-pose recovery, and novel-view rendering tools. Works zero-shot without gradient-based training.

entry.title: DriveCode: Domain Specific Numerical Encoding for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhiye Wang, Yanbo Jiang, Rui Zhou, Bo Zhang, Fang Zhang, Zhenhua Xu, Yaqin Zhang, Jianqiang Wang

entry.summary: DriveCode introduces a novel numerical encoding method for LLM-based autonomous driving that represents numbers as dedicated embeddings rather than discrete tokens, addressing precision limitations in sensor processing and control commands.

entry.title: GeodesicNVS: Probability Density Geodesic Flow Matching for Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Xuqin Wang, Tao Wu, Yanfeng Zhang, Lu Liu, Mingwei Sun, Yongliang Wang, Niclas Zeller, Daniel Cremers

entry.summary: GeodesicNVS introduces probability density geodesic flow matching for novel view synthesis, learning deterministic data-to-data transformations between paired views rather than noise-to-data diffusion. Daniel Cremers is a co-author.

entry.title: Unleashing VLA Potentials in Autonomous Driving via Explicit Learning from Failures

author.name: Yuechen Luo, Qimao Chen, Fang Li, Shaoqing Xu, Jaxin Liu, Ziying Song, Zhi-xin Yang, Fuxi Wen

entry.summary: ELF-VLA augments RL training of Vision-Language-Action models for autonomous driving with structured diagnostic feedback from failures, addressing the performance plateau caused by information-sparse reward signals.

entry.title: RnG: A Unified Transformer for Complete 3D Modeling from Partial Observations

author.name: Mochu Xiang, Zhelun Shen, Xuesong Li, Jiahui Ren, Jing Zhang, Chen Zhao, Shanshan Liu, Haocheng Feng, Jingdong Wang, Yuchao Dai

entry.summary: RnG unifies 3D reconstruction and generation in a single Transformer, using reconstruction-guided causal attention to predict complete 3D structures from partial 2D observations including unseen geometry.

entry.title: DriveCombo: Benchmarking Compositional Traffic Rule Reasoning in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Enhui Ma, Jiahuan Zhang, Guantian Zheng, Tao Tang, Shengbo Eben Li, Yuhang Lu, Xia Zhou, Xueyang Zhang, Yifei Zhan, Kun Zhan, Zhihui Hao, Xianpeng Lang, Kaicheng Yu

entry.summary: DriveCombo benchmarks compositional traffic rule reasoning for MLLMs in autonomous driving, proposing a Five-Level Cognitive Ladder from single-rule to multi-rule conflict scenarios.

entry.title: FastLightGen: Fast and Light Video Generation with Fewer Steps and Parameters

author.name: Shao Shitong, Gu Yufei, Xie Zeke

entry.summary: FastLightGen simultaneously compresses video generation models in both sampling steps and parameter count, combining step reduction (like LCM) with model compression for fast and lightweight video generation.

entry.title: LaST-VLA: Thinking in Latent Spatio-Temporal Space for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yuechen Luo, Fang Li, Shaoqing Xu, Yang Ji, Zehan Zhang, Bing Wang, Yuannan Shen, Jianwei Cui, Long Chen, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Zhi-Xin Yang, Fuxi Wen

entry.summary: LaST-VLA shifts autonomous driving VLA reasoning from discrete symbolic processing into physically grounded latent spatio-temporal chain-of-thought, addressing semantic-perceptual decoupling issues.

entry.title: UniHM: Unified Dexterous Hand Manipulation with Vision Language Model

author.name: Zhenhao Zhang, Jiaxin Liu, Ye Shi, Jingya Wang

entry.summary: UniHM introduces the first framework for unified dexterous hand manipulation guided by free-form language, using a Unified Hand-Dexterous Tokenizer and training solely on human-object interaction data.

entry.title: D-REX: Differentiable Real-to-Sim-to-Real Engine for Learning Dexterous Grasping

author.name: Haozhe Lou, Mingtong Zhang, Haoran Geng, Hanyang Zhou, Sicheng He, Zhiyuan Gao, Siheng Zhao, Jiageng Mao, Pieter Abbeel, Jitendra Malik, Daniel Seita, Yue Wang

entry.summary: D-REX introduces a differentiable real-to-sim-to-real engine using Gaussian Splat representations for physical parameter identification and dexterous grasping policy learning from visual observations.

entry.title: Neural Implicit Action Fields: From Discrete Waypoints to Continuous Functions for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Haoyun Liu, Jianzhuang Zhao, Xinyuan Chang, Tianle Shi, Chuanzhang Meng, Jiayuan Tan, Feng Xiong, Tong Lin, Dongjie Huo, Mu Xu, SongLin Dong, Zhiheng Ma, Yihong Gong, Sheng Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes Neural Implicit Action Fields (NIAF), reformulating VLA action prediction from discrete waypoints to continuous action function regression, enabling infinite-resolution trajectory synthesis as continuous-time manifolds.

entry.title: CausalWrap: Model-Agnostic Causal Constraint Wrappers for Tabular Synthetic Data

author.name: Amir Asiaee, Zhuohui J. Liang, Chao Yan

entry.summary: CausalWrap is a model-agnostic wrapper that injects partial causal knowledge into tabular synthetic data generators, improving structural fidelity for downstream causal reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Learning Shortest Paths with Generative Flow Networks

author.name: Nikita Morozov, Ian Maksimov, Daniil Tiapkin, Sergey Samsonov

entry.summary: Presents a novel framework using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) for finding shortest paths in graphs. Proves that minimizing total flow in non-acyclic environments yields policies traversing only shortest paths, demonstrating results on permutation environments and Rubik's Cubes.

entry.title: Meta-Learning Hyperparameters for Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning

author.name: Zichen Tian, Yaoyao Liu, Qianru Sun

entry.summary: MetaPEFT uses meta-learning to automatically optimize hyperparameters (layer positions, depth, scaling factors) for parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods like LoRA, particularly for remote sensing applications.

entry.title: Partial Causal Structure Learning for Valid Selective Conformal Inference under Interventions

author.name: Amir Asiaee, Kavey Aryan, James P. Long

entry.summary: Studies selective conformal prediction in interventional settings where exchangeability structure is unknown and must be learned, providing coverage guarantees under contamination from misclassified calibration examples.

entry.title: CoSMo3D: Open-World Promptable 3D Semantic Part Segmentation through LLM-Guided Canonical Spatial Modeling

author.name: Li Jin, Weikai Chen, Yujie Wang, Yingda Yin, Zeyu Hu, Runze Zhang, Keyang Luo, Shengju Qian, Xin Wang, Xueying Qin

entry.summary: CoSMo3D achieves open-world 3D semantic part segmentation by learning canonical spatial representations guided by LLMs, aligning parts across categories based on functional roles rather than sensor coordinates.

entry.title: Generative Visual Chain-of-Thought for Image Editing

author.name: Zijin Yin, Tiankai Hang, Yiji Cheng, Shiyi Zhang, Runze He, Yu Xu, Chunyu Wang, Bing Li, Zheng Chang, Kongming Liang, Qinglin Lu, Zhanyu Ma

entry.summary: GVCoT proposes generative visual chain-of-thought for image editing that generates spatial cues to localize target regions before executing edits, jointly optimizing reasoning and editing in an end-to-end manner.

entry.title: $\pi$-StepNFT: Wider Space Needs Finer Steps in Online RL for Flow-based VLAs

author.name: Siting Wang, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu, Minnan Pei, Xinyu Cui, Cheng Deng, Jian Zhao, Guan Huang, Haifeng Zhang, Jun Wang

entry.summary: π-StepNFT proposes a critic-and-likelihood-free online RL framework for flow-based VLA models, showing that wider exploration spaces need finer-grained step-wise guidance.

entry.title: DIG to Heal: Scaling General-purpose Agent Collaboration via Explainable Dynamic Decision Paths

author.name: Hanqing Yang, Hyungwoo Lee, Yuhang Yao, Zhiwei Liu, Kay Liu, Jingdi Chen, Carlee Joe-Wong

entry.summary: Studies multi-agent LLM systems without predefined roles or workflows, proposing DIG (Dynamic Decision Paths) to achieve emergent collaboration that scales with agent count. Addresses redundant work and cascading failures in unstructured multi-agent interactions.

entry.title: LOGIGEN: Logic-Driven Generation of Verifiable Agentic Tasks

author.name: Yucheng Zeng, Weipeng Lu, Linyun Liu, Shupeng Li, Zitian Qu, Chenghao Zhu, Shaofei Li, Zhengdong Tan, Mengyue Liu, Haotian Zhao, Zhe Zhou, Jianmin Wu

entry.summary: Introduces LOGIGEN, a framework for synthesizing verifiable training data for agentic AI using logic-driven forward synthesis with deterministic state verification, employing a triple-agent orchestration (Architect, Executor, Auditor).

entry.title: MemPO: Self-Memory Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agents

author.name: Ruoran Li, Xinghua Zhang, Haiyang Yu, Shitong Duan, Xiang Li, Wenxin Xiang, Chonghua Liao, Xudong Guo, Yongbin Li, Jinli Suo

entry.summary: Proposes MemPO, a self-memory policy optimization algorithm enabling agents to autonomously summarize and manage memory during long-horizon interactions, using credit assignment based on memory effectiveness.

entry.title: BioProAgent: Neuro-Symbolic Grounding for Constrained Scientific Planning

author.name: Yuyang Liu, Jingya Wang, Liuzhenghao Lv, Yonghong Tian

entry.summary: Proposes BioProAgent, a neuro-symbolic framework for wet-lab protocol planning that anchors LLM planning in deterministic finite state machines to prevent hallucinations that could cause equipment damage or experimental failure.

entry.title: HiMAC: Hierarchical Macro-Micro Learning for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

author.name: Hongbo Jin, Rongpeng Zhu, Jiayu Ding, Wenhao Zhang, Ge Li

entry.summary: Proposes HiMAC, a hierarchical RL framework that decomposes long-horizon agent decision-making into macro-level planning (blueprint generation) and micro-level execution, addressing error propagation in flat autoregressive policies.

entry.title: Securing the Floor and Raising the Ceiling: A Merging-based Paradigm for Multi-modal Search Agents

author.name: Zhixiang Wang, Jingxuan Xu, Dajun Chen, Yunfang Wu, Wei Jiang, Yong Li

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free paradigm to give VLMs autonomous search capabilities through cross-modal model merging, fusing text-based search agents with base VLMs without additional multimodal training data.

entry.title: RubricBench: Aligning Model-Generated Rubrics with Human Standards

author.name: Qiyuan Zhang, Junyi Zhou, Yufei Wang, Fuyuan Lyu, Yidong Ming, Can Xu, Qingfeng Sun, Kai Zheng, Peng Kang, Xue Liu, Chen Ma

entry.summary: Introduces RubricBench, a benchmark with 1,147 pairwise comparisons for assessing the reliability of rubric-based LLM evaluation. Uses a multi-dimensional filtration pipeline targeting hard samples with nuanced complexity.

entry.title: According to Me: Long-Term Personalized Referential Memory QA

author.name: Jingbiao Mei, Jinghong Chen, Guangyu Yang, Xinyu Hou, Margaret Li, Bill Byrne

entry.summary: Introduces ATM-Bench, the first benchmark for multimodal, multi-source personalized referential memory QA spanning approximately four years of privacy-preserving personal memory data with human-annotated QA pairs requiring personal reference resolution.

entry.title: Position: AI Agents Are Not (Yet) a Panacea for Social Simulation

author.name: Yiming Li, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that LLM-based agents are not yet suitable for rigorous social simulation, identifying systematic mismatches between what agent pipelines produce and what simulation-as-science requires.

entry.title: CT-Flow: Orchestrating CT Interpretation Workflow with Model Context Protocol Servers

author.name: Yannian Gu, Xizhuo Zhang, Linjie Mu, Yongrui Yu, Zhongzhen Huang, Shaoting Zhang, Xiaofan Zhang

entry.summary: CT-Flow is an agentic framework for CT interpretation that uses Model Context Protocol (MCP) to orchestrate tool-mediated workflows, shifting from single-pass inference to iterative, tool-aware processing similar to how radiologists work. This bridges the gap between static LVLM inference and dynamic clinical workflows.

entry.title: Efficient Long-Horizon GUI Agents via Training-Free KV Cache Compression

author.name: Bowen Zhou, Zhou Xu, Wanli Li, Jingyu Xiao, Haoqian Wang

entry.summary: ST-Lite is a training-free KV cache compression framework for GUI agents that exploits the uniform high-sparsity attention pattern unique to GUI scenarios, enabling efficient long-horizon interactions.

entry.title: Agentic Scientific Simulation: Execution-Grounded Model Construction and Reconstruction

author.name: Knut-Andreas Lie, Olav M{\o}yner, Elling Svee, Jakob Torben

entry.summary: Investigates agentic scientific simulation where LLM agents construct physics models through interpret-act-validate loops, with the simulator serving as arbiter of physical validity. Addresses ambiguity in natural-language model specifications.

entry.title: Hereditary Geometric Meta-RL: Nonlocal Generalization via Task Symmetries

author.name: Paul Nitschke, Shahriar Talebi

entry.summary: Develops geometric perspective on Meta-RL using Lie group symmetries for nonlocal generalization, enabling policy transfer through state/action transformations rather than smooth extrapolation.

entry.title: Whisper-MLA: Reducing GPU Memory Consumption of ASR Models based on MHA2MLA Conversion

author.name: Sen Zhang, Jianguo Wei, Wenhuan Lu, Xianghu Yue, Wei Li, Qiang Li, Pengcheng Zhao, Ming Cai, Luo Si

entry.summary: Whisper-MLA introduces Multi-Head Latent Attention into the Whisper ASR model to reduce GPU memory from KV cache, achieving significant memory savings when applied to decoder cross-attention while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Improving Text-to-Image Generation with Intrinsic Self-Confidence Rewards

author.name: Seungwook Kim, Minsu Cho

entry.summary: ARC introduces a self-confidence-based post-training framework for text-to-image models that uses internal self-denoising probes as rewards, enabling fully unsupervised optimization without external reward models.

entry.title: Conformal Prediction for Risk-Controlled Medical Entity Extraction Across Clinical Domains

author.name: Manil Shrestha, Edward Kim

entry.summary: Applies conformal prediction to LLM-based medical entity extraction, providing finite-sample coverage guarantees across drug labels and radiology reports using GPT-4.1 and Llama-4-Maverick.

entry.title: TriMoE: Augmenting GPU with AMX-Enabled CPU and DIMM-NDP for High-Throughput MoE Inference via Offloading

author.name: Yudong Pan, Yintao He, Tianhua Han, Lian Liu, Shixin Zhao, Zhirong Chen, Mengdi Wang, Cangyuan Li, Yinhe Han, Ying Wang

entry.summary: TriMoE proposes a GPU-CPU-NDP heterogeneous architecture for MoE inference that leverages AMX-enabled CPUs for warm experts and DIMM-NDP for cold experts, addressing the compute gap in offloading-based inference.

entry.title: Robust Weighted Triangulation of Causal Effects Under Model Uncertainty

author.name: Rohit Bhattacharya, Ina Ocelli, Ted Westling

entry.summary: Proposes a principled framework for causal effect triangulation that combines model testability from causal discovery with semiparametric inference, avoiding explicit model selection. The method produces a weighted combination of estimates robust to model uncertainty.

entry.title: TC-SSA: Token Compression via Semantic Slot Aggregation for Gigapixel Pathology Reasoning

author.name: Zhuo Chen, Shawn Young, Lijian Xu

entry.summary: TC-SSA proposes a learnable token compression framework for gigapixel whole slide image analysis that aggregates patch features into semantic slots using gated Top-2 routing, enabling VLMs to process pathology images efficiently.

entry.title: VidDoS: Universal Denial-of-Service Attack on Video-based Large Language Models

author.name: Duoxun Tang, Dasen Dai, Jiyao Wang, Xiao Yang, Jianyu Wang, Siqi Cai

entry.summary: VidDoS is the first universal energy-latency attack framework for Video-LLMs, using universal optimization to create instance-agnostic triggers that exhaust computational resources without per-instance optimization.

entry.title: Non-Markovian Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Keyframe Chaining

author.name: Yipeng Chen, Wentao Tan, Lei Zhu, Fengling Li, Jingjing Li, Guoli Yang, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Keyframe-Chaining VLA extracts and links key historical frames to model non-Markovian dependencies in long-horizon robotic manipulation, addressing a fundamental limitation of current VLA models.

entry.title: Towards Privacy-Preserving LLM Inference via Collaborative Obfuscation (Technical Report)

author.name: Yu Lin, Qizhi Zhang, Wenqiang Ruan, Daode Zhang, Jue Hong, Ye Wu, Hanning Xia, Yunlong Mao, Sheng Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes collaborative obfuscation for privacy-preserving LLM inference that meets three practical requirements: minimal accuracy/efficiency loss, compatibility with heterogeneous hardware, and reuse of existing LLM infrastructure.

entry.title: DualSentinel: A Lightweight Framework for Detecting Targeted Attacks in Black-box LLM via Dual Entropy Lull Pattern

author.name: Xiaoyi Pang, Xuanyi Hao, Pengyu Liu, Qi Luo, Song Guo, Zhibo Wang

entry.summary: DualSentinel detects targeted attacks (backdoor, prompt injection) on black-box LLMs by identifying a 'Dual Entropy Lull' pattern during generation, providing lightweight real-time defense.

entry.title: Rethinking Policy Diversity in Ensemble Policy Gradient in Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Naoki Shitanda, Motoki Omura, Tatsuya Harada, Takayuki Osa

entry.summary: Theoretically analyzes inter-policy diversity in ensemble policy gradient methods for large-scale RL and proposes Coupled Policy Optimization, which regulates diversity through KL constraints between policies for more effective exploration.

entry.title: Hyperparameter Trajectory Inference with Conditional Lagrangian Optimal Transport

author.name: Harry Amad, Mihaela van der Schaar

entry.summary: Introduces Hyperparameter Trajectory Inference (HTI), learning how a neural network's output distribution changes with hyperparameters to construct surrogates that approximate the network at unobserved settings, using conditional Lagrangian optimal transport.

entry.title: KDFlow: A User-Friendly and Efficient Knowledge Distillation Framework for Large Language Models

author.name: Songming Zhang, Xue Zhang, Tong Zhang, Bojie Hu, Yufeng Chen, Jinan Xu

entry.summary: Presents KDFlow, an LLM knowledge distillation framework that decouples student training (FSDP2) from teacher inference (SGLang), achieving better efficiency through heterogeneous backend optimization and compressed logit transfer.

entry.title: Dream2Learn: Structured Generative Dreaming for Continual Learning

author.name: Salvatore Calcagno, Matteo Pennisi, Federica Proietto Salanitri, Amelia Sorrenti, Simone Palazzo, Concetto Spampinato, Giovanni Bellitto

entry.summary: Introduces Dream2Learn, a continual learning framework inspired by dreaming where a model generates structured synthetic experiences from internal representations using a frozen diffusion model, creating novel dreamed classes for self-improvement.

entry.title: MMR-Life: Piecing Together Real-life Scenes for Multimodal Multi-image Reasoning

author.name: Jiachun Li, Shaoping Huang, Zhuoran Jin, Chenlong Zhang, Pengfei Cao, Yubo Chen, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces MMR-Life, a benchmark with 2,646 questions over 19,108 real-world images evaluating multimodal multi-image reasoning across seven reasoning types (abductive, analogical, causal, deductive, etc.).

entry.title: Near-Optimal Regret for KL-Regularized Multi-Armed Bandits

author.name: Kaixuan Ji, Qingyue Zhao, Heyang Zhao, Qiwei Di, Quanquan Gu

entry.summary: Provides near-optimal regret analysis for KL-regularized multi-armed bandits via sharp analysis of KL-UCB, achieving the first high-probability regret bound with linear dependence on K and near-matching lower bounds.

entry.title: Diagnostics for Individual-Level Prediction Instability in Machine Learning for Healthcare

author.name: Elizabeth W. Miller, Jeffrey D. Blume

entry.summary: Develops diagnostics for individual-level prediction instability in healthcare ML models, showing that optimization randomness alone can produce materially different risk estimates for the same patient even with identical data and architecture.

entry.title: Bridge Matching Sampler: Scalable Sampling via Generalized Fixed-Point Diffusion Matching

author.name: Denis Blessing, Lorenz Richter, Julius Berner, Egor Malitskiy, Gerhard Neumann

entry.summary: Introduces Bridge Matching Sampler (BMS), a method for sampling from unnormalized densities that generalizes existing diffusion-based matching methods as fixed-point iterations rooted in Nelson's relation, enabling transport between arbitrary prior and target distributions.

entry.title: To Use or not to Use Muon: How Simplicity Bias in Optimizers Matters

author.name: Sara Dragutinovi\'c, Rajesh Ranganath

entry.summary: Investigates potential downsides of the Muon optimizer compared to Adam, analyzing biases induced by Muon's optimization mechanism and demonstrating failure cases where Muon-optimized models underperform.

entry.title: Understanding LoRA as Knowledge Memory: An Empirical Analysis

author.name: Seungju Back, Dongwoo Lee, Naun Kang, Taehee Lee, S. K. Hong, Youngjune Gwon, Sungjin Ahn

entry.summary: Provides the first systematic empirical study of LoRA as modular knowledge memory for LLMs, mapping the design space of capacity, composability, and interference patterns for knowledge updating.

entry.title: JailNewsBench: Multi-Lingual and Regional Benchmark for Fake News Generation under Jailbreak Attacks

author.name: Masahiro Kaneko, Ayana Niwa, Timothy Baldwin

entry.summary: Proposes JailNewsBench, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM robustness against jailbreak-induced fake news generation across multiple languages and regions.

entry.title: Towards OOD Generalization in Dynamic Graphs via Causal Invariant Learning

author.name: Xinxun Zhang, Pengfei Jiao, Mengzhou Gao, Tianpeng Li, Xuan Guo

entry.summary: Proposes a causal invariant learning framework for OOD generalization in dynamic graphs, addressing the challenges of identifying invariant patterns in evolving graphs and ensuring generalization across diverse distribution shifts.

entry.title: Decentralized Federated Learning by Partial Message Exchange

author.name: Shan Sha, Shenglong Zhou, Xin Wang, Lingchen Kong, Geoffrey Ye Li

entry.summary: PaME introduces a decentralized federated learning algorithm where only randomly selected sparse coordinates are exchanged between neighbors, achieving communication reduction and privacy preservation simultaneously.

entry.title: CoVAE: correlated multimodal generative modeling

author.name: Federico Caretti, Guido Sanguinetti

entry.summary: CoVAE introduces a multimodal VAE architecture that preserves cross-modal correlations, unlike standard fusion strategies that destroy joint statistical structure, enabling better cross-modal reconstruction and uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Bilevel Optimization with Lower-Level Uniform Convexity: Theory and Algorithm

author.name: Yuman Wu, Xiaochuan Gong, Jie Hao, Mingrui Liu

entry.summary: Studies bilevel optimization under lower-level uniform convexity (weaker than strong convexity), establishing non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for this broader class of problems.

entry.title: Detecting Cognitive Signatures in Typing Behavior for Non-Intrusive Authorship Verification

author.name: David Condrey

entry.summary: Proposes using keystroke timing patterns as cognitive signatures for authorship verification, introducing the Cognitive Load Correlation metric to distinguish genuine composition from transcription.

entry.title: KROM: Kernelized Reduced Order Modeling

author.name: Aras Bacho, Jonghyeon Lee, Houman Owhadi

entry.summary: KROM proposes a kernel-based reduced-order framework for nonlinear PDEs that uses snapshot-driven empirical kernels and sparse Cholesky factorization for efficiency.

entry.title: Polynomial Mixing for Efficient Self-supervised Speech Encoders

author.name: Eva Feillet, Ryan Whetten, David Picard, Alexandre Allauzen

entry.summary: Proposes Polynomial Mixer (PoM) as a drop-in replacement for multi-head self-attention in speech encoders, achieving linear complexity. Integrated into BEST-RQ self-supervised framework and evaluated on speech recognition.

entry.title: Tiny-Critic RAG: Empowering Agentic Fallback with Parameter-Efficient Small Language Models

author.name: Yichao Wu, Penghao Liang, Yafei Xiang, Mengwei Yuan, Jianan Liu, Jing Yang, Xianyou Li, Weiran Yan

entry.summary: Tiny-Critic RAG decouples retrieval quality assessment from the main LLM by using small, parameter-efficient language models as critics for routing decisions, reducing computational overhead in agentic RAG systems.

entry.title: IDProxy: Cold-Start CTR Prediction for Ads and Recommendation at Xiaohongshu with Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Yubin Zhang, Haiming Xu, Guillaume Salha-Galvan, Ruiyan Han, Feiyang Xiao, Yanhua Huang, Li Lin, Yang Luo, Yao Hu

entry.summary: IDProxy uses multimodal LLMs to generate proxy ID embeddings for cold-start items in CTR prediction at Xiaohongshu, aligning content-derived embeddings with existing ID embedding spaces. Deployed in production.

entry.title: Probing Materials Knowledge in LLMs: From Latent Embeddings to Reliable Predictions

author.name: Vineeth Venugopal, Soroush Mahjoubi, Elsa Olivetti

entry.summary: Evaluates 25 LLMs across four materials science tasks (200+ configurations), finding that output modality determines model behavior—symbolic tasks benefit from fine-tuning while numerical tasks remain inconsistent across runs.

entry.title: Learning to Read Where to Look: Disease-Aware Vision-Language Pretraining for 3D CT

author.name: Simon Ging (Computer Vision Group, University of Freiburg, Germany, Adaptive & Agentic AI), Philipp Arnold (Department of Radiology, Medical Center -- University of Freiburg, Germany), Sebastian Walter (Chair of Algorithms and Data Structures, University of Freiburg, Germany), Hani Alnahas (Computer Vision Group, University of Freiburg, Germany), Hannah Bast (Chair of Algorithms and Data Structures, University of Freiburg, Germany), Elmar Kotter (Department of Radiology, Medical Center -- University of Freiburg, Germany), Jiancheng Yang (ELLIS Institute Finland, School of Electrical Engineering, Aalto University, Finland), Behzad Bozorgtabar (Adaptive & Agentic AI), Thomas Brox (Computer Vision Group, University of Freiburg, Germany)

entry.summary: Trains a 3D CT vision-language model on 98k report-volume pairs using SigLIP-style contrastive pretraining with disease-specific supervision, achieving state-of-the-art text-to-image retrieval on CT-RATE.

entry.title: CoMoL: Efficient Mixture of LoRA Experts via Dynamic Core Space Merging

author.name: Jie Cao, Zhenxuan Fan, Zhuonan Wang, Tianwei Lin, Ziyuan Zhao, Rolan Yan, Wenqiao Zhang, Feifei Shao, Hongwei Wang, Jun Xiao, Siliang Tang

entry.summary: Proposes CoMoL, a Mixture-of-LoRA framework that stores experts in compact core matrices and uses token-level routing rather than instance-level routing, improving both parameter efficiency and fine-grained adaptation.

entry.title: Reasoning or Rationalization? The Role of Justifications in Masked Diffusion Models for Fact Verification

author.name: Jacob Devasier

entry.summary: Investigates how Masked Diffusion Language Models handle reasoning in fact verification, finding they converge on verdicts early as global anchors before completing justifications—and that enforcing reasoning-first constraints degrades performance.

entry.title: Commitment Checklist: Auditing Author Commitments in Peer Review

author.name: Chung-Chi Chen, Iryna Gurevych

entry.summary: Conducts large-scale audit of author commitments in peer review rebuttals versus camera-ready papers using LLMs, finding ~25% of promises unfulfilled, and proposes an 'Author Commitment Checklist' system.

entry.title: Mechanistically Guided LoRA Improves Paraphrase Consistency in Medical Vision-Language Models

author.name: Binesh Sadanandan, Vahid Behzadan

entry.summary: Addresses paraphrase inconsistency in MedGemma-4B medical VLM where rephrased clinical questions yield different answers. Uses mechanistic interpretability (SAEs) and LoRA fine-tuning to reduce flip rate from 14.6% to 1.9%.

entry.title: DreamWorld: Unified World Modeling in Video Generation

author.name: Boming Tan, Xiangdong Zhang, Ning Liao, Yuqing Zhang, Shaofeng Zhang, Xue Yang, Qi Fan, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces DreamWorld, a unified framework that integrates multiple forms of world knowledge (physical commonsense, 3D/temporal consistency) into video generators via joint world modeling paradigm.

entry.title: MLLM-4D: Towards Visual-based Spatial-Temporal Intelligence

author.name: Xingyilang Yin, Chengzhengxu Li, Jiahao Chang, Chi-Man Pun, Xiaodong Cun

entry.summary: Introduces MLLM-4D, a comprehensive framework for 4D spatio-temporal understanding from visual inputs, with data curation pipeline and datasets (MLLM4D-2M, MLLM4D-R1-30k) for supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

entry.title: NERFIFY: A Multi-Agent Framework for Turning NeRF Papers into Code

author.name: Seemandhar Jain, Keshav Gupta, Kunal Gupta, Manmohan Chandraker

entry.summary: NERFIFY is a multi-agent framework that converts NeRF research papers into trainable Nerfstudio code plugins, using context-free grammars and graph-of-thought synthesis. It addresses the gap where generic paper-to-code tools (including GPT-5) fail to produce runnable NeRF code.

entry.title: VGGT-Det: Mining VGGT Internal Priors for Sensor-Geometry-Free Multi-View Indoor 3D Object Detection

author.name: Yang Cao, Feize Wu, Dave Zhenyu Chen, Yingji Zhong, Lanqing Hong, Dan Xu

entry.summary: VGGT-Det builds on Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer to perform sensor-geometry-free multi-view indoor 3D object detection, eliminating the need for calibrated camera poses. First framework for this practical setting.

entry.title: ArtLLM: Generating Articulated Assets via 3D LLM

author.name: Penghao Wang, Siyuan Xie, Hongyu Yan, Xianghui Yang, Jingwei Huang, Chunchao Guo, Jiayuan Gu

entry.summary: ArtLLM generates articulated 3D assets with kinematic structure from complete meshes using a 3D multimodal LLM. Predicts joint types, parameters, and motion ranges for complex multi-joint objects.

entry.title: DOCFORGE-BENCH: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Document Forgery Detection and Analysis

author.name: Zengqi Zhao, Weidi Xia, Peter Wei, Yan Zhang, Yiyi Zhang, Jane Mo, Tiannan Zhang, Yuanqin Dai, Zexi Chen, Simiao Ren

entry.summary: DOCFORGE-BENCH is the first unified zero-shot benchmark for document forgery detection, revealing a critical calibration failure where methods achieve moderate AUC but near-zero F1 scores.

entry.title: Unifying Language-Action Understanding and Generation for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xinyang Wang, Qian Liu, Wenjie Ding, Zhao Yang, Wei Li, Chang Liu, Bailin Li, Kun Zhan, Xianpeng Lang, Wei Chen

entry.summary: LinkVLA unifies language and action tokens into a shared discrete codebook for autonomous driving, addressing misalignment between language instructions and action outputs in VLA models while improving efficiency.

entry.title: Preference Score Distillation: Leveraging 2D Rewards to Align Text-to-3D Generation with Human Preference

author.name: Jiaqi Leng, Shuyuan Tu, Haidong Cao, Sicheng Xie, Daoguo Dong, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Preference Score Distillation (PSD) leverages pretrained 2D reward models for human-aligned text-to-3D synthesis without 3D training data, addressing the incompatibility of pixel-level gradients from reward models.

entry.title: QCAgent: An agentic framework for quality-controllable pathology report generation from whole slide image

author.name: Rundong Wang, Wei Ba, Ying Zhou, Yingtai Li, Bowen Liu, Baizhi Wang, Yuhao Wang, Zhidong Yang, Kun Zhang, Rui Yan, S. Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: QCAgent is an agentic framework for quality-controllable pathology report generation from whole-slide images, featuring a customized critique mechanism guided by user-defined checklists.

entry.title: FireRed-OCR Technical Report

author.name: Hao Wu, Haoran Lou, Xinyue Li, Zuodong Zhong, Zhaojun Sun, Phellon Chen, Xuanhe Zhou, Kai Zuo, Yibo Chen, Xu Tang, Yao Hu, Boxiang Zhou, Jian Wu, Yongji Wu, Wenxin Yu, Yingmiao Liu, Yuhao Huang, Manjie Xu, Gang Liu, Yidong Ma, Zhichao Sun, Changhao Qiao

entry.summary: FireRed-OCR specializes general VLMs (based on Qwen3-VL) into high-performance OCR models for complex document parsing, addressing 'structural hallucination' with a geometry+semantics data factory.

entry.title: Process Over Outcome: Cultivating Forensic Reasoning for Generalizable Multimodal Manipulation Detection

author.name: Yuchen Zhang, Yaxiong Wang, Kecheng Han, Yujiao Wu, Lianwei Wu, Li Zhu, Zhedong Zheng

entry.summary: REFORM proposes a reasoning-driven framework for multimodal manipulation detection that shifts from outcome-based classification to forensic reasoning processes, improving generalization to unseen manipulation patterns.

entry.title: WorldStereo: Bridging Camera-Guided Video Generation and Scene Reconstruction via 3D Geometric Memories

author.name: Yisu Zhang, Chenjie Cao, Tengfei Wang, Xuhui Zuo, Junta Wu, Jianke Zhu, Chunchao Guo

entry.summary: WorldStereo bridges camera-guided video generation and 3D reconstruction via global-geometric and spatial-stereo memory modules that enable precise camera control and consistent 3D scenes.

entry.title: Revisiting Global Token Mixing in Task-Dependent MRI Restoration: Insights from Minimal Gated CNN Baselines

author.name: Xiangjian Hou, Chao Qin, Chang Ni, Xin Wang, Chun Yuan, Xiaodong Ma

entry.summary: Questions whether global token mixing (self-attention, SSMs) is always beneficial for MRI restoration, finding that minimal gated CNN baselines match or exceed complex architectures in tasks with strong physics-driven constraints.

entry.title: Uniform-in-time concentration in two-layer neural networks via transportation inequalities

author.name: Arnaud Guillin (LMBP), Boris Nectoux (LMBP), Paul Stos (LMBP)

entry.summary: Establishes uniform-in-time concentration bounds between two-layer neural networks trained by SGD and their mean-field limits, using transportation inequalities. Provides explicit constants independent of iteration index for Wasserstein distance convergence. This advances the theoretical understanding of the mean-field approximation for neural network training.

entry.title: War Claude

author.name: PeterMcCluskey

entry.summary: Commentary on the US Department of War's conflict with Anthropic, alleging that OpenAI received preferential treatment due to political donations while Anthropic was punished for refusing to build autonomous weapons without human-in-the-loop requirements. Discusses geopolitical implications including two new wars in Asia.

entry.title: Conservative Equilibrium Discovery in Offline Game-Theoretic Multiagent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Austin A. Nguyen, Michael P. Wellman

entry.summary: Addresses offline game-theoretic multi-agent reinforcement learning by extending PSRO to select among candidate equilibria with conservative guarantees from fixed datasets. Proposes methods to handle the impossibility of verifying true equilibria from limited data.

entry.title: K^2-Agent: Co-Evolving Know-What and Know-How for Hierarchical Mobile Device Control

author.name: Zhe Wu, Donglin Mo, Hongjin Lu, Junliang Xing, Jianheng Liu, Yuheng Jing, Kai Li, Kun Shao, Jianye Hao, Yuanchun Shi

entry.summary: Proposes K²-Agent, a hierarchical framework for mobile device control that separates declarative (know-what) and procedural (know-how) knowledge, with self-evolving task-level knowledge from demonstrations.

entry.title: MC-Search: Evaluating and Enhancing Multimodal Agentic Search with Structured Long Reasoning Chains

author.name: Xuying Ning, Dongqi Fu, Tianxin Wei, Mengting Ai, Jiaru Zou, Ting-Wei Li, Hanghang Tong, Yada Zhu, Hendrik Hamann, Jingrui He

entry.summary: Presents MC-Search, the first benchmark for agentic multimodal RAG with long step-wise annotated reasoning chains spanning five reasoning structures, with a HAVE verification protocol.

entry.title: DIVA-GRPO: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning through Difficulty-Adaptive Variant Advantage

author.name: Haowen Gao, Zhenyu Zhang, Liang Pang, Fangda Guo, Hongjian Dou, Guannan Lv, Shaoguo Liu, Tingting Gao, Huawei Shen, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes DIVA-GRPO, a difficulty-adaptive variant advantage method that adjusts difficulty distributions within GRPO rollout groups to address sparse rewards and advantage vanishing for multimodal reasoning.

entry.title: AutoSkill: Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning via Skill Self-Evolution

author.name: Yutao Yang, Junsong Li, Qianjun Pan, Bihao Zhan, Yuxuan Cai, Lin Du, Jie Zhou, Kai Chen, Qin Chen, Xin Li, Bo Zhang, Liang He

entry.summary: Introduces AutoSkill, a lifelong learning framework where LLM agents automatically derive, maintain, and evolve skills from dialogue traces, enabling personalized capability accumulation across sessions without retraining.

entry.title: A Unified Framework to Quantify Cultural Intelligence of AI

author.name: Sunipa Dev, Vinodkumar Prabhakaran, Rutledge Chin Feman, Aida Davani, Remi Denton, Charu Kalia, Piyawat L Kumjorn, Madhurima Maji, Rida Qadri, Negar Rostamzadeh, Renee Shelby, Romina Stella, Hayk Stepanyan, Erin van Liemt, Aishwarya Verma, Oscar Wahltinez, Edem Wornyo, Andrew Zaldivar, Sa\v{s}ka Mojsilovi\'c

entry.summary: Presents a principled framework for measuring cultural intelligence of AI systems, drawing on measurement theory to aggregate multifaceted cultural capability indicators into unified assessment.

entry.title: Words & Weights: Streamlining Multi-Turn Interactions via Co-Adaptation

author.name: Chenxing Wei, Hong Wang, Ying He, Zhongxiang Dai, Bo Jiang, F. Richard Yu, Yao Shu

entry.summary: Proposes ROSA², a framework treating multi-turn LLM interaction as joint optimization over both prompts (words) and model weights, arguing semantic clarity pre-conditions effective parameter updates.

entry.title: Emerging Human-like Strategies for Semantic Memory Foraging in Large Language Models

author.name: Eric Lacosse, Mariana Duarte, Peter M. Todd, Daniel C. McNamee

entry.summary: Studies whether LLMs exhibit human-like semantic memory foraging strategies using the Semantic Fluency Task and mechanistic interpretability techniques to analyze how models access and organize semantic memory.

entry.title: MOSAIC: Unveiling the Moral, Social and Individual Dimensions of Large Language Models

author.name: Erica Coppolillo, Emilio Ferrara

entry.summary: Introduces MOSAIC, the first large-scale benchmark jointly assessing moral, social, and individual characteristics of LLMs, going beyond the commonly used Moral Foundation Theory to include personality traits and social values.

entry.title: Universal NP-Hardness of Clustering under General Utilities

author.name: Angshul Majumdar

entry.summary: Proves universal NP-hardness of clustering under general polynomial-time computable utility functions, unifying ten major paradigms including k-means and GMMs under a single theoretical framework.

entry.title: MuonRec: Shifting the Optimizer Paradigm Beyond Adam in Scalable Generative Recommendation

author.name: Rong Shan, Aofan Yu, Bo Chen, Kuo Cai, Qiang Luo, Ruiming Tang, Han Li, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang, Jianghao Lin

entry.summary: MuonRec brings the Muon optimizer (orthogonalized momentum via Newton-Schulz iteration) to recommender systems, challenging the default Adam/AdamW choice. First framework applying Muon to RecSys.

entry.title: HydroShear: Hydroelastic Shear Simulation for Tactile Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning

author.name: An Dang, Jayjun Lee, Mustafa Mukadam, X. Alice Wu, Bernadette Bucher, Manikantan Nambi, Nima Fazeli

entry.summary: HydroShear is a non-holonomic hydroelastic tactile simulator modeling stick-slip transitions, path-dependent force buildup, and full SE(3) interactions for sim-to-real tactile policy transfer.

entry.title: Rooted Absorbed Prefix Trajectory Balance with Submodular Replay for GFlowNet Training

author.name: Xi Wang, Wenbo Lu, Shengjie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes RapTB for GFlowNet training that addresses mode collapse through rooted absorbed prefix trajectory balance with submodular replay, providing dense prefix-level learning signals for LLM fine-tuning.

entry.title: ArtiFixer: Enhancing and Extending 3D Reconstruction with Auto-Regressive Diffusion Models

author.name: Riccardo de Lutio, Tobias Fischer, Yen-Yu Chang, Yuxuan Zhang, Jay Zhangjie Wu, Xuanchi Ren, Tianchang Shen, Katarina Tothova, Zan Gojcic, Haithem Turki

entry.summary: ArtiFixer uses auto-regressive diffusion models to enhance 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions in under-observed areas, addressing scalability and consistency issues of prior generative-prior methods for novel view synthesis.

entry.title: Curvature-Weighted Capacity Allocation: A Minimum Description Length Framework for Layer-Adaptive Large Language Model Optimization

author.name: Theophilus Amaefuna, Hitesh Vaidya, Anshuman Chhabra, Ankur Mali

entry.summary: Proposes curvature-weighted capacity allocation using MDL principle for layer-adaptive LLM optimization, deriving a curvature-adjusted layer gain metric for principled pruning and allocation decisions under hardware constraints.

entry.title: EraseAnything++: Enabling Concept Erasure in Rectified Flow Transformers Leveraging Multi-Object Optimization

author.name: Zhaoxin Fan, Nanxiang Jiang, Daiheng Gao, Shiji Zhou, Wenjun Wu

entry.summary: EraseAnything++ is a unified framework for concept erasure in both image and video diffusion models with flow-matching objectives, formulating erasure as constrained multi-objective optimization.

entry.title: FastCode: Fast and Cost-Efficient Code Understanding and Reasoning

author.name: Zhonghang Li, Zongwei Li, Yuxuan Chen, Han Shi, Jiawei Li, Jierun Chen, Haoli Bai, Chao Huang

entry.summary: FastCode decouples repository exploration from content consumption for code reasoning, using a structural scouting mechanism over a lightweight semantic-structural map to reduce context costs.

entry.title: Differential privacy representation geometry for medical image analysis

author.name: Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh, Marziyeh Mohammadi, Sven Nebelung, Daniel Truhn

entry.title: Alpha-RF: Automated RF-Filter-Circuit Design with Neural Simulator and Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Nhat Tran, Chenjie Hao, Alexander Stameroff, Anh-Vu Pham, Yubei Chen

entry.summary: Alpha-RF proposes an automated RF filter circuit design tool using a neural simulator combined with reinforcement learning, replacing manual design iterations and expensive electromagnetic simulations.

entry.title: Scaling Quantum Machine Learning without Tricks: High-Resolution and Diverse Image Generation

author.name: Jonas J\"ager, Florian J. Kiwit, Carlos A. Riofr\'io

entry.summary: Proposes methods for scaling quantum generative modeling to high-resolution diverse images without relying on dimensionality reduction tricks, building on recent classical image loading techniques for quantum computers.

entry.title: Multimodal Adaptive Retrieval Augmented Generation through Internal Representation Learning

author.name: Ruoshuang Du, Xin Sun, Qiang Liu, Bowen Song, Zhongqi Chen, Weiqiang Wang, Liang Wang

entry.summary: MMA-RAG dynamically decides whether to use retrieved external information for Visual Question Answering by assessing model confidence in its internal knowledge. Addresses the problem of irrelevant or conflicting retrieved content in visual RAG settings.

entry.title: Non-Rectangular Average-Reward Robust MDPs: Non-Rectangular Average-Reward Robust MDPs:Optimal Policies and Their Transient Values

author.name: Shengbo wang, Nian Si

entry.summary: Studies non-rectangular robust MDPs under average-reward criterion, showing that the robust value admits a minimax representation without requiring rectangularity assumptions or robust dynamic programming.

entry.title: Reasoning Boosts Opinion Alignment in LLMs

author.name: Fr\'ed\'eric Berdoz, Yann Billeter, Yann Vonlanthen, Roger Wattenhofer

entry.summary: Studies whether reasoning (via RL-trained models) improves LLM alignment with individual political opinions, finding that reasoning boosts opinion modeling accuracy over naive prompting.

entry.title: Reconstructing Content via Collaborative Attention to Improve Multimodal Embedding Quality

author.name: Jiahan Chen, Da Li, Hengran Zhang, Yinqiong Cai, Lixin Su, Jiafeng Guo, Daiting Shi, Dawei Yin, Keping Bi

entry.summary: CoCoA proposes a content reconstruction pre-training paradigm with collaborative attention to improve multimodal embedding quality, addressing limitations of causal attention for forming compact representations.

entry.title: Deep Learning for Financial Time Series: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Risk-Adjusted Performance

author.name: Adir Saly-Kaufmann, Kieran Wood, Jan Peter-Calliess, Stefan Zohren

entry.summary: Large-scale benchmark of deep learning architectures for financial time series prediction with focus on Sharpe ratio optimization, evaluating linear models, RNNs, transformers, state-space models across futures data spanning 2010-2025.

entry.title: Policy Compliance of User Requests in Natural Language for AI Systems

author.name: Pedro Cisneros-Velarde

entry.summary: Proposes the first benchmark for evaluating whether user requests to AI systems comply with organizational policies, with annotated data related to industrial technology applications.

entry.title: The Aftermath of DrawEduMath: Vision Language Models Underperform with Struggling Students and Misdiagnose Errors

author.name: Li Lucy, Albert Zhang, Nathan Anderson, Ryan Knight, Kyle Lo

entry.summary: Provides year-long evaluation of 11 VLMs on DrawEduMath benchmark involving real student handwritten math responses, finding all models underperform on student errors and struggle most with pedagogically important error assessment.

entry.title: Efficient Extractive Summarization with MAMBA-Transformer Hybrids for Low-Resource Scenarios

author.name: Nisrine Ait Khayi

entry.summary: Introduces the first Mamba-Transformer hybrid for extractive summarization, combining transformer sentence-level semantics with Mamba's linear-time processing to handle full documents without truncation.

entry.title: Catalyst-Agent: Autonomous heterogeneous catalyst screening and optimization with an LLM Agent

author.name: Achuth Chandrasekhar, Janghoon Ock, Amir Barati Farimani

entry.summary: Introduces Catalyst-Agent, an MCP server-based LLM agent for autonomous catalyst screening that integrates material databases (OPTIMADE API), graph neural network predictions, and DFT simulations.

entry.title: Anatomy of the Modality Gap: Dissecting the Internal States of End-to-End Speech LLMs

author.name: Ming-Hao Hsu, Xueyao Zhang, Xiaohai Tian, Jun Zhang, Zhizheng Wu

entry.summary: Analyzes the modality gap between speech and text in speech-language models, finding speech representations show broad cross-layer alignment bands due to redundancy, and identifying layer-specific processing differences.

entry.title: RTLocating: Intent-aware RTL Localization for Hardware Design Iteration

author.name: Changwen Xing, Yanfeng Lu, Lei Qi, Chenxu Niu, Jie Li, Xi Wang, Yong Chen, Jun Yang

entry.summary: Formalizes ΔSpec-to-RTL localization for hardware design iteration—mapping natural language change requests to affected RTL code blocks—with an intent-aware framework using dynamic fusion of textual, structural, and dependency encoders.

entry.title: Seeking Necessary and Sufficient Information from Multimodal Medical Data

author.name: Boyu Chen, Weiye Bao, Junjie Liu, Michael Shen, Bo Peng, Paul Taylor, Zhu Li, Mengyue Yang

entry.summary: Proposes learning necessary and sufficient features in multimodal medical representations using Probability of Necessity and Sufficiency (PNS) as a learning objective, improving robustness to missing modalities.

entry.title: SSR: Pushing the Limit of Spatial Intelligence with Structured Scene Reasoning

author.name: Yi Zhang, Youya Xia, Yong Wang, Meng Song, Xin Wu, Wenjun Wan, Bingbing Liu, AiXue Ye, Hongbo Zhang, Feng Wen

entry.summary: Introduces SSR for structured scene reasoning in MLLMs, integrating 2D and 3D representations via lightweight alignment without large-scale pre-training. Addresses the lack of spatial reasoning in current MLLMs.

entry.title: Vision-TTT: Efficient and Expressive Visual Representation Learning with Test-Time Training

author.name: Quan Kong, Yanru Xiao, Yuhao Shen, Cong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Vision-TTT, applying Test-Time Training as a linear-time sequence modeling method for vision, compressing visual tokens via self-supervised learning with bidirectional scan and Conv2d module.

entry.title: Mesh-Pro: Asynchronous Advantage-guided Ranking Preference Optimization for Artist-style Quadrilateral Mesh Generation

author.name: Zhen Zhou, Jian Liu, Biwen Lei, Jing Xu, Haohan Weng, Yiling Zhu, Zhuo Chen, Junfeng Fan, Yunkai Ma, Dazhao Du, Song Guo, Fengshui Jing, Chunchao Guo

entry.title: UNICBench: UNIfied Counting Benchmark for MLLM

author.name: Chenggang Rong, Tao Han, Zhiyuan Zhao, Yaowu Fan, Jia Wan, Song Guo, Yuan Yuan, Junyu Gao

entry.summary: Presents UNICBench, a unified multimodal counting benchmark spanning images, documents, and audio with 5,300+ images and evaluations of 45 state-of-the-art MLLMs revealing significant counting limitations.

entry.title: Position: Evaluation of Visual Processing Should Be Human-Centered, Not Metric-Centered

author.name: Jinfan Hu, Fanghua Yu, Zhiyuan You, Xiang Yin, Hongyu An, Xinqi Lin, Chao Dong, Jinjin Gu

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that visual processing evaluation should shift from single-metric IQA benchmarks toward human-centered, context-aware assessment, especially for generative methods.

entry.title: Decoupling Motion and Geometry in 4D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yi Zhang, Yulei Kang, Jian-Fang Hu

entry.title: Event-Anchored Frame Selection for Effective Long-Video Understanding

author.name: Wang Chen, Yongdong Luo, Yuhui Zeng, Luojun Lin, Tianyu Xie, Fei Chao, Rongrong Ji, Xiawu Zheng

entry.summary: EFS introduces hierarchical, event-aware frame selection for long-video understanding with LVLMs, using DINO embeddings to partition videos into semantic events and select query-relevant anchor frames.

entry.title: GroundedSurg: A Multi-Procedure Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Surgical Tool Segmentation

author.name: Tajamul Ashraf, Abrar Ul Riyaz, Wasif Tak, Tavaheed Tariq, Sonia Yadav, Moloud Abdar, Janibul Bashir

entry.summary: GroundedSurg introduces the first language-conditioned, instance-level surgical grounding benchmark where each instrument instance is paired with a natural-language referring expression about its functional role or spatial relation.

entry.title: UniTalking: A Unified Audio-Video Framework for Talking Portrait Generation

author.name: Hebeizi Li, Zihao Liang, Benyuan Sun, Zihao Yin, Xiao Sha, Chenliang Wang, Yi Yang

entry.summary: UniTalking is a unified end-to-end diffusion framework for generating lip-synchronized video with speech, using Multi-Modal Transformer Blocks for fine-grained audio-video temporal correspondence. Explicitly references Veo3 and Sora2.

entry.title: Radiometrically Consistent Gaussian Surfels for Inverse Rendering

author.name: Kyu Beom Han, Jaeyoon Kim, Woo Jae Kim, Jinhwan Seo, Sung-eui Yoon

entry.title: Better Matching, Less Forgetting: A Quality-Guided Matcher for Transformer-based Incremental Object Detection

author.name: Qirui Wu, Shizhou Zhang, De Cheng, Yinghui Xing, Lingyan Ran, Dahu Shi, Peng Wang

entry.summary: Identifies 'background foregrounding' as a novel source of catastrophic forgetting in DETR-like incremental object detectors, caused by Hungarian matcher forcing assignment of background predictions to ground truth.

entry.title: PathMoE: Interpretable Multimodal Interaction Experts for Pediatric Brain Tumor Classification

author.name: Jian Yu, Joakim Nguyen, Jinrui Fang, Awais Naeem, Zeyuan Cao, Sanjay Krishnan, Nicholas Konz, Tianlong Chen, Chandra Krishnan, Hairong Wang, Edward Castillo, Ying Ding, Ankita Shukla

entry.title: Dehallu3D: Hallucination-Mitigated 3D Generation from Single Image via Cyclic View Consistency Refinement

author.name: Xiwen Wang, Shichao Zhang, Hailun Zhang, Ruowei Wang, Mao Li, Chenyu Zhou, Qijun Zhao, Ji-Zhe Zhou

entry.summary: Dehallu3D addresses hallucinations in large 3D reconstruction models (structural outliers like holes or protrusions) through cyclic view consistency refinement to mitigate artifacts from sparse multi-view generation.

entry.title: Learning Domain-Aware Task Prompt Representations for Multi-Domain All-in-One Image Restoration

author.name: Guanglu Dong, Chunlei Li, Chao Ren, Jingliang Hu, Yilei Shi, Xiao Xiang Zhu, Lichao Mou

entry.summary: DATPRL-IR proposes the first multi-domain all-in-one image restoration method that handles natural, medical, and remote sensing domains simultaneously through domain-aware task prompt representation learning.

entry.title: Efficient Test-Time Optimization for Depth Completion via Low-Rank Decoder Adaptation

author.name: Minseok Seo, Wonjun Lee, Jaehyuk Jang, Changick Kim

entry.title: MMNavAgent: Multi-Magnification WSI Navigation Agent for Clinically Consistent Whole-Slide Analysis

author.name: Zhengyang Xu, Han Li, Jingsong Liu, Linrui Xie, Xun Ma, Xin You, Shihui Zu, Ayako Ito, Xinyu Hao, Hongming Xu, Shaohua Kevin Zhou, Nassir Navab, Peter J. Sch\"uffler

entry.title: Certifiable Estimation with Factor Graphs

author.name: Zhexin Xu, Nikolas R. Sanderson, Hanna Jiamei Zhang, David M. Rosen

entry.summary: Proposes a general framework for certifiable estimation using factor graphs that can verify global optimality of solutions, important for safety-critical robotic applications.

entry.title: Rethinking Camera Choice: An Empirical Study on Fisheye Camera Properties in Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Han Xue, Nan Min, Xiaotong Liu, Wendi Chen, Yuan Fang, Jun Lv, Cewu Lu, Chuan Wen

entry.summary: First comprehensive empirical study on fisheye camera properties in robotic manipulation, analyzing spatial localization, scene generalization, and hardware generalization effects on imitation learning.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation via 3D Gaussian Splatting-Enhanced Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zilong Xie, Jingyu Gong, Xin Tan, Zhizhong Zhang, Yuan Xie

entry.title: TacMamba: A Tactile History Compression Adapter Bridging Fast Reflexes and Slow VLA Reasoning

entry.title: LifeEval: A Multimodal Benchmark for Assistive AI in Egocentric Daily Life Tasks

author.name: Hengjian Gao, Kaiwei Zhang, Shibo Wang, Mingjie Chen, Qihang Cao, Xianfeng Wang, Yucheng Zhu, Xiongkuo Min, Wei Sun, Dandan Zhu, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Introduces LifeEval, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating real-time assistive AI in egocentric daily life tasks, emphasizing task-oriented reasoning, proactive assistance, and contextual adaptation from first-person video.

entry.title: GAM-RAG: Gain-Adaptive Memory for Evolving Retrieval in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Yifan Wang, Mingxuan Jiang, Zhihao Sun, Yixin Cao, Yicun Liu, Keyang Chen, Guangnan Ye, Hongfeng Chai

entry.title: LLMs as Strategic Actors: Behavioral Alignment, Risk Calibration, and Argumentation Framing in Geopolitical Simulations

author.name: Veronika Solopova, Viktoria Skorik, Maksym Tereshchenko, Alina Haidun, Ostap Vykhopen

entry.summary: Evaluates six LLMs as strategic actors in geopolitical crisis simulations, comparing their action alignment, risk calibration, and argumentative framing to human participants across multiple rounds.

entry.title: Adaptive Confidence Regularization for Multimodal Failure Detection

author.name: Moru Liu, Hao Dong, Olga Fink, Mario Trapp

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Confidence Regularization (ACR) for detecting multimodal failures, addressing 'confidence degradation' where multimodal prediction confidence drops below unimodal branch confidence.

entry.title: CoPeP: Benchmarking Continual Pretraining for Protein Language Models

author.name: Darshan Patil, Pranshu Malviya, Mathieu Reymond, Quentin Fournier, Sarath Chandar

entry.summary: Introduces CoPeP, a benchmark for evaluating continual pretraining of protein language models on temporally-evolving protein databases, enabling evaluation of how well models adapt to growing biological data over time.

entry.title: Learning Under Extreme Data Scarcity: Subject-Level Evaluation of Lightweight CNNs for fMRI-Based Prodromal Parkinsons Detection

author.name: Naimur Rahman

entry.title: Individual Turing Test: A Case Study of LLM-based Simulation Using Longitudinal Personal Data

author.name: Minghao Guo, Ziyi Ye, Wujiang Xu, Xi Zhu, Wenyue Hua, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.title: Fake It Right: Injecting Anatomical Logic into Synthetic Supervised Pre-training for Medical Segmentation

author.name: Jiaqi Tang, Mengyan Zheng, Shu Zhang, Fandong Zhang, Qingchao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes anatomy-informed synthetic supervised pre-training for medical segmentation that bridges the gap between formula-driven synthetic data and real anatomical structures, enabling privacy-preserving training without real patient data.

entry.title: Token Reduction via Local and Global Contexts Optimization for Efficient Video Large Language Models

author.name: Jinlong Li, Liyuan Jiang, Haonan Zhang, Nicu Sebe

entry.title: WildCross: A Cross-Modal Large Scale Benchmark for Place Recognition and Metric Depth Estimation in Natural Environments

author.name: Joshua Knights, Joseph Reid, Kaushik Roy, David Hall, Mark Cox, Peyman Moghadam

entry.summary: WildCross provides a cross-modal benchmark for place recognition and depth estimation in natural environments with 476K RGB frames, semi-dense depth, surface normals, and 6DoF poses.

entry.title: OMG-Avatar: One-shot Multi-LOD Gaussian Head Avatar

author.name: Jianqiang Ren, Lin Liu, Steven Hoi

entry.title: Unifying Heterogeneous Multi-Modal Remote Sensing Detection Via Language-Pivoted Pretraining

author.name: Yuxuan Li, Yuming Chen, Yunheng Li, Ming-Ming Cheng, Xiang Li, Jian Yang

entry.summary: BabelRS proposes a language-pivoted pretraining framework for heterogeneous multi-modal remote sensing detection that decouples modality alignment from downstream task learning across RGB, SAR, and Infrared.

entry.title: Resolving Blind Inverse Problems under Dynamic Range Compression via Structured Forward Operator Modeling

entry.title: SimRecon: SimReady Compositional Scene Reconstruction from Real Videos

author.name: Chong Xia, Kai Zhu, Zizhuo Wang, Fangfu Liu, Zhizheng Zhang, Yueqi Duan

entry.summary: SimRecon implements a Perception-Generation-Simulation pipeline for compositional scene reconstruction from real videos, creating simulation-ready object-centric representations.

entry.title: 3D Field of Junctions: A Noise-Robust, Training-Free Structural Prior for Volumetric Inverse Problems

author.name: Namhoon Kim, Narges Moeini, Justin Romberg, Sara Fridovich-Keil

entry.summary: 3D Field of Junctions extends the 2D FoJ representation to 3D for volume denoising and as a training-free structural prior that preserves sharp edges and corners, requiring no training data.

entry.title: Tiny-DroNeRF: Tiny Neural Radiance Fields aboard Federated Learning-enabled Nano-drones

author.name: Ilenia Carboni, Elia Cereda, Lorenzo Lamberti, Daniele Malpetti, Francesco Conti, Daniele Palossi

entry.summary: Tiny-DroNeRF enables NeRF-based 3D scene reconstruction on sub-30g nano-drones with sub-100mW MCUs using federated learning, dramatically reducing memory and compute requirements.

entry.title: DeepXiv-SDK: An Agentic Data Interface for Scientific Papers

author.name: Hongjin Qian, Ziyi Xia, Ze Liu, Jianlv Chen, Kun Luo, Minghao Qin, Chaofan Li, Lei Xiong, Sen Wang, Zhengyang Liang, Zheng Liu

entry.summary: Introduces DeepXiv-SDK, an agentic data interface for scientific papers that provides progressive, budget-aware access with structured views (header-first, section-structured) enabling efficient paper screening and targeted navigation by research agents.

entry.title: Graph-theoretic Agreement Framework for Multi-agent LLM Systems

author.name: Muhammad Umar Javed

entry.summary: Establishes a graph-theoretic framework for analyzing consensus in multi-agent LLM systems with signed, directed interaction networks, bridging graph theory with observability analysis for securing distributed LLM architectures.

entry.title: Let Your Image Move with Your Motion! -- Implicit Multi-Object Multi-Motion Transfer

author.name: Yuze Li, Dong Gong, Xiao Cao, Junchao Yuan, Dongsheng Li, Lei Zhou, Yun Sing Koh, Cheng Yan, Xinyu Zhang

entry.summary: FlexiMMT is the first implicit image-to-video motion transfer framework supporting multi-object, multi-motion transfer. Introduces Motion Decoupled Mask Attention to handle cross-object motion entanglement.

entry.title: StepVAR: Structure-Texture Guided Pruning for Visual Autoregressive Models

author.name: Keli Liu, Zhendong Wang, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li

entry.title: EmCoop: A Framework and Benchmark for Embodied Cooperation Among LLM Agents

author.name: Hanqing Yang, Shiyu Chen, Narjes Nourzad, Marie Siew, Jingdi Chen, Carlee Joe-Wong

entry.summary: Introduces EmCoop, a benchmark for studying cooperation in LLM-based embodied multi-agent systems, separating cognitive from embodied layers to enable fine-grained analysis of how collaboration emerges and contributes to task success.

entry.title: Advancing Multimodal Judge Models through a Capability-Oriented Benchmark and MCTS-Driven Data Generation

author.name: Zeyu Chen, Huanjin Yao, Ziwang Zhao, Min Yang

entry.summary: Introduces M-JudgeBench, a capability-oriented benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs as judges, with MCTS-driven data generation. Decomposes judgment into pairwise CoT comparison, length bias avoidance, and process error detection.

entry.title: Heterophily-Agnostic Hypergraph Neural Networks with Riemannian Local Exchanger

author.name: Li Sun, Ming Zhang, Wenxin Jin, Zhongtian Sun, Zhenhao Huang, Hao Peng, Sen Su, Philip Yu

entry.summary: Proposes heterophily-agnostic hypergraph neural networks using Riemannian geometry, connecting oversquashing with hypergraph bottleneck through Riemannian manifold heat flow framework.

entry.title: MO-MIX: Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Cooperative Decision-Making With Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Tianmeng Hu, Biao Luo, Chunhua Yang, Tingwen Huang

entry.summary: Proposes MO-MIX for multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning using CTDE framework, addressing the intersection of multi-objective and multi-agent decision-making which has been underexplored.

entry.title: HarmonyCell: Automating Single-Cell Perturbation Modeling under Semantic and Distribution Shifts

author.name: Wenxuan Huang, Mingyu Tsoi, Yanhao Huang, Xinjie Mao, Xue Xia, Hao Wu, Jiaqi Wei, Yuejin Yang, Lang Yu, Cheng Tan, Xiang Zhang, Zhangyang Gao, Siqi Sun

entry.summary: Proposes HarmonyCell for single-cell perturbation modeling, using LLM-driven semantic unification for metadata harmonization and MCTS-based architecture search to handle distribution shifts across datasets.

entry.title: Harmonizing Dense and Sparse Signals in Multi-turn RL: Dual-Horizon Credit Assignment for Industrial Sales Agents

author.name: Haojin Yang, Ai Jian, Xinyue Huang, Yiwei Wang, Weipeng Zhang, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai, Jingqing Ruan

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Horizon Credit Assignment (DuCA) for training LLM sales agents, separately normalizing advantages from turn-level (fluency, compliance) and session-level (conversion) rewards to prevent reward scale mismatch.

entry.title: LLM-assisted Semantic Option Discovery for Facilitating Adaptive Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chang Yao, Jinghui Qin, Kebing Jin, Hankz Hankui Zhuo

entry.summary: Introduces LLM-driven closed-loop framework combining semantic option discovery with symbolic planning for DRL, enabling skill reuse and real-time constraint monitoring via natural language.

entry.title: Pharmacology Knowledge Graphs: Do We Need Chemical Structure for Drug Repurposing?

author.name: Youssef Abo-Dahab, Ruby Hernandez, Ismael Caleb Arechiga Duran

entry.summary: Benchmarks knowledge graph embedding models for drug repurposing with strict temporal validation (train ≤2022, test 2023-2025), finding that adding chemical structure features provides marginal improvement over topology-only approaches.

entry.title: ToolRLA: Fine-Grained Reward Decomposition for Tool-Integrated Reinforcement Learning Alignment in Domain-Specific Agents

author.name: Pengbo Liu

entry.summary: Presents ToolRLA, a three-stage post-training pipeline for domain-specific tool-integrated agents using fine-grained reward decomposition across four dimensions (format, tool selection, parameter accuracy, output validity) instead of binary success/failure signals.

entry.title: ActMem: Bridging the Gap Between Memory Retrieval and Reasoning in LLM Agents

author.name: Xiaohui Zhang, Zequn Sun, Chengyuan Yang, Yaqin Jin, Yazhong Zhang, Wei Hu

entry.summary: Proposes ActMem, an actionable memory framework for LLM agents that integrates memory retrieval with active causal reasoning using counterfactual reasoning and commonsense completion on a structured causal-semantic graph.

entry.title: Autorubric: A Unified Framework for Rubric-Based LLM Evaluation

author.name: Delip Rao, Chris Callison-Burch

entry.summary: Presents Autorubric, a unified open-source framework for rubric-based LLM evaluation supporting multiple criteria types, judge ensembles, calibration, and bias mitigations in a single package.

entry.title: Evaluating Theory of Mind and Internal Beliefs in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Adam Kostka, Jaros{\l}aw A. Chudziak

entry.summary: Evaluates Theory of Mind and Belief-Desire-Intention models in LLM-based multi-agent systems, finding that simply adding cognitive mechanisms doesn't automatically improve coordination. Highlights the gap between theoretical cognitive models and practical MAS performance.

entry.title: M-Gaussian: An Magnetic Gaussian Framework for Efficient Multi-Stack MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Kangyuan Zheng, Xuan Cai, Jiangqi Wang, Guixing Fu, Zhuoshuo Li, Yazhou Chen, Xinting Ge, Liangqiong Qu, Mengting Liu

entry.summary: M-Gaussian adapts 3D Gaussian Splatting to MRI reconstruction for multi-stack thick-slice acquisitions, introducing magnetic Gaussian primitives for efficient isotropic volume reconstruction.

entry.title: FlowPortrait: Reinforcement Learning for Audio-Driven Portrait Video Generation

author.name: Weiting Tan, Andy T. Liu, Ming Tu, Xinghua Qu, Philipp Koehn, Lu Lu

entry.summary: FlowPortrait uses reinforcement learning with MLLM-based evaluation for audio-driven talking head generation, using GRPO for post-training with human-aligned composite rewards for lip-sync, expressiveness, and motion quality.

entry.title: Efficient Flow Matching for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction

author.name: Jiayang Shi, Lincen Yang, Zhong Li, Tristan Van Leeuwen, Daniel M. Pelt, K. Joost Batenburg

entry.summary: Applies flow matching models instead of diffusion models for sparse-view CT reconstruction, leveraging deterministic ODE trajectories that avoid interference with data consistency corrections, improving efficiency.

entry.title: Acoustic Sensing for Universal Jamming Grippers

author.name: Lion Weber, Theodor Wienert, Martin Splettst\"o{\ss}er, Alexander Koenig, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Presents acoustic sensing for soft jamming grippers where sound propagation through the gripper body encodes object properties, achieving 2.6mm size accuracy and 0.6 degree orientation accuracy while preserving gripper compliance.

entry.title: USE: Uncertainty Structure Estimation for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning

author.name: Tsao-Lun Chen, Chien-Liang Liu, Tzu-Ming Harry Hsu, Tai-Hsien Wu, Chi-Cheng Fu, Han-Yi E. Chou, Shun-Feng Su

entry.summary: USE proposes Uncertainty Structure Estimation for semi-supervised learning that focuses on unlabeled data quality assessment, arguing the bottleneck is data curation rather than algorithmic design.

entry.title: Exact and Asymptotically Complete Robust Verifications of Neural Networks via Quantum Optimization

author.name: Wenxin Li, Wenchao Liu, Chuan Wang, Qi Gao, Yin Ma, Hai Wei, Kai Wen

entry.summary: Proposes quantum optimization-based models for robust neural network verification: exact formulation for piecewise-linear activations and asymptotically complete over-approximations for general activations.

entry.title: An Interpretable Local Editing Model for Counterfactual Medical Image Generation

author.name: Hyungi Min, Taeseung You, Hangyeul Lee, Yeongjae Cho, Sungzoon Cho

entry.summary: InstructX2X is an interpretable local editing model for counterfactual medical image generation that restricts modifications to specific regions, preventing unintended changes to demographic attributes.

entry.title: Taxonomy-Aware Representation Alignment for Hierarchical Visual Recognition with Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Hulingxiao He, Zhi Tan, Yuxin Peng

entry.summary: TARA injects taxonomic knowledge into Large Multimodal Models for hierarchical visual recognition by aligning representations with biology foundation models, enabling consistent predictions from coarse to fine categories.

entry.title: DeepAFL: Deep Analytic Federated Learning

author.name: Jianheng Tang, Yajiang Huang, Kejia Fan, Feijiang Han, Jiaxu Li, Jinfeng Xu, Run He, Anfeng Liu, Houbing Herbert Song, Huiping Zhuang, Yunhuai Liu

entry.summary: DeepAFL enables deep analytic (closed-form) federated learning that goes beyond single-layer linear models by introducing representation learning capabilities, addressing limitations of gradient-free FL approaches.

entry.title: Seeing Beyond 8bits: Subjective and Objective Quality Assessment of HDR-UGC Videos

author.name: Shreshth Saini, Bowen Chen, Neil Birkbeck, Yilin Wang, Balu Adsumilli, Alan C. Bovik

entry.summary: Beyond8Bits curates a large-scale HDR video quality assessment dataset (44K videos, 1.5M ratings) and introduces HDR-Q, the first MLLM for HDR-UGC video quality assessment.

entry.title: AWE: Adaptive Agents for Dynamic Web Penetration Testing

author.name: Akshat Singh Jaswal, Ashish Baghel

entry.summary: AWE is a memory-augmented multi-agent framework for autonomous web penetration testing that embeds vulnerability-specific analysis pipelines within LLM orchestration for structured, reproducible security testing.

entry.title: An Open-Source Modular Benchmark for Diffusion-Based Motion Planning in Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yun Li, Simon Thompson, Yidu Zhang, Ehsan Javanmardi, Manabu Tsukada

entry.summary: Open-source modular benchmark for diffusion-based motion planners integrated into ROS 2/Autoware autonomous driving stack, decomposing monolithic models into independently executable modules with C++ reimplementation.

entry.title: Egocentric Co-Pilot: Web-Native Smart-Glasses Agents for Assistive Egocentric AI

author.name: Sicheng Yang, Yukai Huang, Weitong Cai, Shitong Sun, Fengyi Fang, You He, Yiqiao Xie, Jiankang Deng, Hang Zhang, Jifei Song, Zhensong Zhang

entry.summary: Egocentric Co-Pilot is a web-native neuro-symbolic framework for smart glasses that uses an LLM to orchestrate perception, reasoning, and web tools. It introduces Temporal Chain-of-Thought with Hierarchical Context Compression for long-horizon first-person video understanding.

entry.title: ATLAS: AI-Assisted Threat-to-Assertion Learning for System-on-Chip Security Verification

author.name: Ishraq Tashdid, Kimia Tasnia, Alexander Garcia, Jonathan Valamehr, Sazadur Rahman

entry.summary: ATLAS uses LLMs to bridge threat modeling and formal verification for SoC security, automatically generating assertion-based security properties from vulnerability databases. Detected 39/48 CWEs on HACK@DAC benchmarks.

entry.title: Scaling of learning time for high dimensional inputs

author.name: Carlos Stein Brito

entry.summary: Theoretical analysis of how learning time scales with input dimensionality in Hebbian learning models performing independent component analysis. Shows learning time grows only linearly with input dimension for specific models.

entry.title: The MAMA-MIA Challenge: Advancing Generalizability and Fairness in Breast MRI Tumor Segmentation and Treatment Response Prediction

author.name: Lidia Garrucho, Smriti Joshi, Kaisar Kushibar, Richard Osuala, Maciej Bobowicz, Xavier Bargall\'o, Paulius Jaru\v{s}evi\v{c}ius, Kai Geissler, Raphael Sch\"afer, Muhammad Alberb, Tony Xu, Anne Martel, Daniel Sleiman, Navchetan Awasthi, Hadeel Awwad, Joan C. Vilanova, Robert Mart\'i, Daan Schouten, Jeong Hoon Lee, Mirabela Rusu, Eleonora Poeta, Luisa Vargas, Eliana Pastor, Maria A. Zuluaga, Jessica K\"achele, Dimitrios Bounias, Alexandra Ertl, Katarzyna Gwo\'zdziewicz, Maria-Laura Cosaka, Pasant M. Abo-Elhoda, Sara W. Tantawy, Shorouq S. Sakrana, Norhan O. Shawky-Abdelfatah, Amr Muhammad Abdo-Salem, Androniki Kozana, Eugen Divjak, Gordana Ivanac, Katerina Nikiforaki, Michail E. Klontzas, Rosa Garc\'ia-Dosd\'a, Meltem Gulsun-Akpinar, O\u{g}uz Lafc{\i}, Carlos Mart\'in-Isla, Oliver D\'iaz, Laura Igual, Karim Lekadir

entry.summary: The MAMA-MIA Challenge provides a large-scale benchmark for breast MRI tumor segmentation and treatment response prediction, evaluating generalizability and fairness across demographic subgroups.

entry.title: UTICA: Multi-Objective Self-Distllation Foundation Model Pretraining for Time Series Classification

author.name: Yessin Moakher, Youssef Attia El Hili, Vasilii Feofanov

entry.summary: UTICA adapts DINOv2-style self-distillation for time series foundation model pretraining, achieving state-of-the-art classification on UCR and UEA benchmarks.

entry.title: Toward Graph-Tokenizing Large Language Models with Reconstructive Graph Instruction Tuning

author.name: Zhongjian Zhang, Xiao Wang, Mengmei Zhang, Jiarui Tan, Chuan Shi

entry.summary: Proposes reconstructive graph instruction tuning for graph-tokenizing LLMs, using information-theoretic analysis to show that existing methods only achieve implicit graph alignment through text supervision alone.

entry.title: ATA: Bridging Implicit Reasoning with Attention-Guided and Action-Guided Inference for Vision-Language Action Models

author.name: Cheng Yang, Jianhao Jiao, Lingyi Huang, Jinqi Xiao, Zhexiang Tang, Yu Gong, Yibiao Ying, Yang Sui, Jintian Lin, Wen Huang, Bo Yuan

entry.summary: ATA bridges implicit reasoning with attention-guided and action-guided inference for VLA models, avoiding the need for expensive CoT annotations or visual grounding annotations.

entry.title: A Practical Guide to Streaming Continual Learning

author.name: Andrea Cossu, Federico Giannini, Giacomo Ziffer, Alessio Bernardo, Alexander Gepperth, Emanuele Della Valle, Barbara Hammer, Davide Bacciu

entry.summary: Provides a practical guide to Streaming Continual Learning (SCL), bridging continual learning and streaming machine learning communities. Discusses how SCL can address real-world problems requiring both adaptation and knowledge retention.

entry.title: QIME: Constructing Interpretable Medical Text Embeddings via Ontology-Grounded Questions

author.name: Yixuan Tang, Zhenghong Lin, Yandong Sun, Anthony K. H. Tung

entry.summary: QIME constructs interpretable medical text embeddings where each dimension corresponds to a clinically meaningful yes/no question, grounded in medical ontologies.

entry.title: Phase-Type Variational Autoencoders for Heavy-Tailed Data

author.name: Abdelhakim Ziani, Andr\'as Horv\'ath, Paolo Ballarini

entry.summary: Proposes PH-VAE, a Variational Autoencoder using Phase-Type distributions as decoder, defined via continuous-time Markov chain absorption times, enabling flexible heavy-tailed data modeling.

entry.title: Explanation-Guided Adversarial Training for Robust and Interpretable Models

author.name: Chao Chen, Yanhui Chen, Shanshan Lin, Dongsheng Hong, Shu Wu, Xiangwen Liao, Chuanyi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Explanation-Guided Adversarial Training (EGAT), unifying adversarial training with explanation-guided learning to improve both robustness and interpretability of deep neural networks simultaneously.

entry.title: Revealing Combinatorial Reasoning of GNNs via Graph Concept Bottleneck Layer

author.name: Yue Niu, Zhaokai Sun, Jiayi Yang, Xiaofeng Cao, Rui Fan, Xin Sun, Hanli Wang, Wei Ye

entry.summary: Develops a Graph Concept Bottleneck Layer for GNNs that reveals combinatorial reasoning through interpretable graph concepts, quantifying concept contributions to predictions rather than just identifying hard logical rules.

entry.title: GenDB: The Next Generation of Query Processing -- Synthesized, Not Engineered

author.name: Jiale Lao, Immanuel Trummer

entry.summary: Proposes GenDB, which uses LLMs to synthesize execution code for each incoming database query instead of using traditional query processing engines, arguing this represents the next generation of query processing.

entry.title: Kiwi-Edit: Versatile Video Editing via Instruction and Reference Guidance

author.name: Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Ziyun Zeng, Zechen Bai, Yanzhe Chen, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Introduces Kiwi-Edit for video editing that combines instruction and reference guidance, with a scalable data generation pipeline that creates training quadruplets from existing pairs, and a new benchmark RefVIE-Bench.

entry.title: Physics-Aware Learnability: From Set-Theoretic Independence to Operational Constraints

author.name: Jeongho Bang, Kyoungho Cho

entry.summary: Introduces physics-aware learnability (PL) that resolves paradoxes in learning theory (like EMX learnability depending on ZFC axioms) by conditioning on explicit physical access models with finite precision constraints.

entry.title: Unlearning Evaluation through Subset Statistical Independence

author.name: Chenhao Zhang, Muxing Li, Feng Liu, Weitong Chen, Miao Xu
