entry.summary: DFA presents a dual-stream deepfake detection framework combining CLIP with forensics-specific adapters, including global feature adaptation, frequency analysis, and multi-scale residual learning.

entry.title: SCATR: Mitigating New Instance Suppression in LiDAR-based Tracking-by-Attention via Second Chance Assignment and Track Query Dropout

author.name: Brian Cheong, Letian Wang, Sandro Papais, Steven L. Waslander

entry.summary: SCATR addresses new instance suppression in LiDAR tracking-by-attention via Second Chance Assignment and Track Query Dropout, two architecture-agnostic training strategies.

entry.title: Cryo-Bench: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Cryosphere Applications

author.name: Saurabh Kaushik, Lalit Maurya, Beth Tellman

entry.summary: Cryo-Bench is a new benchmark for evaluating geo-foundation models on cryosphere applications including glaciers, glacial lakes, sea ice, and calving fronts. Evaluates 14 GFMs across multiple sensors and regions.

entry.title: Coarse-to-Fine Monocular Re-Localization in OpenStreetMap via Semantic Alignment

author.name: Yuchen Zou, Xiao Hu, Dexing Zhong, Yuqing Tang

entry.summary: Proposes a coarse-to-fine monocular re-localization framework using OpenStreetMap as a lightweight, privacy-preserving map alternative, leveraging DINO-ViT for semantic alignment.

entry.title: Preoperative-to-intraoperative Liver Registration for Laparoscopic Surgery via Latent-Grounded Correspondence Constraints

author.name: Ruize Cui, Jialun Pei, Haiqiao Wang, Jun Zhou, Jeremy Yuen-Chun Teoh, Pheng-Ann Heng, Jing Qin

entry.summary: Land-Reg introduces a correspondence-driven deformable registration framework for laparoscopic liver surgery that learns latent-grounded 2D-3D landmark correspondences for interpretable cross-modal alignment.

entry.title: Action-Guided Attention for Video Action Anticipation

author.name: Tsung-Ming Tai, Sofia Casarin, Andrea Pilzer, Werner Nutt, Oswald Lanz

entry.summary: Action-Guided Attention (AGA) proposes using predicted action sequences as queries in attention mechanisms for video action anticipation, providing high-level semantic guidance beyond pixel representations.

entry.title: ORGAN: Object-Centric Representation Learning using Cycle Consistent Generative Adversarial Networks

author.name: Jo\"el K\"uchler, Ellen van Maren, Vaiva Vasiliauskait\.e, Katarina Vuli\'c, Reza Abbasi-Asl, Stephan J. Ihle

entry.summary: ORGAN applies cycle-consistent GANs to object-centric representation learning as an alternative to autoencoder-based approaches, showing competitive performance with improved handling of textured backgrounds.

entry.title: HiFi-Inpaint: Towards High-Fidelity Reference-Based Inpainting for Generating Detail-Preserving Human-Product Images

author.name: Yichen Liu, Donghao Zhou, Jie Wang, Xin Gao, Guisheng Liu, Jiatong Li, Quanwei Zhang, Qiang Lyu, Lanqing Guo, Shilei Wen, Weiqiang Wang, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: HiFi-Inpaint proposes high-fidelity reference-based inpainting for generating human-product images with precise product detail preservation for advertising and e-commerce.

entry.title: EgoMoD: Predicting Global Maps of Dynamics from Local Egocentric Observations

author.name: Iacopo Catalano, David Morilla-Cabello, Jorge Pena-Queralta, Eduardo Montijano

entry.summary: Introduces EgoMoD, the first approach to predict environment-wide Maps of Dynamics from short egocentric video clips during robot operation. Enables anticipatory navigation planning in crowded scenes beyond the robot's perceptual range.

entry.title: Pro-HOI: Perceptive Root-guided Humanoid-Object Interaction

author.name: Yuhang Lin, Jiyuan Shi, Dewei Wang, Jipeng Kong, Yong Liu, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Introduces Pro-HOI, a framework for humanoid-object interaction that conditions policy on root trajectory and uses SDF loss for contact optimization. Demonstrates robust humanoid loco-manipulation including box carrying.

entry.title: riMESA: Consensus ADMM for Real-World Collaborative SLAM

author.name: Daniel McGann, Michael Kaess

entry.summary: Proposes riMESA, a robust incremental distributed SLAM backend using consensus ADMM that handles outliers, limited communication, and online operation for multi-robot teams.

entry.title: ROSER: Few-Shot Robotic Sequence Retrieval for Scalable Robot Learning

author.name: Zillur Rahman, Eddison Pham, Alejandro Daniel Noel, Cristian Meo

entry.summary: Introduces ROSER, a few-shot robotic sequence retrieval framework that extracts task-centric segments from unlabeled interaction logs using learned metric spaces over temporal windows, requiring as few as a single reference.

entry.title: CHOP: Counterfactual Human Preference Labels Improve Obstacle Avoidance in Visuomotor Navigation Policies

author.name: Gershom Seneviratne, Jianyu An, Vaibhav Shende, Sahire Ellahy, Yaxita Amin, Kondapi Manasanjani, Samarth Chopra, Jonathan Deepak Kannan, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: Introduces CHOP, using counterfactual human preference labels where annotators compare alternative trajectories the robot could have followed, aligning visuomotor navigation policies with human safety intuition.

entry.title: RoboGPU: Accelerating GPU Collision Detection for Robotics

author.name: Lufei Liu, Liwei Xue, Youssef Mohammed, Jocelyn Zhao, Yuan Hsi Chou, Tor M. Aamodt

entry.summary: Proposes RoboGPU, enhancing GPU ray tracing accelerator units for robotics collision detection, showing GPUs can efficiently handle collision detection with hardware modifications.

entry.title: Confusion-Aware Rubric Optimization for LLM-based Automated Grading

author.name: Yucheng Chu, Hang Li, Kaiqi Yang, Yasemin Copur-Gencturk, Joseph Krajcik, Namsoo Shin, Jiliang Tang

entry.summary: Introduces CARO, a framework for optimizing LLM grading rubrics that addresses 'rule dilution' where conflicting constraints from aggregated error samples weaken grading logic. Uses confusion-aware clustering to organize errors before updating rubrics.

entry.title: EMPA: Evaluating Persona-Aligned Empathy as a Process

author.name: Shiya Zhang, Yuhan Zhan, Ruixi Su, Ruihan Sun, Ziyi Song, Zhaohan Chen, Xiaofan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces EMPA, a process-oriented framework evaluating persona-aligned empathy in LLM dialogue agents as sustained intervention trajectories rather than isolated replies, scoring in latent psychological space.

entry.title: HVR-Met: A Hypothesis-Verification-Replaning Agentic System for Extreme Weather Diagnosis

author.name: Shuo Tang, Jiadong Zhang, Jian Xu, Gengxian Zhou, Qizhao Jin, Qinxuan Wang, Yi Hu, Ning Hu, Hongchang Ren, Lingli He, Jiaolan Fu, Jingtao Ding, Shiming Xiang, Chenglin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HVR-Met, a multi-agent system for extreme weather diagnosis using hypothesis-verification-replanning cycles with expert knowledge integration and professional-grade iterative reasoning.

entry.title: The Observer-Situation Lattice: A Unified Formal Basis for Perspective-Aware Cognition

author.name: Saad Alqithami

entry.summary: Introduces Observer-Situation Lattice (OSL), a unified mathematical structure for perspective-aware cognition in multi-agent systems, providing a single semantic space for reasoning about beliefs across agents, times, and contexts.

entry.title: Benchmarking LLM Summaries of Multimodal Clinical Time Series for Remote Monitoring

author.name: Aditya Shukla, Yining Yuan, Ben Tamo, Yifei Wang, Micky Nnamdi, Shaun Tan, Jieru Li, Benoit Marteau, Brad Willingham, May Wang

entry.summary: Introduces an event-based evaluation framework for LLM-generated clinical summaries of multimodal time series data, using a dementia monitoring dataset. The framework measures whether summaries faithfully capture clinically significant events like sustained abnormalities, addressing a gap where existing metrics focus only on semantic similarity.

entry.title: Econometric vs. Causal Structure-Learning for Time-Series Policy Decisions: Evidence from the UK COVID-19 Policies

author.name: Bruno Petrungaro, Anthony C. Constantinou

entry.summary: Compares econometric and causal structure-learning methods for recovering causal structures from time series data, using UK COVID-19 policy data as a case study.

entry.title: M3-AD: Reflection-aware Multi-modal, Multi-category, and Multi-dimensional Benchmark and Framework for Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Chao Huang, Yanhui Li, Yunkang Cao, Wei Wang, Hongxi Huang, Jie Wen, Wenqi Ren, Xiaochun Cao

entry.summary: Proposes M3-AD, a reflection-aware multimodal framework for industrial anomaly detection using MLLMs, with RA-Monitor for self-correction and a benchmark covering multiple categories and dimensions.

entry.title: AdURA-Net: Adaptive Uncertainty and Region-Aware Network

author.name: Antik Aich Roy, Ujjwal Bhattacharya

entry.summary: AdURA-Net addresses uncertainty handling in clinical decision-making for multi-label chest X-ray datasets, allowing models to express uncertainty rather than forcing confident predictions.

entry.title: Personalities at Play: Probing Alignment in AI Teammates

author.name: Mohammad Amin Samadi, Nia Nixon

entry.summary: Studies AI personality alignment through self-perception, behavioral expression, and reflective expression across GPT-4o, Claude-3.7, Gemini-2.5 Pro, and Grok-3, examining Big Five personality traits in LLM teammates.

entry.title: TAP-SLF: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Vision Foundation Models for Multi-Task Ultrasound Image Analysis

author.name: Hui Wan, Libin Lan

entry.summary: TAP-SLF proposes task-aware prompting and selective layer fine-tuning for adapting vision foundation models to multiple ultrasound analysis tasks simultaneously, addressing the gap between task-agnostic adaptation and task-specific needs.

entry.title: RAISE: Requirement-Adaptive Evolutionary Refinement for Training-Free Text-to-Image Alignment

author.name: Liyao Jiang, Ruichen Chen, Chao Gao, Di Niu

entry.summary: RAISE is a training-free evolutionary framework for improving text-to-image alignment that adapts iteration budgets to prompt difficulty, avoiding the need for curated reflection datasets or fine-tuning.

entry.title: Enhancing Molecular Property Predictions by Learning from Bond Modelling and Interactions

author.name: Yunqing Liu, Yi Zhou, Wenqi Fan

entry.summary: DeMol introduces a dual-graph framework for molecular representation learning that models both atom-centric and bond-centric perspectives, addressing limitations of conventional approaches that overlook bond-level phenomena like resonance.

entry.title: AlignVAR: Towards Globally Consistent Visual Autoregression for Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Cencen Liu (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Dongyang Zhang (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Ubiquitous Intelligence and Trusted Services Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province), Wen Yin (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Jielei Wang (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Ubiquitous Intelligence and Trusted Services Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province), Tianyu Li (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Ji Guo (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Wenbo Jiang (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Guoqing Wang (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Guoming Lu (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Ubiquitous Intelligence and Trusted Services Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province)

entry.summary: AlignVAR adapts Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models for image super-resolution with spatial consistency mechanisms and multi-scale supervision to address locality bias and error accumulation across scales.

entry.title: QANTIS: A Hardware-Validated Quantum Platform for POMDP Planning and Multi-Target Data Association

author.name: Bayram Y\"uksel Eker, Suayb S. Arslan, \"Ozg\"ur Nazl{\i}, Mustafa Serhat Demirgil, Furkan Delig\"oz

entry.summary: QANTIS is a quantum computing platform for POMDP planning and multi-target data association, using quantum amplitude amplification and QUBO reformulations, validated on real quantum hardware.

entry.title: TripleSumm: Adaptive Triple-Modality Fusion for Video Summarization

author.name: Sumin Kim, Hyemin Jeong, Mingu Kang, Yejin Kim, Yoori Oh, Joonseok Lee

entry.summary: TripleSumm proposes adaptive triple-modality (visual, text, audio) fusion for video summarization with frame-level modality weighting. Also introduces a new comprehensive benchmark for multimodal video summarization.

entry.title: AG-VAS: Anchor-Guided Zero-Shot Visual Anomaly Segmentation with Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Zhen Qu, Xian Tao, Xiaoyi Bao, Dingrong Wang, ShiChen Qu, Zhengtao Zhang, Xingang Wang

entry.summary: AG-VAS introduces anchor-guided zero-shot visual anomaly segmentation using large multimodal models with learnable semantic anchor tokens for anomaly detection.

entry.title: Constructing Synthetic Instruction Datasets for Improving Reasoning in Domain-Specific LLMs: A Case Study in the Japanese Financial Domain

author.name: Yuma Okochi, Fabio Milentiansen Sim, Tomoyasu Okada

entry.summary: Proposes a method for constructing synthetic instruction datasets for domain-specific LLMs starting from domain vocabulary, demonstrated in Japanese financial domain with 9.5B tokens including CoT traces.

entry.title: Enhancing Persona Following at Decoding Time via Dynamic Importance Estimation for Role-Playing Agents

author.name: Yuxin Liu, Mingye Zhu, Siyuan Liu, Bo Hu, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic importance estimation for persona-following in role-playing agents at decoding time, grounded in psychological theory (Cognitive-Affective Personality Systems) for adaptive persona management.

entry.title: Retrieval, Refinement, and Ranking for Text-to-Video Generation via Prompt Optimization and Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Zillur Rahman, Alex Sheng, Cristian Meo

entry.summary: 3R introduces a RAG-based prompt optimization framework for text-to-video generation that requires no model training, using retrieval, refinement, and ranking to improve generation quality.

entry.title: Assessing Crime Disclosure Patterns in a Large-Scale Cybercrime Forum

author.name: Raphael Hoheisel, Tom Meurs, Jai Wientjes, Marianne Junger, Abhishta Abhishta, Masarah Paquet-Clouston

entry.summary: Large-scale analysis of crime disclosure patterns in a cybercrime forum using LLM-powered classification of 3.5M posts from 300K users, measuring evolution of criminal disclosure over time.

entry.title: PleaSQLarify: Visual Pragmatic Repair for Natural Language Database Querying

author.name: Robin Shing Moon Chan, Rita Sevastjanova, Mennatallah El-Assady

entry.summary: Presents PleaSQLarify, a system that reframes natural language database querying through pragmatic inference, using interactive clarification around interpretable decision variables to resolve ambiguity between user intent and SQL generation.

entry.title: Tide: A Customisable Dataset Generator for Anti-Money Laundering Research

author.name: Montijn van den Beukel, Jo\v{z}e Martin Ro\v{z}anec, Ana-Lucia Varbanescu

entry.summary: Presents Tide, an open-source synthetic dataset generator for anti-money laundering research that produces graph-based financial networks with both structural and temporal money laundering patterns.

entry.title: Demonstrating ViviDoc: Generating Interactive Documents through Human-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Yinghao Tang, Yupeng Xie, Yingchaojie Feng, Tingfeng Lan, Wei Chen

entry.summary: Presents ViviDoc, a human-agent collaborative system for generating interactive educational documents using a multi-agent pipeline with a human-readable Document Specification (DocSpec) intermediate representation.

entry.title: MAC: A Conversion Rate Prediction Benchmark Featuring Labels Under Multiple Attribution Mechanisms

author.name: Jinqi Wu, Sishuo Chen, Zhangming Chan, Yong Bai, Lei Zhang, Sheng Chen, Chenghuan Hou, Xiang-Rong Sheng, Han Zhu, Jian Xu, Bo Zheng, Chaoyou Fu

entry.summary: Establishes MAC, the first public conversion rate prediction dataset with labels from multiple attribution mechanisms, along with PyMAL library for multi-attribution learning research.

entry.title: Retrodictive Forecasting: A Proof-of-Concept for Exploiting Temporal Asymmetry in Time Series Prediction

author.name: Cedric Damour

entry.summary: Proposes retrodictive forecasting: instead of predicting future from past, identifies the future that best explains the present via inverse MAP optimization over a CVAE, with an information-theoretic diagnostic for applicability.

entry.title: Wave-Attractor-Tree: A Hierarchical Binary Tree Reduction Architecture for Efficient Sequence Modeling

author.name: Igor Berezkin

entry.summary: Proposes Wave-Attractor-Tree, a hierarchical binary tree reduction architecture replacing self-attention with recursive gated linear unit merges, achieving O(n) total operations and O(log n) parallel depth.

entry.title: Principled Fast and Meta Knowledge Learners for Continual Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ke Sun, Hongming Zhang, Jun Jin, Chao Gao, Xi Chen, Wulong Liu, Linglong Kong

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-learner framework inspired by hippocampus-cortex interplay for continual RL, with a fast learner for knowledge transfer and meta learner for knowledge integration that minimizes catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Fed-ADE: Adaptive Learning Rate for Federated Post-adaptation under Distribution Shift

author.name: Heewon Park, Mugon Joe, Miru Kim, Kyungjin Im, Minhae Kwon

entry.summary: Proposes Fed-ADE, a federated learning framework for post-deployment adaptation using uncertainty and representation dynamics estimation to automatically adjust learning rates per client under distribution shift.

entry.title: SKINOPATHY AI: Smartphone-Based Ophthalmic Screening and Longitudinal Tracking Using Lightweight Computer Vision

author.name: S. Kalaycioglu, C. Hong, M. Zhu, H. Xie

entry.summary: SKINOPATHY AI is a smartphone-based web application for ophthalmic screening using commodity mobile hardware, providing five screening modules including redness quantification and pupil reflex characterization.

entry.title: The Partition Principle Revisited: Non-Equal Volume Designs Achieve Minimal Expected Star Discrepancy

author.name: Xiaoda Xu

entry.summary: Proves that non-equal volume stratified sampling achieves lower expected star discrepancy than classical jittered sampling, with explicit improved upper bounds.

entry.title: On the Stability Connection Between Discrete-Time Algorithms and Their Resolution ODEs: Applications to Min-Max Optimisation

author.name: Amir Ali Farzin, Yuen-Man Pun, Philipp Braun, Iman Shames

entry.summary: Establishes rigorous connections between stability of discrete-time optimization algorithms and their continuous-time ODE approximations, proving exponential stability transfers under small step sizes.

entry.title: Building a Strong Instruction Language Model for a Less-Resourced Language

author.name: Domen Vre\v{s}, Tja\v{s}a Ar\v{c}on, Timotej Petri\v{c}, Dario Vajda, Marko Robnik-\v{S}ikonja, Iztok Lebar Bajec

entry.title: Graph neural network force fields for adiabatic dynamics of lattice Hamiltonians

author.name: Yunhao Fan, Gia-Wei Chern

entry.summary: Develops GNN-based force fields for adiabatic dynamics of lattice Hamiltonians, demonstrating on the semiclassical Holstein model with strict linear scaling and symmetry preservation through message passing.

entry.title: Piecing Together Cross-Document Coreference Resolution Datasets: Systematic Dataset Analysis and Unification

author.name: Anastasia Zhukova, Terry Ruas, Jan Philip Wahle, Bela Gipp

entry.summary: Introduces uCDCR, a unified dataset consolidating diverse cross-document coreference resolution corpora into a consistent format with standardized metrics, incorporating both entity and event coreference.

entry.title: Hybrid Neural-LLM Pipeline for Morphological Glossing in Endangered Language Documentation: A Case Study of Jungar Tuvan

author.name: Siyu Liang, Talant Mawkanuli, Gina-Anne Levow

entry.title: Towards Orthographically-Informed Evaluation of Speech Recognition Systems for Indian Languages

author.name: Kaushal Santosh Bhogale, Tahir Javed, Greeshma Susan John, Dhruv Rathi, Akshayasree Padmanaban, Niharika Parasa, Mitesh M. Khapra

entry.title: A Study on Building Efficient Zero-Shot Relation Extraction Models

author.name: Hugo Thomas, Caio Corro, Guillaume Gravier, Pascale S\'ebillot

entry.title: Beyond the Resum\'e: A Rubric-Aware Automatic Interview System for Information Elicitation

author.name: Harry Stuart, Masahiro Kaneko, Timothy Baldwin

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based automated interview system that elicits rubric-specific information from job candidates, updating beliefs about applicant qualifications through structured dialogue.

entry.title: LLM-as-an-Annotator: Training Lightweight Models with LLM-Annotated Examples for Aspect Sentiment Tuple Prediction

entry.title: Semantic Novelty Trajectories in 80,000 Books: A Cross-Corpus Embedding Analysis

author.name: Fred Zimmerman

entry.title: End-to-End Simultaneous Dysarthric Speech Reconstruction with Frame-Level Adaptor and Multiple Wait-k Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Minghui Wu, Haitao Tang, Jiahuan Fan, Ruizhi Liao, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes end-to-end simultaneous dysarthric speech reconstruction with frame-level adaptation and multiple wait-k knowledge distillation, addressing latency issues in streaming scenarios.

entry.title: Power Echoes: Investigating Moderation Biases in Online Power-Asymmetric Conflicts

author.name: Yaqiong Li, Peng Zhang, Peixu Hou, Kainan Tu, Guangping Zhang, Shan Qu, Wenshi Chen, Yan Chen, Ning Gu, Tun Lu

entry.title: DiffSOS: Acoustic Conditional Diffusion Model for Speed-of-Sound Reconstruction in Ultrasound Computed Tomography

author.name: Yujia Wu, Shuoqi Chen, Shiru Wang, Yucheng Tang, Petr Bruza, Geoffrey P. Luke

entry.title: Improved Adversarial Diffusion Compression for Real-World Video Super-Resolution

author.name: Bin Chen, Weiqi Li, Shijie Zhao, Xuanyu Zhang, Junlin Li, Li Zhang, Jian Zhang

entry.summary: Improves adversarial diffusion compression for real-world video super-resolution, adding temporal awareness and enhanced adversarial learning to balance spatial details with temporal consistency.

entry.title: COG: Confidence-aware Optimal Geometric Correspondence for Unsupervised Single-reference Novel Object Pose Estimation

author.name: Yuchen Che, Jingtu Wu, Hao Zheng, Asako Kanezaki

entry.title: RAFM: Retrieval-Augmented Flow Matching for Unpaired CBCT-to-CT Translation

entry.title: Adaptive Dynamic Dehazing via Instruction-Driven and Task-Feedback Closed-Loop Optimization for Diverse Downstream Task Adaptation

author.name: Yafei Zhang, Shuaitian Song, Huafeng Li, Shujuan Wang, Yu Liu

author.name: Cong Wang, Jinshan Pan, Liyan Wang, Wei Wang, Yang Yang

entry.title: Adaptive Augmentation-Aware Latent Learning for Robust LiDAR Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Wangkai Li, Zhaoyang Li, Yuwen Pan, Rui Sun, Yujia Chen, Tianzhu Zhang

author.name: Jiachen Yang, Xianhui Lin, Yi Dong, Zebiao Zheng, Xing Liu, Hong Gu, Yanmei Fang

author.name: Anna Michailidou, Georgios Angelidis, Vasileios Argyriou, Panagiotis Sarigiannidis, Georgios Th. Papadopoulos

entry.title: Align-cDAE: Alzheimer's Disease Progression Modeling with Attention-Aligned Conditional Diffusion Auto-Encoder

author.name: Ayantika Das, Keerthi Ram, Mohanasankar Sivaprakasam

entry.title: A Diffusion-Driven Fine-Grained Nodule Synthesis Framework for Enhanced Lung Nodule Detection from Chest Radiographs

author.name: Aryan Goyal, Shreshtha Singh, Ashish Mittal, Manoj Tadepalli, Piyush Kumar, Preetham Putha

entry.title: Event-Only Drone Trajectory Forecasting with RPM-Modulated Kalman Filtering

entry.title: Multiview Progress Prediction of Robot Activities

entry.title: DAM-VLA: A Dynamic Action Model-Based Vision-Language-Action Framework for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Xiongfeng Peng, Jiaqian Yu, Dingzhe Li, Yixiang Jin, Lu Xu, Yamin Mao, Chao Zhang, Weiming Li, Sujin Jang, Dongwook Lee, Daehyun Ji

entry.title: SFCo-Nav: Efficient Zero-Shot Visual Language Navigation via Collaboration of Slow LLM and Fast Attributed Graph Alignment

author.name: Chaoran Xiong, Litao Wei, Xinhao Hu, Kehui Ma, Ziyi Xia, Zixin Jiang, Zhen Sun, Ling Pei

entry.title: Why Not? Solver-Grounded Certificates for Explainable Mission Planning

entry.title: Nano-EmoX: Unifying Multimodal Emotional Intelligence from Perception to Empathy

author.name: Jiahao Huang, Fengyan Lin, Xuechao Yang, Chen Feng, Kexin Zhu, Xu Yang, Zhide Chen

author.name: Ronald Schnitzer, Maximilian Hoeving, Sonja Zillner

entry.title: Phishing the Phishers with SpecularNet: Hierarchical Graph Autoencoding for Reference-Free Web Phishing Detection

author.name: Tailai Song, Pedro Casas, Michela Meo

entry.summary: Introduces SpecularNet, a lightweight phishing detection framework that operates solely on domain names and raw HTML without external knowledge bases, using hierarchical graph autoencoders for reference-free detection.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Concept and Motion Segmentation for Semi-Supervised Angiography Videos

author.name: Yu Luo, Guangyu Wei, Yangfan Li, Jieyu He, Yueming Lyu

entry.summary: Introduces a 3D mesh convolution-based autoencoder for geometry compression that works directly on irregular mesh data without preprocessing or manifold conditions.

entry.title: NextAds: Towards Next-generation Personalized Video Advertising

entry.title: Test-Driven Agentic Framework for Reliable Robot Controller

author.name: Shivanshu Tripathi, Reza Akbarian Bafghi, Maziar Raissi

entry.summary: Proposes a test-driven agentic framework that iteratively refines LLM-generated robot controller code using diagnostic feedback from structured test suites, with a dual-tier repair strategy combining prompt-level and code-level refinement.

entry.title: RAG-RUSS: A Retrieval-Augmented Robotic Ultrasound for Autonomous Carotid Examination

author.name: Dianye Huang, Ziping Cong, Nassir Navab, Zhongliang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces RAG-RUSS, a retrieval-augmented framework for autonomous robotic ultrasound carotid examination that provides interpretable decision-making aligned with clinical workflows.

entry.title: B$^2$F-Map: Crowd-sourced Mapping with Bayesian B-spline Fusion

author.name: Yiping Xie, Yuxuan Xia, Erik Stenborg, Junsheng Fu, Axel Beauvisage, Gabriel E. Garcia, Tianyu Wu, Gustaf Hendeby

entry.title: Optimizing In-Context Demonstrations for LLM-based Automated Grading

author.name: Yucheng Chu, Hang Li, Kaiqi Yang, Yasemin Copur-Gencturk, Kevin Haudek, Joseph Krajcik, Jiliang Tang

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Framework for Self-Adapting Model Predictive Controllers

author.name: Wael Hafez, Amir Nazeri

entry.summary: Introduces Entanglement Learning, an information-theoretic framework enhancing Model Predictive Control adaptability through Information Digital Twin monitoring of information flow between inputs, actions, and behavior.

entry.title: Agentic Multi-Source Grounding for Enhanced Query Intent Understanding: A DoorDash Case Study

author.name: Emmanuel Aboah Boateng, Kyle MacDonald, Akshad Viswanathan, Sudeep Das

entry.summary: Presents an agentic multi-source grounding system for DoorDash that maps ambiguous user queries to multiple business categories using catalog retrieval and web search, emitting ordered multi-intent sets.

entry.title: CeProAgents: A Hierarchical Agents System for Automated Chemical Process Development

author.name: Yuhang Yang, Ruikang Li, Jifei Ma, Kai Zhang, Qi Liu, Jianyu Han, Yonggan Bu, Jibin Zhou, Defu Lian, Xin Li, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Introduces CeProAgents, a hierarchical multi-agent system for automating chemical process development through collaborative division of labor across knowledge, concept, and parameter agent cohorts with a novel hybrid architecture.

entry.title: OpenRad: a Curated Repository of Open-access AI models for Radiology

author.name: Konstantinos Vrettos, Galini Papadaki, Emmanouil Brilakis, Matthaios Triantafyllou, Dimitrios Leventis, Despina Staraki, Maria Mavroforou, Eleftherios Tzanis, Konstantina Giouroukou, Michail E. Klontzas

entry.title: AI-Generated Letters from the Future: A Randomized Test of Personalized Climate Communication

author.name: Nattavudh Powdthavee, Pat Pataranutaporn, Sandra J. Geiger, Louisa Richter, Mathew P. White

entry.title: LitBench: A Graph-Centric Large Language Model Benchmarking Tool For Literature Tasks

author.name: Andreas Varvarigos, Ali Maatouk, Jiasheng Zhang, Ngoc Bui, Jialin Chen, Leandros Tassiulas, Rex Ying

entry.title: Iterative LLM-based improvement for French Clinical Interview Transcription and Speaker Diarization

author.name: Ambre Marie (LaTIM), Thomas Bertin (DySoLab), Guillaume Dardenne (LaTIM), Gwenol\'e Quellec (LaTIM)

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-pass LLM post-processing architecture for improving French clinical speech transcription by alternating between speaker and word recognition passes, achieving significant improvements on suicide prevention conversations.

entry.title: Exploring Drug Safety Through Knowledge Graphs: Protein Kinase Inhibitors as a Case Study

author.name: David Jackson, Michael Gertz, J\"urgen Hesser

entry.summary: Presents a knowledge graph framework unifying diverse drug safety sources (ChEMBL, PubMed, FAERS) into an evidence-weighted network for protein kinase inhibitors, enabling contextual comparison of efficacy and safety profiles.

entry.title: Pulse-Driven Neural Architecture: Learnable Oscillatory Dynamics for Robust Continuous-Time Sequence Processing

author.name: Paras Sharma

entry.summary: PDNA augments continuous-time recurrent networks with learnable oscillatory dynamics and recurrent self-attention, improving robustness to input gaps in sequential processing tasks.

entry.title: Automated Discovery of Improved Constant Weight Binary Codes

author.name: Christopher D. Rosin

entry.summary: Uses tabu search and a novel greedy heuristic to establish improved lower bounds on constant weight binary codes A(n,d,w) for 24 parameter combinations, discovered by AI-guided search.

entry.title: LiaisonAgent: An Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous Risk Investigation and Governance

author.name: Chuanming Tang, Ling Qing, Shifeng Chen

entry.title: Physical Evaluation of Naturalistic Adversarial Patches for Camera-Based Traffic-Sign Detection

author.name: Brianna D'Urso, Tahmid Hasan Sakib, Syed Rafay Hasan, Terry N. Guo

entry.title: Quantifying Catastrophic Forgetting in IoT Intrusion Detection Systems

author.name: Sourasekhar Banerjee, David Bergqvist, Salman Toor, Christian Rohner, Andreas Johnsson

entry.title: TMR-VLA:Vision-Language-Action Model for Magnetic Motion Control of Tri-leg Silicone-based Soft Robot

author.name: Ruijie Tang, Chi Kit Ng, Kaixuan Wu, Long Bai, Guankun Wang, Yiming Huang, Yupeng Wang, Hongliang Ren

entry.title: Research Summary: March 02, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research spans fundamental theoretical limits of AI training, architectural innovations for sequence modeling, and practical advances in inference efficiency and safety.

  • A unified theory frames human supervision as an information bottleneck, proving strictly positive excess-risk floors for any learner—directly relevant to alignment scaling debates
  • Memory Caching enables RNN capacity to grow with sequence length via checkpoint caching, addressing a core recurrent-model limitation
  • CUDA Agent applies large-scale agentic RL to GPU kernel optimization, achieving strong results on a high-value infrastructure problem
  • Compositional generalization is formally shown to require linear, orthogonal representation geometry, grounding the Linear Representation Hypothesis
  • LLMs parse severely degraded "Jabberwockified" English, revealing deep reliance on syntactic structure over lexical content

On the efficiency and training front, LK Losses directly optimize acceptance rates for speculative decoding instead of using KL divergence as a proxy. Recycling Failures salvages mostly-correct RLVR trajectories via fine-grained off-policy guidance, improving sample efficiency. LoRA-Pre reframes optimizer momentum as online linear regression, yielding a principled low-rank optimizer. Separately, removing prior assistant responses from multi-turn LLM conversations surprisingly preserves response quality, and training reasoning models with separate LoRA adapters enables privacy-preserving chain-of-thought without leaking sensitive information.

entry.title: Memory Caching: RNNs with Growing Memory

author.name: Ali Behrouz and Zeman Li and Yuan Deng and Peilin Zhong and Meisam Razaviyayn and Vahab Mirrokni

entry.summary: Introduces Memory Caching (MC) for RNNs, which caches checkpoints of hidden states to allow effective memory capacity to grow with sequence length, bridging the gap between fixed-memory RNNs and Transformers on recall-intensive tasks.

entry.title: Human Supervision as an Information Bottleneck: A Unified Theory of Error Floors in Human-Guided Learning

author.name: Alejandro Rodriguez Dominguez

entry.summary: Develops a unified theory showing that human supervision acts as an information bottleneck, inducing strictly positive excess-risk floors for any learner. Formalizes the 'Human-Bounded Intelligence' limit across six complementary theoretical frameworks.

entry.title: The Astonishing Ability of Large Language Models to Parse Jabberwockified Language

author.name: Gary Lupyan, Senyi Yang

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLMs can recover meaning from severely degraded English texts where content words are replaced with nonsense strings ('Jabberwockified'). Shows structural cues constrain lexical meaning far more than previously thought.

entry.title: Compositional Generalization Requires Linear, Orthogonal Representations in Vision Embedding Models

author.name: Arnas Uselis, Andrea Dittadi, Seong Joon Oh

entry.summary: Formalizes three desiderata for compositional generalization in vision embeddings and proves they require linear, orthogonal representation decomposition - providing theoretical grounding for the Linear Representation Hypothesis from first principles.

entry.title: CUDA Agent: Large-Scale Agentic RL for High-Performance CUDA Kernel Generation

author.name: Weinan Dai, Hanlin Wu, Qiying Yu, Huan-ang Gao, Jiahao Li, Chengquan Jiang, Weiqiang Lou, Yufan Song, Hongli Yu, Jiaze Chen, Wei-Ying Ma, Ya-Qin Zhang, Jingjing Liu, Mingxuan Wang, Xin Liu, Hao Zhou

entry.summary: Presents CUDA Agent, a large-scale agentic RL system that develops CUDA kernel optimization expertise through data synthesis, skill-augmented environments, and RL training. Aims to bridge the gap between LLM code generation and compiler-based systems like torch.compile.

entry.title: Controllable Reasoning Models Are Private Thinkers

author.name: Haritz Puerto, Haonan Li, Xudong Han, Timothy Baldwin, Iryna Gurevych

entry.summary: Proposes training reasoning models to follow privacy instructions not only in final answers but also in reasoning traces, introducing separate LoRA adapters for reasoning and answer generation to prevent private information leakage in AI agent reasoning chains.

entry.title: Do LLMs Benefit From Their Own Words?

author.name: Jenny Y. Huang, Leshem Choshen, Ramon Astudillo, Tamara Broderick, and Jacob Andreas

entry.summary: Finds that removing prior assistant responses from multi-turn LLM conversations does not affect response quality on a large fraction of turns, with up to 10x reduction in cumulative context length. Shows most multi-turn conversations consist of independent subtasks.

entry.title: The Stability of Online Algorithms in Performative Prediction

author.name: Gabriele Farina and Juan Carlos Perdomo

entry.summary: Proves that any no-regret algorithm in performative prediction settings converges to a mixed performatively stable equilibrium, without requiring assumptions on how models influence distributions. Uses a martingale argument to achieve this unconditional reduction.

entry.title: Causal Identification from Counterfactual Data: Completeness and Bounding Results

author.name: Arvind Raghavan, Elias Bareinboim

entry.summary: Develops complete identification theory for counterfactual queries when some Layer 3 (counterfactual) data is available, extending Pearl's causal hierarchy. Provides algorithmic completeness results and tight bounding procedures for partially identifiable quantities.

author.name: Ziqi Gao, Jieyu Zhang, Wisdom Oluchi Ikezogwo, Jae Sung Park, Tario G. You, Daniel Ogbu, Chenhao Zheng, Weikai Huang, Yinuo Yang, Winson Han, Quan Kong, Rajat Saini, Ranjay Krishna

entry.title: Optimizer-Induced Low-Dimensional Drift and Transverse Dynamics in Transformer Training

author.name: Yongzhong Xu

entry.summary: Studies the geometry of training trajectories in small transformers, finding parameter updates organize into a dominant drift direction with transverse oscillatory dynamics. Reveals that AdamW develops multi-dimensional drift structure distinct from SGD, suggesting optimizer choice fundamentally shapes trajectory geometry.

entry.title: LK Losses: Direct Acceptance Rate Optimization for Speculative Decoding

author.name: Alexander Samarin, Sergei Krutikov, Anton Shevtsov, Sergei Skvortsov, Filipp Fisin, Alexander Golubev

entry.summary: Proposes LK losses that directly optimize acceptance rate for speculative decoding draft models, rather than using KL divergence as a proxy. Comprehensive experiments across four draft architectures and six target models (8B-685B) show consistent improvements.

entry.title: Recycling Failures: Salvaging Exploration in RLVR via Fine-Grained Off-Policy Guidance

author.name: Yanwei Ren, Haotian Zhang, Likang Xiao, Xikai Zhang, Jiaxing Huang, Jiayan Qiu, Baosheng Yu, Quan Chen, Liu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a method to salvage mostly-correct but failed reasoning trajectories in RLVR training by providing fine-grained off-policy guidance rather than discarding them entirely. Addresses the problem that outcome-based supervision penalizes largely correct rollouts with minor errors as heavily as completely wrong ones.

entry.title: LemmaBench: A Live, Research-Level Benchmark to Evaluate LLM Capabilities in Mathematics

author.name: Antoine Peyronnet, Fabian Gloeckle, Amaury Hayat

entry.summary: Introduces LemmaBench, a live benchmark evaluating LLMs on research-level mathematics by automatically extracting lemmas from arXiv and rewriting them as self-contained problems. entry.title: Taming Momentum: Rethinking Optimizer States Through Low-Rank Approximation

author.name: Zhengbo Wang, Jian Liang, Ran He, Zilei Wang, Tieniu Tan

entry.summary: Reframes the EMA in optimizer momentum as training a linear regressor via online gradient flow, then introduces LoRA-Pre, a low-rank optimizer that decomposes momentum matrices into compact low-rank subspaces for memory-efficient pre-training of large language models.

author.name: Nazanin Mohammadi Sepahvand, Eleni Triantafillou, Hugo Larochelle, Doina Precup, Daniel M. Roy, Gintare Karolina Dziugaite

The theoretical result is complemented by a practical DeepOCluster algorithm for functional data clustering.

entry.title: Let There Be Claws: An Early Social Network Analysis of AI Agents on Moltbook

author.name: H.C.W. Price, H. AlMuhanna, P.M. Bassani, M. Ho, T.S. Evans

entry.summary: Analyzes an AI-native social platform (Moltbook) during its first 12 days, finding extreme attention concentration, hierarchical role separation, and one-way attention flow among AI agent accounts. Shows stratification emerges rapidly in agent ecosystems.

entry.title: Keyword search is all you need: Achieving RAG-Level Performance without vector databases using agentic tool use

author.name: Shreyas Subramanian, Adewale Akinfaderin, Yanyan Zhang, Ishan Singh, Mani Khanuja, Sandeep Singh, Maira Ladeira Tanke

entry.summary: Challenges the necessity of vector databases in RAG by showing that agentic LLMs with simple keyword search can match RAG performance for question-answering tasks. Systematic comparison reveals diminishing marginal value of semantic search.

entry.title: Brain-OF: An Omnifunctional Foundation Model for fMRI, EEG and MEG

author.name: Hanning Guo, Farah Abdellatif, Hanwen Bi, Andrei Galbenus, Jon. N. Shah, Abigail Morrison, J\"urgen Dammers

entry.summary: Proposes Brain-OF, the first omnifunctional brain foundation model jointly pretrained on fMRI, EEG, and MEG. Introduces an Any-Resolution Neural Signal Sampler to reconcile heterogeneous spatiotemporal resolutions across modalities.

entry.title: CiteAudit: You Cited It, But Did You Read It? A Benchmark for Verifying Scientific References in the LLM Era

author.name: Zhengqing Yuan, Kaiwen Shi, Zheyuan Zhang, Lichao Sun, Nitesh V. Chawla, Yanfang Ye

entry.summary: Presents CiteAudit, a benchmark and multi-agent detection framework for hallucinated citations in scientific writing. Addresses the risk of LLM-fabricated references with a pipeline for claim extraction and evidence verification.

entry.title: Lap2: Revisiting Laplace DP-SGD for High Dimensions via Majorization Theory

author.name: Meisam Mohammady and Qin Yang and Nicholas Stout and Ayesha Samreen and Han Wang and Christopher J Quinn and Yuan Hong

entry.summary: Introduces Lap2, enabling L2 norm clipping for Laplace mechanism DP-SGD while preserving privacy guarantees. Uses majorization theory to overcome the impractical L1 norm scaling in high-dimensional models, making Laplace DP-SGD competitive with Gaussian.

entry.title: Humans and LLMs Diverge on Probabilistic Inferences

author.name: Gaurav Kamath, Sreenath Madathil, Sebastian Schuster, Marie-Catherine de Marneffe, Siva Reddy

entry.summary: Introduces ProbCOPA, a dataset of 210 probabilistic inference items showing that humans exhibit graded probabilistic judgments while reasoning LLMs show systematic divergence, being more categorical and less sensitive to nuanced likelihood levels.

entry.title: LFQA-HP-1M: A Large-Scale Human Preference Dataset for Long-Form Question Answering

author.name: Rafid Ishrak Jahan, Fahmid Shahriar Iqbal, Sagnik Ray Choudhury

entry.summary: Presents LFQA-HP-1M, a large-scale dataset of 1.3M human pairwise preference annotations for long-form question answering evaluation, with nine quality rubrics. Shows simple linear models on rubric features match LLM evaluators and reveals biases in LLM judges.

entry.title: SleepLM: Natural-Language Intelligence for Human Sleep

author.name: Zongzhe Xu, Zitao Shuai, Eideen Mozaffari, Ravi S. Aysola, Rajesh Kumar, Yuzhe Yang

entry.summary: Introduces SleepLM, a family of sleep-language foundation models that align polysomnography data with natural language, trained on 100K+ hours from 10K+ individuals. Enables language-grounded sleep analysis beyond fixed label spaces.

entry.title: HiDrop: Hierarchical Vision Token Reduction in MLLMs via Late Injection, Concave Pyramid Pruning, and Early Exit

author.name: Hao Wu, Yingqi Fan, Jinyang Dai, Junlong Tong, Yunpu Ma, Xiaoyu Shen

entry.summary: HiDrop introduces hierarchical vision token reduction for multimodal LLMs featuring Late Injection (bypassing shallow layers for visual tokens) and Concave Pyramid Pruning with Early Exit. Achieves significant efficiency gains with minimal accuracy loss.

entry.title: From Static Benchmarks to Dynamic Protocol: Agent-Centric Text Anomaly Detection for Evaluating LLM Reasoning

author.name: Seungdong Yoa, Sanghyu Yoon, Suhee Yoon, Dongmin Kim, Ye Seul Sim, Junhyun Lee, Woohyung Lim

entry.summary: Proposes an agent-centric dynamic benchmarking paradigm for evaluating LLM reasoning, where teacher/orchestrator/student agents iteratively generate, validate, and solve problems of increasing difficulty, replacing static datasets.

entry.title: TradeFM: A Generative Foundation Model for Trade-flow and Market Microstructure

author.name: Maxime Kawawa-Beaudan, Srijan Sood, Kassiani Papasotiriou, Daniel Borrajo, Manuela Veloso

entry.summary: TradeFM is a 524M-parameter generative Transformer for market microstructure, trained on billions of trade events across 9K+ equities. Uses scale-invariant features and universal tokenization for cross-asset generalization, reproducing key financial stylized facts.

entry.title: SWE-rebench V2: Language-Agnostic SWE Task Collection at Scale

author.name: Ibragim Badertdinov, Maksim Nekrashevich, Anton Shevtsov, Alexander Golubev

entry.summary: SWE-rebench V2 introduces a language-agnostic automated pipeline for harvesting executable real-world software engineering tasks at scale for RL training of SWE agents, addressing the scarcity of large-scale task collections.

entry.title: Thinking with Images as Continuous Actions: Numerical Visual Chain-of-Thought

author.name: Kesen Zhao, Beier Zhu, Junbao Zhou, Xingyu Zhu, Zhongqi Yue, Hanwang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes NV-CoT (Numerical Visual Chain-of-Thought) that enables MLLMs to reason over images using continuous numerical coordinates rather than discrete tokens or fixed patches, requiring only minimal architectural changes.

entry.title: Ask don't tell: Reducing sycophancy in large language models

author.name: Magda Dubois, Cozmin Ududec, Christopher Summerfield, Lennart Luettgau

entry.summary: Studies what input features provoke or prevent LLM sycophancy through controlled experiments with nested factorial design. Finds that asking questions rather than making statements significantly reduces sycophantic behavior.

entry.title: Inference-time optimization for experiment-grounded protein ensemble generation

author.name: Advaith Maddipatla, Anar Rzayev, Marco Pegoraro, Martin Pacesa, Paul Schanda, Ailie Marx, Sanketh Vedula, Alex M. Bronstein

entry.summary: Introduces an inference-time optimization framework for generating protein conformational ensembles that match experimental data, optimizing over latent representations rather than perturbing structures post hoc.

entry.title: RewardUQ: A Unified Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Reward Models

author.name: Daniel Yang, Samuel Stante, Florian Redhardt, Lena Libon, Parnian Kassraie, Ido Hakimi, Barna P\'asztor, Andreas Krause

entry.summary: Introduces RewardUQ, a unified framework for systematically evaluating uncertainty quantification in reward models for LLM alignment. Compares methods across accuracy, calibration, and proposes new ranking metrics.

entry.title: Toward Guarantees for Clinical Reasoning in Vision Language Models via Formal Verification

author.name: Vikash Singh, Debargha Ganguly, Haotian Yu, Chengwei Zhou, Prerna Singh, Brandon Lee, Vipin Chaudhary, and Gourav Datta

entry.summary: Introduces a neurosymbolic verification framework for auditing clinical reasoning consistency in VLM-generated radiology reports, using an SMT solver (Z3) and clinical knowledge base to formally verify whether diagnostic claims are logically entailed by reported findings.

entry.title: Planning from Observation and Interaction

author.name: Tyler Han, Siyang Shen, Rohan Baijal, Harine Ravichandiran, Bat Nemekhbold, Kevin Huang, Sanghun Jung, Byron Boots

entry.summary: Presents a planning-based inverse RL algorithm for robot learning from observation alone (no demonstrations, rewards, or pre-training). Demonstrates real-world image-based manipulation tasks learned from scratch in under an hour.

entry.title: Humanoid Robots as First Assistants in Endoscopic Surgery

author.name: Sue Min Cho, Jan Emily Mangulabnan, Han Zhang, Zhekai Mao, Yufan He, Pengfei Guo, Daguang Xu, Gregory Hager, Masaru Ishii, Mathias Unberath

entry.summary: Reports the first proof-of-concept of a humanoid robot (Unitree G1) assisting in surgery: teleoperated endoscopic visualization during a cadaveric sphenoidectomy performed by an attending otolaryngologist. The procedure was completed successfully with stable visualization.

entry.title: A Mixed Diet Makes DINO An Omnivorous Vision Encoder

author.name: Rishabh Kabra, Maks Ovsjanikov, Drew A. Hudson, Ye Xia, Skanda Koppula, Andre Araujo, Joao Carreira, Niloy J. Mitra

entry.summary: Proposes the Omnivorous Vision Encoder that learns modality-agnostic features by training DINOv2-style encoders with cross-modal alignment and frozen teacher distillation. Reveals that standard vision encoder features for RGB and depth of the same scene have near-random cosine similarity.

entry.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Multimodal Large Language Models with Incoherence-adjusted Semantic Volume

author.name: Gregory Kang Ruey Lau, Hieu Dao, Nicole Kan Hui Lin, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low

entry.summary: Introduces UMPIRE, a training-free uncertainty quantification framework for multimodal LLMs that computes incoherence-adjusted semantic volume of sampled responses using only the models' internal features, working across input/output modalities without external tools.

entry.title: UFO-4D: Unposed Feedforward 4D Reconstruction from Two Images

author.name: Junhwa Hur, Charles Herrmann, Songyou Peng, Philipp Henzler, Zeyu Ma, Todd Zickler, Deqing Sun

entry.summary: Introduces UFO-4D, a unified feedforward framework for dense 4D reconstruction from two unposed images, directly estimating dynamic 3D Gaussian Splats for joint geometry, motion, and camera pose estimation without test-time optimization.

entry.title: Tools to generate realistic prompts help surprisingly little with Petri audit realism

author.name: Connor Kissane

entry.summary: Researchers from the Anthropic Fellows Program investigate whether generating more realistic synthetic user prompts improves the realism of Petri automated auditing agent transcripts. They find that while individual prompts can be made harder to distinguish from real WildChat deployment prompts, this doesn't translate to more realistic full audit transcripts. The bottleneck is higher-level features: the inherently harmful nature of audit scenarios and unnatural multi-turn conversation structure.

entry.title: A Variational Estimator for $L_p$ Calibration Errors

author.name: Eug\`ene Berta, Sacha Braun, David Holzm\"uller, Francis Bach, Michael I. Jordan

entry.summary: Extends variational estimation of calibration errors to Lp divergences beyond proper losses. The method separates over- and under-confidence and avoids overestimation unlike non-variational approaches. Notable author list includes Francis Bach and Michael Jordan.

entry.title: From Flat Logs to Causal Graphs: Hierarchical Failure Attribution for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Yawen Wang, Wenjie Wu, Junjie Wang, Qing Wang

entry.summary: CHIEF transforms execution logs of LLM-based multi-agent systems into hierarchical causal graphs, then uses oracle-guided backtracking and counterfactual verification for failure attribution. Addresses the opacity of multi-agent system failures.

entry.title: Partition Function Estimation under Bounded f-Divergence

author.name: Adam Block and Abhishek Shetty

entry.summary: Provides an information-theoretic characterization of partition function estimation complexity under bounded f-divergence. Introduces the integrated coverage profile to tightly characterize sample complexity of multiplicative partition function estimation with matching lower bounds.

entry.title: HumanMCP: A Human-Like Query Dataset for Evaluating MCP Tool Retrieval Performance

author.name: Shubh Laddha, Lucas Changbencharoen, Win Kuptivej, Surya Shringla, Archana Vaidheeswaran, Yash Bhaskar

entry.summary: Introduces HumanMCP, the first large-scale dataset of diverse human-like queries for evaluating MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool retrieval performance across 2800 tools and 308 MCP servers. Each tool is paired with multiple user personas.

entry.title: Universality of Shallow and Deep Neural Networks on Non-Euclidean Spaces

author.name: Vugar Ismailov

entry.summary: Develops a universal approximation theory for neural networks on general non-Euclidean topological spaces using isotropic activation functions. Establishes universality results for both wide shallow and narrow deep architectures.

entry.title: Truncated Step-Level Sampling with Process Rewards for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning

author.name: Chris Samarinas, Haw-Shiuan Chang, Hamed Zamani

entry.summary: Proposes SLATE, a framework for retrieval-augmented reasoning that uses truncated step-level sampling with process rewards to address credit assignment in multi-step search-augmented reasoning. Generates trajectories sharing common prefixes to reduce variance.

entry.title: FHIRPath-QA: Executable Question Answering over FHIR Electronic Health Records

author.name: Michael Frew, Nishit Bheda, Bryan Tripp

entry.summary: Introduces FHIRPath-QA, the first open dataset and benchmark for patient-specific question answering over electronic health records using FHIR standard queries. Shifts from free-text generation to structured FHIRPath query synthesis, reducing hallucination risk and LLM usage.

entry.title: Dynamics of Learning under User Choice: Overspecialization and Peer-Model Probing

author.name: Adhyyan Narang, Sarah Dean, Lillian J Ratliff, Maryam Fazel

entry.summary: Identifies the 'overspecialization trap' in multi-platform ML settings where learners converge to models with poor global performance due to user self-selection feedback loops. Proposes 'peer-model probing' to escape this trap.

entry.title: FlexGuard: Continuous Risk Scoring for Strictness-Adaptive LLM Content Moderation

author.name: Zhihao Ding, Jinming Li, Ze Lu, and Jieming Shi

entry.summary: Introduces FlexGuard with FlexBench benchmark for strictness-adaptive LLM content moderation, providing continuous risk scores rather than binary classifications to accommodate varying platform requirements.

entry.title: AI Must Embrace Specialization via Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence

author.name: Judah Goldfeder, Philippe Wyder, Yann LeCun, Ravid Shwartz Ziv

entry.summary: Argues that AI should embrace specialization rather than pursuing AGI, introducing Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence (SAI) - intelligence that achieves superhuman performance in specific domains while being adaptable. Co-authored with Yann LeCun.

entry.title: PseudoAct: Leveraging Pseudocode Synthesis for Flexible Planning and Action Control in Large Language Model Agents

author.name: Yihan (Logon) Wen, Xin Chen

entry.summary: PseudoAct introduces a framework where LLM agents synthesize pseudocode plans before execution, enabling structured control flow (loops, conditionals, parallelism) for complex long-horizon tasks. Outperforms ReAct-style approaches while reducing token consumption.

entry.title: U-Mind: A Unified Framework for Real-Time Multimodal Interaction with Audiovisual Generation

author.name: Xiang Deng, Feng Gao, Yong Zhang, Youxin Pang, Xu Xiaoming, Zhuoliang Kang, Xiaoming Wei, Yebin Liu

entry.summary: U-Mind is a unified system for real-time multimodal dialogue supporting joint language, speech, motion, and video synthesis within a single interactive loop. Implements segment-wise alignment strategy for cross-modal synchronization.

entry.title: Learning Accurate Segmentation Purely from Self-Supervision

author.name: Zuyao You, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Selfment is a fully self-supervised segmentation framework that segments objects from raw images without any labels or pretrained models, using patch-level affinity graphs with NCut and a novel Iterative Patch Optimization for spatial coherence refinement.

entry.title: RF-Agent: Automated Reward Function Design via Language Agent Tree Search

author.name: Ning Gao, Xiuhui Zhang, Xingyu Jiang, Mukang You, Mohan Zhang, Yue Deng

entry.summary: Proposes RF-Agent, a framework using LLMs as language agents with Monte Carlo Tree Search to design reward functions for RL control tasks. Frames reward function design as sequential decision-making, improving over greedy/evolutionary approaches.

entry.title: MINT: Multimodal Imaging-to-Speech Knowledge Transfer for Early Alzheimer's Screening

author.name: Vrushank Ahire, Yogesh Kumar, Anouck Girard, M. A. Ganaie

entry.summary: Proposes MINT, a three-stage cross-modal framework that transfers MRI biomarker knowledge into a speech encoder for early Alzheimer's screening, enabling population-scale screening without neuroimaging at inference time.

entry.title: Task Complexity Matters: An Empirical Study of Reasoning in LLMs for Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Donghao Huang and Zhaoxia Wang

entry.summary: Comprehensive evaluation of 504 configurations testing whether reasoning improves LLM performance on sentiment analysis. Finds reasoning is task-complexity dependent: hurts binary classification (-19.9 F1pp) but helps 27-class emotion (+16.0pp).

entry.title: Preference Packing: Efficient Preference Optimization for Large Language Models

author.name: Jaekyung Cho

entry.summary: Introduces preference packing, a training optimization that reduces redundant attention computation for duplicate input prompts in preference-based training (DPO, reward models). Achieves at least 37% reduction in training time by sharing attention over identical prompt portions across chosen/rejected responses.

entry.title: DiffusionHarmonizer: Bridging Neural Reconstruction and Photorealistic Simulation with Online Diffusion Enhancer

author.name: Yuxuan Zhang, Katar\'ina T\'othov\'a, Zian Wang, Kangxue Yin, Haithem Turki, Riccardo de Lutio, Yen-Yu Chang, Or Litany, Sanja Fidler, Zan Gojcic

entry.summary: Introduces DiffusionHarmonizer, a framework that uses online diffusion enhancement to improve neural scene reconstructions (NeRF/3DGS) for autonomous driving simulation. Transforms imperfect renderings into temporally consistent, photorealistic outputs while integrating dynamic objects from different scenes.

entry.title: Robust Skills, Brittle Grounding: Diagnosing Restricted Generalization in Vision-Language Action Policies via Multi-Object Picking

author.name: David Emukpere, Romain Deffayet, Jean-Michel Renders

entry.summary: Diagnoses a key limitation of vision-language action (VLA) policies: manipulation execution is reliable but language-to-object grounding fails under distribution shift. Tests SmolVLA and π₀.₅ under progressive workspace randomization, finding grounding is more brittle than motor skills.

entry.title: Efficient Discovery of Approximate Causal Abstractions via Neural Mechanism Sparsification

author.name: Amir Asiaee

entry.summary: Reframes discovery of causal abstractions in neural networks as structured pruning, deriving an Interventional Risk objective whose second-order expansion yields closed-form criteria for unit replacement. Shows variance-based pruning emerges as a special case.

entry.title: Moment Matters: Mean and Variance Causal Graph Discovery from Heteroscedastic Observational Data

author.name: Yoichi Chikahara

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian framework for causal discovery that separately infers mean and variance causal graphs from heteroscedastic observational data. Establishes identifiability conditions and develops a Bayesian inference procedure for the two-graph structure.

entry.title: On De-Individuated Neurons: Continuous Symmetries Enable Dynamic Topologies

author.name: George Bird

entry.summary: Introduces isotropic activation functions enabling dynamic neural network topology changes (growth/shrinkage) during training. The symmetry-based approach makes structural changes invariant under reparameterization, allowing real-time architecture adaptation.

entry.title: Annotation-Free Visual Reasoning for High-Resolution Large Multimodal Models via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jiacheng Yang, Anqi Chen, Yunkai Dang, Qi Fan, Cong Wang, Wenbin Li, Feng Miao, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes HART, a framework using reinforcement learning to train large multimodal models to identify and focus on key high-resolution image regions during reasoning without requiring grounding annotations.

entry.title: FedRot-LoRA: Mitigating Rotational Misalignment in Federated LoRA

author.name: Haoran Zhang, Dongjun Kim, Seohyeon Cha, Haris Vikalo

entry.summary: Proposes FedRot-LoRA to address rotational misalignment in federated LoRA fine-tuning, where semantically equivalent updates in different latent subspaces interfere destructively when averaged across clients.

entry.title: EgoGraph: Temporal Knowledge Graph for Egocentric Video Understanding

author.name: Shitong Sun, Ke Han, Yukai Huang, Weitong Cai, Jifei Song

entry.summary: EgoGraph constructs dynamic temporal knowledge graphs from ultra-long egocentric videos, encoding cross-entity dependencies (people, objects, locations, events) in a training-free framework for improved long-term video understanding.

entry.title: A Difference-in-Difference Approach to Detecting AI-Generated Images

author.name: Xinyi Qi, Kai Ye, Chengchun Shi, Ying Yang, Hongyi Zhou, Jin Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a difference-in-difference method for detecting AI-generated images, computing second-order differences in reconstruction error rather than first-order, achieving variance reduction and improved detection accuracy as AI images become more realistic.

entry.title: MPU: Towards Secure and Privacy-Preserving Knowledge Unlearning for Large Language Models

author.name: Tiantong Wang, Xinyu Yan, Tiantong Wu, Yurong Hao, Yong Jiang, Fei Huang, Wei Yang Bryan Lim

entry.summary: MPU addresses the privacy dilemma in LLM machine unlearning where neither server parameters nor client forget sets can be shared. Proposes a framework using multiple perturbed model copies for privacy-preserving unlearning.

entry.title: OmniXtreme: Breaking the Generality Barrier in High-Dynamic Humanoid Control

author.name: Yunshen Wang, Shaohang Zhu, Peiyuan Zhi, Yuhan Li, Jiaxin Li, Yong-Lu Li, Yuchen Xiao, Xingxing Wang, Baoxiong Jia and Siyuan Huang

entry.summary: OmniXtreme addresses the 'generality barrier' in humanoid motion tracking where fidelity collapses as motion diversity scales. Uses flow-matching policy with high-capacity architectures and decouples general skill learning from sim-to-real refinement.

entry.title: PointCoT: A Multi-modal Benchmark for Explicit 3D Geometric Reasoning

author.name: Dongxu Zhang, Yiding Sun, Pengcheng Li, Yumou Liu, Hongqiang Lin, Haoran Xu, Xiaoxuan Mu, Liang Lin, Wenbiao Yan, Ning Yang, Chaowei Fang, Juanjuan Zhao, Jihua Zhu, Conghui He, Cheng Tan

entry.summary: Introduces PointCoT, a framework that empowers MLLMs with explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning for 3D point cloud understanding, following a 'Look, Think, then Answer' paradigm to address geometric hallucinations.

entry.title: Learning Generation Orders for Masked Discrete Diffusion Models via Variational Inference

author.name: David Fox, Sam Bowyer, Song Liu, Laurence Aitchison, Raul Santos-Rodriguez, Mengyue Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a variational inference framework for learning parallel generation orders in masked discrete diffusion models. Introduces a factored posterior parameterization for generation orders.

entry.title: MSVBench: Towards Human-Level Evaluation of Multi-Shot Video Generation

author.name: Haoyuan Shi, Yunxin Li, Nanhao Deng, Zhenran Xu, Xinyu Chen, Longyue Wang, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MSVBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for multi-shot video generation with hierarchical scripts and cross-shot metrics. Evaluates 20 video generation methods and reveals limitations in narrative coherence.

entry.title: Interpretable Debiasing of Vision-Language Models for Social Fairness

author.name: Na Min An, Yoonna Jang, Yusuke Hirota, Ryo Hachiuma, Isabelle Augenstein, Hyunjung Shim

entry.summary: Introduces DeBiasLens, an interpretable bias mitigation framework for VLMs that uses sparse autoencoders to localize social attribute neurons in multimodal encoders, enabling targeted debiasing.

entry.title: Sandwiching Polynomials for Geometric Concepts with Low Intrinsic Dimension

author.name: Adam R. Klivans and Konstantinos Stavropoulos and Arsen Vasilyan

entry.summary: Provides new constructions of low-degree sandwiching polynomials for geometric concepts, achieving poly(k) degree for functions of k halfspaces under Gaussian distribution - an exponential improvement over the prior 2^O(k) bound. Applicable to learning with distribution shift and contamination.

entry.title: Enhancing Spatial Understanding in Image Generation via Reward Modeling

author.name: Zhenyu Tang, Chaoran Feng, Yufan Deng, Jie Wu, Xiaojie Li, Rui Wang, Yunpeng Chen, Daquan Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces SpatialScore, a reward model for evaluating spatial relationship accuracy in text-to-image generation, built on 80k preference pairs. Demonstrates that using this reward model can improve spatial understanding of image generation models.

entry.title: VaSST: Variational Inference for Symbolic Regression using Soft Symbolic Trees

author.name: Somjit Roy, Pritam Dey, Bani K. Mallick

entry.summary: Introduces VaSST, a variational inference framework for symbolic regression using continuous relaxation of symbolic expression trees ('soft symbolic trees'). This enables principled uncertainty quantification over symbolic expressions while avoiding the challenges of MCMC in multimodal combinatorial spaces.

entry.title: Democratizing GraphRAG: Linear, CPU-Only Graph Retrieval for Multi-Hop QA

author.name: Qizhi Wang

entry.summary: Presents SPRIG, a CPU-only, linear-time GraphRAG pipeline that replaces LLM-based graph construction with NER-driven co-occurrence graphs and Personalized PageRank for multi-hop retrieval.

entry.title: No Calibration, No Depth, No Problem: Cross-Sensor View Synthesis with 3D Consistency

author.name: Cho-Ying Wu, Zixun Huang, Xinyu Huang, Liu Ren

entry.summary: First study of cross-sensor view synthesis across different modalities (RGB-X), proposing a match-densify-consolidate method that eliminates the need for cumbersome cross-sensor calibration by using confidence-aware densification in 3DGS.

entry.title: KEEP: A KV-Cache-Centric Memory Management System for Efficient Embodied Planning

author.name: Zebin Yang, Tong Xie, Baotong Lu, Shaoshan Liu, Bo Yu and Meng Li

entry.summary: Proposes KEEP, a KV-cache-centric memory management system for embodied planning with LLMs that reduces recomputation through static-dynamic memory construction, hierarchical KV caching, and speculative prefetching.

entry.title: When Does Multimodal Learning Help in Healthcare? A Benchmark on EHR and Chest X-Ray Fusion

author.name: Kejing Yin and Haizhou Xu and Wenfang Yao and Chen Liu and Zijie Chen and Yui Haang Cheung and William K. Cheung and Jing Qin

entry.summary: Systematic benchmark of multimodal fusion between EHR and chest X-rays on MIMIC datasets, investigating when fusion helps, comparing strategies, testing robustness to missing modalities, and evaluating fairness.

entry.title: FAVLA: A Force-Adaptive Fast-Slow VLA model for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yao Li, Peiyuan Tang, Wuyang Zhang, Chengyang Zhu, Yifan Duan, Weikai Shi, Xiaodong Zhang, Zijiang Yang, Jianmin Ji, and Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FAVLA, a force-adaptive VLA model that decouples slow VLM perception planning from fast contact-aware control for contact-rich manipulation, addressing the frequency mismatch between force sensing and vision processing.

entry.title: StemVLA:An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model with Future 3D Spatial Geometry Knowledge and 4D Historical Representation

author.name: Jiasong Xiao, Yutao She, Kai Li, Yuyang Sha, Ziang Cheng, and Ziang Tong

entry.summary: StemVLA incorporates future-oriented 3D spatial knowledge and historical 4D spatiotemporal representations into vision-language-action models for robot manipulation, moving beyond direct 2D-to-action mappings.

entry.title: Bridging Dynamics Gaps via Diffusion Schr\"odinger Bridge for Cross-Domain Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hanping Zhang, Yuhong Guo

entry.summary: BDGxRL uses Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge to align source-domain transitions with target-domain dynamics for cross-domain reinforcement learning, combined with a reward modulation mechanism for consistency with target dynamics.

entry.title: Reasoning-Driven Multimodal LLM for Domain Generalization

author.name: Zhipeng Xu and Zilong Wang and Xinyang Jiang and Dongsheng Li and De Cheng and Nannan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes reasoning-driven MLLM for domain generalization using reasoning chains, with DomainBed-Reasoning dataset extension. Introduces Perception-Logic Balance and reasoning-guided visual feature regularization to address challenges of reasoning-based classification.

entry.title: Beyond State-Wise Mirror Descent: Offline Policy Optimization with Parameteric Policies

author.name: Xiang Li, Nan Jiang, Yuheng Zhang

entry.summary: Extends offline RL theory to parametric policy classes over continuous action spaces, moving beyond state-wise mirror descent. Provides theoretical guarantees when the optimal policy lies outside the hypothesis class.

entry.title: SelfOccFlow: Towards end-to-end self-supervised 3D Occupancy Flow prediction

author.name: Xavier Timoneda, Markus Herb, Fabian Duerr, Daniel Goehring

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised method for 3D occupancy flow estimation that eliminates need for human annotations or external flow supervision. Disentangles static and dynamic scene components using separate signed distance fields.

entry.title: Ref-Adv: Exploring MLLM Visual Reasoning in Referring Expression Tasks

author.name: Qihua Dong, Kuo Yang, Lin Ju, Handong Zhao, Yitian Zhang, Yizhou Wang, Huimin Zeng, Jianglin Lu, Yun Fu

entry.summary: Introduces Ref-Adv, a challenging REC benchmark that suppresses shortcuts in referring expression comprehension by pairing linguistically nontrivial expressions with hard distractors. Reveals significant performance gaps in current MLLMs.

entry.title: Hierarchical Concept-based Interpretable Models

author.name: Oscar Hill, Mateo Espinosa Zarlenga, Mateja Jamnik

entry.summary: Introduces Hierarchical Concept Embedding Models (HiCEMs) that model inter-concept relationships through hierarchical structures, along with Concept Splitting for automatic sub-concept discovery. Improves interpretability and accuracy.

entry.title: Look Carefully: Adaptive Visual Reinforcements in Multimodal Large Language Models for Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Xingyu Zhu, Kesen Zhao, Liang Yi, Shuo Wang, Zhicai Wang, Beier Zhu, Hanwang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Visual Reinforcement (AIR), a training-free framework that selectively reinforces relevant visual tokens during MLLM decoding to mitigate hallucination, using prototype-based token reduction.

entry.title: AgenticOCR: Parsing Only What You Need for Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zhengren Wang, Dongsheng Ma, Huaping Zhong, Jiayu Li, Wentao Zhang, Bin Wang, Conghui He

entry.summary: Introduces AgenticOCR, which transforms OCR from static full-text extraction into a query-driven, on-demand system for RAG pipelines. Avoids processing entire document pages by extracting only query-relevant information, reducing hallucinations from extraneous context.

entry.title: SenCache: Accelerating Diffusion Model Inference via Sensitivity-Aware Caching

author.name: Yasaman Haghighi, Alexandre Alahi

entry.summary: Proposes SenCache, a principled sensitivity-aware caching framework for accelerating diffusion model inference. Formalizes caching error through analysis of model output sensitivity to perturbations in noisy latents and timesteps, showing sensitivity predicts caching quality.

entry.title: Time Series Foundation Models as Strong Baselines in Transportation Forecasting: A Large-Scale Benchmark Analysis

author.name: Javier Pulido, Filipe Rodrigues

entry.summary: Evaluates time-series foundation models (specifically Chronos-2) as zero-shot forecasters across ten transportation datasets, finding they deliver state-of-the-art or competitive performance without any task-specific fine-tuning.

entry.title: Chunk-wise Attention Transducers for Fast and Accurate Streaming Speech-to-Text

author.name: Hainan Xu, Vladimir Bataev, Travis M. Bartley, Jagadeesh Balam

entry.summary: Proposes CHAT (Chunk-wise Attention Transducer), extending RNN-T for streaming speech-to-text by processing audio in fixed chunks with cross-attention, achieving up to 46% training memory reduction, 1.36x faster training, and 6.3% relative WER reduction.

entry.title: DARE-bench: Evaluating Modeling and Instruction Fidelity of LLMs in Data Science

author.name: Fan Shu, Yite Wang, Ruofan Wu, Boyi Liu, Zhewei Yao, Yuxiong He, Feng Yan

entry.summary: Introduces DARE-bench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on data science tasks (ML modeling, instruction following) with 6,300 Kaggle-derived tasks and verifiable ground truth, addressing gaps in process-aware evaluation and labeled training data.

entry.title: Fairness under Graph Uncertainty: Achieving Interventional Fairness with Partially Known Causal Graphs over Clusters of Variables

author.name: Yoichi Chikahara

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for achieving interventional fairness using causal graphs over clusters of variables rather than requiring detailed variable-level causal knowledge. Uses minimax optimization over possible adjustment cluster sets to handle graph uncertainty.

entry.title: Demystifying Action Space Design for Robotic Manipulation Policies

author.name: Yuchun Feng, Jinliang Zheng, Zhihao Wang, Dongxiu Liu, Jianxiong Li, Jiangmiao Pang, Tai Wang, Xianyuan Zhan

entry.summary: Conducts a large-scale empirical study on action space design for robotic manipulation policy learning, analyzing temporal and spatial dimensions of action design and their impact on learnability and control stability.

entry.title: Diffusion Probe: Generated Image Result Prediction Using CNN Probes

author.name: Benlei Cui, Bukun Huang, Zhizeng Ye, Xuemei Dong, Tuo Chen, Hui Xue, Dingkang Yang, Longtao Huang, Jingqun Tang, Haiwen Hong

entry.summary: Diffusion Probe reveals strong correlation between early diffusion cross-attention distributions and final image quality, enabling lightweight prediction of image quality from initial denoising steps before full synthesis completes.

entry.title: See, Act, Adapt: Active Perception for Unsupervised Cross-Domain Visual Adaptation via Personalized VLM-Guided Agent

author.name: Tianci Tang, Tielong Cai, Hongwei Wang, Gaoang Wang

entry.summary: Sea² proposes adapting how perception models are deployed rather than the models themselves, using a VLM-guided agent to navigate to informative viewpoints. Keeps all perception modules frozen and requires no downstream labels.

entry.title: ABPolicy: Asynchronous B-Spline Flow Policy for Real-Time and Smooth Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Fan Yang, Peiguang Jing, Kaihua Qu, Ningyuan Zhao, Yuting Su

entry.summary: Proposes ABPolicy, an asynchronous flow-matching policy for robotic manipulation that operates in B-spline control-point space. Addresses intra-chunk jitter, inter-chunk discontinuities, and stop-and-go execution in policy deployment.

entry.title: OPTIAGENT: A Physics-Driven Agentic Framework for Automated Optical Design

author.name: Yuyu Geng, Lei Sun, Yao Gao, Xinxin Hu, Zhonghua Yi, Xiaolong Qian, Weijian Hu, Jian Bai, Kaiwei Wang

entry.summary: OPTIAGENT is the first attempt to employ LLMs in optical lens design, bridging the expertise gap by enabling non-experts to develop functional lens systems. Includes OptiDesignQA dataset and an agentic framework connecting LLMs with optical simulation tools.

entry.title: Hypothesis Testing over Observable Regimes in Singular Models

author.name: Sean Plummer

entry.summary: Addresses hypothesis testing in singular statistical models, showing the fundamental obstruction is not singularity itself but formulating hypotheses on non-identifiable quantities. Demonstrates that hypotheses over identifiable observables reduce to classical testing problems.

entry.title: Single-Nodal Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking in NLP Models

author.name: Shalom Rosner, Ronit D. Gross, Ella Koresh and Ido Kanter

entry.summary: Demonstrates spontaneous symmetry breaking in NLP models during pre-training and fine-tuning at the level of individual attention heads and even single nodes. Shows analogy to phase transitions in statistical mechanics.

entry.title: U-CAN: Utility-Aware Contrastive Attenuation for Efficient Unlearning in Generative Recommendation

author.name: Zezheng Wu, Rui Wang, Xinghe Cheng, Yang Shao, Qing Yang, Jiapu Wang, Jingwei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes U-CAN for machine unlearning in generative recommendation systems, addressing the 'polysemy dilemma' where neurons interleave sensitive data with general reasoning. Uses contrastive attenuation on low-rank adapters for precision unlearning.

entry.title: Learning to Generate Secure Code via Token-Level Rewards

author.name: Jiazheng Quan, Xiaodong Li, Bin Wang, Guo An, Like Liu, Degen Huang, Lin Liu, Chengbin Hou

entry.summary: Proposes Vul2Safe framework for secure code generation using token-level RL rewards. Uses LLM self-reflection to construct repair pairs from real vulnerabilities and introduces SRCode training with token-level security rewards.

entry.title: Uncertainty-aware Language Guidance for Concept Bottleneck Models

author.name: Yangyi Li, Mengdi Huai

entry.summary: Proposes uncertainty-aware language guidance for Concept Bottleneck Models that quantifies and incorporates uncertainty from LLM-annotated concepts, addressing hallucination risks. Introduces mechanisms for uncertainty quantification and uncertainty-aware concept integration.

entry.title: All in One: Unifying Deepfake Detection, Tampering Localization, and Source Tracing with a Robust Landmark-Identity Watermark

author.name: Junjiang Wu, Liejun Wang, Zhiqing Guo

entry.summary: Proposes a unified proactive forensics framework using a 152-dimensional landmark-identity watermark (LIDMark) that jointly addresses deepfake detection, tampering localization, and source tracing in a single system.

entry.title: Planning under Distribution Shifts with Causal POMDPs

author.name: Matteo Ceriscioli, Karthika Mohan

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework for planning under partial observability using causal POMDPs, where distribution shifts are modeled as interventions on the causal structure, enabling identification of changed environment components.

entry.title: Flowette: Flow Matching with Graphette Priors for Graph Generation

author.name: Asiri Wijesinghe, Sevvandi Kandanaarachchi, Daniel M. Steinberg, Cheng Soon Ong

entry.summary: Proposes Flowette, a continuous flow matching framework for graph generation using GNN-based transformers and graphettes, a new probabilistic family of graph structure models that generalize graphons for incorporating structural priors like rings, stars, and trees.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Causal Reasoning for Suicide Ideation Detection Through Online Conversations

author.name: Jun Li, Xiangmeng Wang, Haoyang Li, Yifei Yan, Shijie Zhang, Hong Va Leong, Ling Feng, Nancy Xiaonan Yu, Qing Li
