entry.summary: Proposes MACR, a multi-agent causal reasoning framework for suicide ideation detection in online conversations that uses a Reasoning Agent to scale interactions and a Bias-aware Agent to mitigate hidden influences like conformity and copycat behavior.

entry.title: Selective Denoising Diffusion Model for Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Kohei Obata, Zheng Chen, Yasuko Matsubara, Lingwei Zhu, Yasushi Sakurai

entry.summary: Proposes AnomalyFilter, a diffusion-based time series anomaly detection method that selectively denoises only anomalous parts while retaining normal parts, rather than reconstructing everything from noise.

entry.title: The Compulsory Imaginary: AGI and Corporate Authority

author.name: Emilio Barkett

entry.summary: Analyzes the rhetorical strategies of OpenAI and Anthropic in constructing AGI narratives, identifying four shared operations: self-exemption, teleological naturalization, qualified acknowledgment, and implicit indispensability. Draws on sociotechnical imaginaries framework.

entry.title: Unsupervised Causal Prototypical Networks for De-biased Interpretable Dermoscopy Diagnosis

author.name: Junhao Jia, Yueyi Wu, Huangwei Chen, Haodong Jing, Haishuai Wang, Jiajun Bu, Lei Wu

entry.summary: CausalProto proposes an unsupervised causal prototypical network for dermoscopy diagnosis that disentangles pathological features from environmental confounders using a Structural Causal Model and Information Bottleneck constraint to prevent shortcut learning.

entry.title: Provable Subspace Identification of Nonlinear Multi-view CCA

author.name: Zhiwei Han, Stefan Matthes, Hao Shen

entry.summary: Proves that nonlinear multi-view CCA recovers pairwise correlated signal subspaces up to orthogonal ambiguity under suitable conditions. Establishes finite-sample consistency guarantees for subspace identification.

entry.title: GRAIL: Post-hoc Compensation by Linear Reconstruction for Compressed Networks

author.name: Wenwu Tang, Dong Wang, Lothar Thiele, Olga Saukh

entry.summary: GRAIL proposes a zero-finetuning post-compression compensation method that uses Gram matrices and ridge regression to restore compressed network blocks' input-output behavior, absorbed into existing weights at no inference cost.

entry.title: Action-Geometry Prediction with 3D Geometric Prior for Bimanual Manipulation

author.name: Chongyang Xu, Haipeng Li, Shen Cheng, Jingyu Hu, Haoqiang Fan, Ziliang Feng and Shuaicheng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for bimanual robot manipulation that builds on pretrained 3D geometric foundation models, fusing geometry-aware latents with 2D features and proprioception. Uses diffusion models for smooth coordinated motion generation.

entry.title: OmniTrack: General Motion Tracking via Physics-Consistent Reference

author.name: Yuhan Li, Peiyuan Zhi, Yunshen Wang, Tengyu Liu, Sixu Yan, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang, Baoxiong Jia, Siyuan Huang

entry.summary: OmniTrack decouples physical feasibility from motion tracking for humanoid robots, using a privileged generalist policy in simulation followed by physics-aware refinement for real-world deployment.

entry.title: RUMAD: Reinforcement-Unifying Multi-Agent Debate

author.name: Chao Wang, Han Lin, Huaze Tang, Huijing Lin and Wenbo Ding

entry.summary: RUMAD formulates dynamic communication topology control in multi-agent debate as an RL problem, using content-agnostic observation and multi-objective reward to optimize accuracy, consensus, and efficiency simultaneously.

entry.title: AoE: Always-on Egocentric Human Video Collection for Embodied AI

author.name: Bowen Yang, Zishuo Li, Yang Sun, Changtao Miao, Yifan Yang, Man Luo, Xiaotong Yan, Feng Jiang, Jinchuan Shi, Yankai Fu, Ning Chen, Junkai Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Guocai Yao, Shanghang Zhang, Hao Chen, Zhe Li, and Kai Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces AoE, a data collection system using smartphones and human agents to gather large-scale egocentric real-world interaction data for embodied AI. Aims to reduce hardware costs and scale data collection globally.

entry.title: SwitchCraft: Training-Free Multi-Event Video Generation with Attention Controls

author.name: Qianxun Xu, Chenxi Song, Yujun Cai, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SwitchCraft, a training-free framework for multi-event video generation that aligns frame-level attention with event prompts (EAQS) and automatically balances event strength (ABSS).

entry.title: GuardAlign: Test-time Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Xingyu Zhu, Beier Zhu, Junfeng Fang, Shuo Wang, Yin Zhang, Xiang Wang, Xiangnan He

entry.summary: Proposes GuardAlign, a training-free defense for LVLMs using optimal transport-based safety detection and cross-modal attentive calibration to identify and mitigate unsafe image content.

entry.title: Terminology Rarity Predicts Catastrophic Failure in LLM Translation of Low-Resource Ancient Languages: Evidence from Ancient Greek

author.name: James L. Zainaldin, Cameron Pattison, Manuela Marai, Jacob Wu, Mark J. Schiefsky

entry.summary: First systematic human evaluation of LLM translation quality for Ancient Greek technical prose, finding that terminology rarity is a strong predictor of catastrophic translation failure. Evaluates Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT on Galen's medical texts with domain expert assessment.

entry.title: HumanOrbit: 3D Human Reconstruction as 360{\deg} Orbit Generation

author.name: Keito Suzuki, Kunyao Chen, Lei Wang, Bang Du, Runfa Blark Li, Peng Liu, Ning Bi, Truong Nguyen

entry.summary: Presents HumanOrbit, a video diffusion model that generates a full 360° orbit video around a person from a single image, enabling 3D human reconstruction with identity-preserving novel views via a reconstruction pipeline.

entry.title: Task-Centric Acceleration of Small-Language Models

author.name: Dor Tsur, Sharon Adar, Ran Levy

entry.summary: Proposes TASC, a framework for accelerating small language models through task-adaptive sequence compression: TASC-ft enriches the tokenizer with high-frequency output n-grams during fine-tuning, while TASC-spec provides training-free speculative decoding using n-gram draft models.

entry.title: Flow-Based Density Ratio Estimation for Intractable Distributions with Applications in Genomics

author.name: Egor Antipov, Alessandro Palma, Lorenzo Consoli, Stephan G\"unnemann, Andrea Dittadi, Fabian J. Theis

entry.summary: Leverages condition-aware flow matching to derive a single dynamical formulation for tracking density ratios between intractable distributions along generative trajectories. Applied to genomics for comparing sample likelihoods across conditions.

entry.title: SafeGen-LLM: Enhancing Safety Generalization in Task Planning for Robotic Systems

author.name: Jialiang Fan, Weizhe Xu, Mengyu Liu, Oleg Sokolsky, Insup Lee, Fangxin Kong

entry.summary: Proposes SafeGen-LLM for safety-generalizable robot task planning using LLMs, combining supervised fine-tuning on constraint-compliant PDDL3 plans with GRPO reinforcement learning to generalize safety constraints to novel properties and domains.

entry.title: A Minimal Agent for Automated Theorem Proving

author.name: Borja Requena Pozo, Austin Letson, Krystian Nowakowski, Izan Beltran Ferreiro, Leopoldo Sarra

entry.summary: Proposes a minimal agentic baseline for automated theorem proving that implements core features (iterative proof refinement, library search, context management) and demonstrates competitive performance with state-of-the-art while using simpler architecture.

entry.title: Unlocking Cognitive Capabilities and Analyzing the Perception-Logic Trade-off

author.name: Longyin Zhang, Shuo Sun, Yingxu He, Won Cheng Yi Lewis, Muhammad Huzaifah Bin Md Shahrin, Hardik Bhupendra Sailor, Heng Meng Jeremy Wong, Tarun Kumar Vangani, Yi Ma, Qiongqiong Wang, Minh Duc Pham, Ridong Jiang, Jingtao Li, Jingyi Liao, Zhuohan Liu, Yanfeng Lu, Manas Gupta and Ai Ti Aw

entry.summary: Introduces MERaLiON2-Omni, a 10B multilingual omni-perception model for Southeast Asia that explicitly decouples and integrates System 1 (perception) and System 2 (reasoning) capabilities through progressive training, including region-specific audio-visual alignment.

entry.title: Experience-Guided Self-Adaptive Cascaded Agents for Breast Cancer Screening and Diagnosis with Reduced Biopsy Referrals

author.name: Pramit Saha, Mohammad Alsharid, Joshua Strong, J. Alison Noble

entry.summary: Proposes BUSD-Agent, a cascaded multi-agent framework for breast ultrasound screening that aims to reduce unnecessary biopsy referrals. Uses a lightweight screening agent to filter benign cases before escalating to a diagnostic agent.

entry.title: MuViT: Multi-Resolution Vision Transformers for Learning Across Scales in Microscopy

author.name: Albert Dominguez Mantes, Gioele La Manno, Martin Weigert

entry.summary: Introduces MuViT, a transformer architecture for microscopy that fuses true multi-resolution observations in a shared world-coordinate system using extended rotary positional embeddings, enabling attention to integrate wide-field context with high-resolution detail.

entry.title: Operationalizing Longitudinal Causal Discovery Under Real-World Workflow Constraints

author.name: Tadahisa Okuda, Shohei Shimizu, Thong Pham, Tatsuyoshi Ikenoue, Shingo Fukuma

entry.summary: Addresses the gap between causal discovery theory and operational deployment by characterizing workflow-induced constraints for longitudinal causal discovery. Shows that encoding protocol-derived structural masks reduces structural ambiguity in mixed discrete-continuous panel data.

entry.title: MemEmo: Evaluating Emotion in Memory Systems of Agents

author.name: Peng Liu, Zhen Tao, Jihao Zhao, Ding Chen, Yansong Zhang, Cuiping Li, Zhiyu Li, Hong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes MemEmo, a benchmark evaluating how well LLM memory systems handle emotion-related information across extraction, updating, and QA dimensions. Finds no current system achieves robust performance across all emotional dimensions.

entry.title: General Bayesian Policy Learning

author.name: Masahiro Kato

entry.summary: Proposes a General Bayes framework for policy learning that reformulates welfare maximization as a squared-loss surrogate problem. Shows equivalence between empirical welfare maximization and scaled squared error minimization with regularization.

entry.title: Stereo-Talker: Audio-driven 3D Human Synthesis with Prior-Guided Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Xiang Deng, Youxin Pang, Xiaochen Zhao, Chao Xu, Lizhen Wang, Hongjiang Xiao, Shi Yan, Hongwen Zhang, Yebin Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Stereo-Talker, a one-shot audio-driven system generating 3D talking videos with lip sync, body gestures, and viewpoint control. Uses LLM priors for motion diversity and a Mixture-of-Experts mechanism for video generation.

entry.title: Enhancing CLIP Robustness via Cross-Modality Alignment

author.name: Xingyu Zhu, Beier Zhu, Shuo Wang, Kesen Zhao, Hanwang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes COLA, an optimal transport-based framework for enhancing CLIP robustness against adversarial perturbations by restoring image-text alignment and local structural consistency in feature space.

entry.title: Hello-Chat: Towards Realistic Social Audio Interactions

author.name: Yueran Hou, Peilei Jia, Zihan Sun, Qihang Lu, Wenbing Yang, Yingming Gao, Ya Li, Jun Gao

entry.summary: Introduces Hello-Chat, an end-to-end audio language model for realistic social conversation, trained on real-life conversation data with modality-interleaved training. Achieves SOTA on audio understanding while generating more natural, expressive speech.

entry.title: Refining Almost-Safe Value Functions on the Fly

author.name: Sander Tonkens and Sosuke Kojima and Chenhao Liu and Judy Masri and Sylvia Herbert

entry.summary: Introduces refineCBF and HJ-Patch methods for refining approximate Control Barrier Functions via warm-started Hamilton-Jacobi reachability, bridging offline synthesis and online adaptation for robot safety. Both methods guarantee recovery of safe value functions with monotonic improvement.

entry.title: Spiky Rank and Its Applications to Rigidity and Circuits

author.name: Lianna Hambardzumyan, Konstantin Myasnikov, Artur Riazanov, Morgan Shirley, Adi Shraibman

entry.summary: Introduces spiky rank, a new matrix parameter combining combinatorial block structure with linear-algebraic flexibility. Shows large spiky rank implies high matrix rigidity and yields lower bounds for depth-2 ReLU circuits.

entry.title: SegReg: Latent Space Regularization for Improved Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Puru Vaish, Amin Ranem, Felix Meister, Tobias Heimann, Christoph Brune and Jelmer M. Wolterink

entry.summary: Proposes SegReg, a latent-space regularization framework for U-Net segmentation models that encourages structured embeddings in feature maps. Demonstrates consistent improvements in domain generalization and continual learning on medical imaging tasks.

entry.title: LE-NeuS: Latency-Efficient Neuro-Symbolic Video Understanding via Adaptive Temporal Verification

author.name: Shawn Liang, Sahil Shah, Chengwei Zhou, SP Sharan, Harsh Goel, Arnab Sanyal, Sandeep Chinchali, Gourav Datta

entry.summary: Presents LE-NeuS, a latency-efficient neuro-symbolic framework for long-form video QA that preserves accuracy of temporal logic-guided methods while drastically reducing inference latency through CLIP-guided adaptive temporal sampling and parallel verification.

entry.title: Evidential Neural Radiance Fields

author.name: Ruxiao Duan and Alex Wong

entry.summary: Introduces Evidential Neural Radiance Fields, integrating evidential deep learning with NeRF to jointly estimate aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty without compromising rendering quality or incurring major computational overhead.

entry.title: BRIDGE the Gap: Mitigating Bias Amplification in Automated Scoring of English Language Learners via Inter-group Data Augmentation

author.name: Yun Wang, Xuansheng Wu, Jingyuan Huang, Lei Liu, Xiaoming Zhai, Ninghao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes BRIDGE, a data augmentation method to mitigate bias amplification in automated scoring of English Language Learners by generating inter-group samples that bridge majority and minority linguistic patterns.

entry.title: Egocentric Visibility-Aware Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Peng Dai, Yu Zhang, Yiqiang Feng, Zhen Fan, Yang Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Eva-3M, a large-scale egocentric HPE dataset with 3M+ frames and 435K visibility-annotated frames, along with a visibility-aware framework that disentangles visible and invisible keypoint estimation.

entry.title: BTTackler: A Diagnosis-based Framework for Efficient Deep Learning Hyperparameter Optimization

author.name: Zhongyi Pei, Zhiyao Cen, Yipeng Huang, Chen Wang, Lin Liu, Philip Yu, Mingsheng Long

entry.summary: Proposes BTTackler, a diagnosis-based hyperparameter optimization framework that detects training problems (vanishing gradients, poor convergence) early to avoid wasting compute on bad configurations.

entry.title: AudioCapBench: Quick Evaluation on Audio Captioning across Sound, Music, and Speech

author.name: Jielin Qiu, Jianguo Zhang, Zixiang Chen, Liangwei Yang, Ming Zhu, Juntao Tan, Haolin Chen, Wenting Zhao, Rithesh Murthy, Roshan Ram, Akshara Prabhakar, Shelby Heinecke, Caiming, Xiong, Silvio Savarese, Huan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces AudioCapBench, a benchmark for evaluating audio captioning across sound, music, and speech with 1000 samples. Evaluates 13 models from OpenAI and Google Gemini, finding Gemini 3 Pro achieves highest overall scores.

entry.title: Geodesic Semantic Search: Learning Local Riemannian Metrics for Citation Graph Retrieval

author.name: Brandon Yee, Lucas Wang, Kundana Kommini, Krishna Sharma

entry.summary: Presents Geodesic Semantic Search (GSS), learning node-specific Riemannian metrics on citation graphs for geometry-aware retrieval, achieving 23% improvement in Recall@20 over SPECTER+FAISS baselines.

entry.title: SLA-Aware Distributed LLM Inference Across Device-RAN-Cloud

author.name: Hariz Yet, Nguyen Thanh Tam, Mao V. Ngo, Lim Yi Shen, Lin Wei, Jihong Park, Binbin Chen, and Tony Q. S. Quek

entry.summary: Reports measurements from a 5G AI-RAN testbed for distributed LLM inference across device, RAN-edge, and cloud tiers. Finds on-device execution fails sub-second budgets, while quantized models at RAN-edge can meet 0.5s deadlines.

entry.title: MAGE: Multi-scale Autoregressive Generation for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chenxing Lin, Xinhui Gao, Haipeng Zhang, Xinran Li, Haitao Wang, Songzhu Mei, Chenglu Wen, Weiquan Liu, Siqi Shen, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: MAGE proposes multi-scale autoregressive generation for offline RL, using a condition-guided multi-scale autoencoder to capture temporal structure at different scales for long-horizon tasks with sparse rewards.

entry.title: Footprint-Guided Exemplar-Free Continual Histopathology Report Generation

author.name: Pratibha Kumari, Daniel Reisenb\"uchler, Afshin Bozorgpour, yousef Sadegheih, Priyankar Choudhary, Dorit Merhof

entry.summary: Introduces an exemplar-free continual learning framework for whole-slide image report generation that avoids storing raw slides by using compact domain footprints (morphology codebooks and slide-level summaries) for generative replay.

entry.title: GLUScope: A Tool for Analyzing GLU Neurons in Transformer Language Models

author.name: Sebastian Gerstner and Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: GLUScope is an open-source tool for analyzing GLU neurons in transformer language models, examining all four sign combinations of gate and input activations in SwiGLU architectures and showing distinct functionalities.

entry.title: FedNSAM:Consistency of Local and Global Flatness for Federated Learning

author.name: Junkang Liu, Fanhua Shang, Yuxuan Tian, Hongying Liu, Yuanyuan Liu

entry.summary: FedNSAM addresses the gap between local and global flatness in federated learning by defining flatness distance and proposing an algorithm that ensures local SAM optimization actually improves global model generalization.

entry.title: Hybrid Offline-Online Reinforcement Learning for Sensorless, High-Precision Force Regulation in Surgical Robotic Grasping

author.name: Edoardo Fazzari, Omar Mohamed, Khalfan Hableel, Hamdan Alhadhrami, Cesare Stefanini

entry.summary: Presents a sensorless surgical grasping force control framework combining a physics-consistent digital twin of the da Vinci Xi with hybrid offline-online RL, achieving high-precision distal force regulation without distal force sensors.

entry.title: A Theory of Random Graph Shift in Truncated-Spectrum vRKHS

author.name: Zhang Wan, Tingting Mu, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Develops a theoretical framework for graph classification under domain shift using random graph models and truncated-spectrum vRKHS. Provides fine-grained analysis connecting graph generative processes to hypothesis complexity.

entry.title: Enhancing Vision-Language Navigation with Multimodal Event Knowledge from Real-World Indoor Tour Videos

author.name: Haoxuan Xu, Tianfu Li, Wenbo Chen, Yi Liu, Xingxing Zuo, Yaoxian Song, Haoang Li

entry.summary: Proposes an event-centric knowledge enhancement strategy for Vision-Language Navigation using YE-KG, the first large-scale multimodal spatiotemporal knowledge graph derived from real-world indoor videos.

entry.title: AHAP: Reconstructing Arbitrary Humans from Arbitrary Perspectives with Geometric Priors

author.name: Xiaozhen Qiao, Wenjia Wang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Jiacheng Sun, Ping Luo, Hongyuan Zhang, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Presents AHAP, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing 3D humans from arbitrary camera perspectives without camera calibration, using cross-view identity association and multi-view geometry fusion.

entry.title: Intrinsic Lorentz Neural Network

author.name: Xianglong Shi, Ziheng Chen, Yunhan Jiang, Nicu Sebe

entry.summary: Proposes Intrinsic Lorentz Neural Network (ILNN), a fully intrinsic hyperbolic architecture that conducts all computations within the Lorentz model, avoiding mixing Euclidean and hyperbolic operations.

entry.title: Accelerating Masked Image Generation by Learning Latent Controlled Dynamics

author.name: Kaiwen Zhu, Quansheng Zeng, Yuandong Pu, Shuo Cao, Xiaohui Li, Yi Xin, Qi Qin, Jiayang Li, Yu Qiao, Jinjin Gu, Yihao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a method to accelerate masked image generation models by learning a lightweight model that regresses feature velocity fields, incorporating both previous features and sampled tokens to reduce redundant computation.

entry.title: Spatio-Temporal Garment Reconstruction Using Diffusion Mapping via Pattern Coordinates

author.name: Yingxuan You, Ren Li, Corentin Dumery, Cong Cao, Hao Li, Pascal Fua

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for 3D garment reconstruction from images and videos using Implicit Sewing Patterns with diffusion model priors in UV space, establishing pixel-to-UV-to-3D correspondences.

entry.title: Data Driven Optimization of GPU efficiency for Distributed LLM Adapter Serving

author.name: Ferran Agullo, Joan Oliveras, Chen Wang, Alberto Gutierrez-Torre, Olivier Tardieu, Alaa Youssef, Jordi Torres, Josep Ll. Berral

entry.summary: Presents a data-driven pipeline for optimizing GPU efficiency in distributed LLM adapter serving, computing adapter placements that minimize GPU usage while avoiding starvation and memory errors.

entry.title: GeoDiff4D: Geometry-Aware Diffusion for 4D Head Avatar Reconstruction

author.name: Chao Xu, Xiaochen Zhao, Xiang Deng, Jingxiang Sun, Zhuo Su, Donglin Di, Yebin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes GeoDiff4D for reconstructing animatable 4D head avatars from a single portrait image using geometry-aware diffusion that jointly synthesizes portrait images and surface normals, with a pose-free expression encoder and 3D Gaussian-based rendering.

entry.title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Large-Scale Tote Allocation in Human-Robot Collaborative Fulfillment Centers

author.name: Sikata Sengupta, Guangyi Liu, Omer Gottesman, Joseph W Durham, Michael Kearns, Aaron Roth, Michael Caldara

entry.summary: Formulates tote allocation in human-robot fulfillment centers as a large-scale multi-objective RL problem, using minimax policy learning based on recent constrained RL theory. Evaluated on real Amazon fulfillment center data.

entry.title: A multimodal slice discovery framework for systematic failure detection and explanation in medical image classification

author.name: Yixuan Liu, Kanwal K. Bhatia, Ahmed E. Fetit

entry.summary: Introduces the first automated multimodal slice discovery framework for auditing medical image classifiers, extending slice discovery methods to multimodal representations for systematic failure detection and explanation in medical applications.

entry.title: Adaptive Combinatorial Experimental Design: Pareto Optimality for Decision-Making and Inference

author.name: Hongrui Xie and Junyu Cao and Kan Xu

entry.summary: Provides the first investigation into adaptive combinatorial experimental design, formalizing the trade-off between regret minimization and statistical power in combinatorial MABs through Pareto optimality, with algorithms for full-bandit and semi-bandit feedback.

entry.title: Uncovering Physical Drivers of Dark Matter Halo Structures with Auxiliary-Variable-Guided Generative Models

author.name: Arkaprabha Ganguli and Anirban Samaddar and Florian K\'eruzor\'e and Nesar Ramachandra and Julie Bessac and Sandeep Madireddy and Emil Constantinescu

entry.summary: Presents an auxiliary-variable-guided framework for disentangling latent representations of dark matter halo thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich maps using deep generative models. The Disentangled Latent-CFM model recovers known mass-concentration scaling relations and identifies physical outliers.

entry.title: Refining Few-Step Text-to-Multiview Diffusion via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ziyi Zhang, Li Shen, Deheng Ye, Yong Luo, Huangxuan Zhao, Lefei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an RL finetuning framework for few-step text-to-multiview diffusion models, reformulating denoising across all views as a single MDP. Introduces ZMV-Sampling for improved view consistency at inference time.

entry.title: Geometric-Photometric Event-based 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing

author.name: Kai Kohyama, Yoshimitsu Aoki, Guillermo Gallego, Shintaro Shiba

entry.summary: Proposes a framework combining event cameras with 3D Gaussian Splatting, decoupling geometry rendering (ray-tracing per event) from radiance rendering (snapshot-based) to address the accuracy-temporal resolution tradeoff.

entry.title: Reason to Contrast: A Cascaded Multimodal Retrieval Framework

author.name: Xuanming Cui, Hong-You Chen, Hao Yu, Hao Yuan, Zihao Wang, Shlok Kumar Mishra, Hanchao Yu, Yonghuan Yang, Jun Xiao, Ser-Nam Lim, Jianpeng Cheng, Qi Guo, Xiangjun Fan

entry.summary: Proposes TTE-v2, a hybrid multimodal retrieval framework that extends reasoning-driven retrieval by introducing reasoning-based reranking that scales with input token budget rather than model size. Uses fine-grained supervision for hard negative mining.

entry.title: Leveraging large multimodal models for audio-video deepfake detection: a pilot study

author.name: Songjun Cao (1), Yuqi Li (1 and 2), Yunpeng Luo (1), Jianjun Yin (2), Long Ma (1) ((1) Tencent YouTu Lab, China, (2) Fudan University, China)

entry.summary: Introduces AV-LMMDetect, a supervised fine-tuned large multimodal model for audio-visual deepfake detection, built on Qwen 2.5 Omni. Frames detection as prompted yes/no classification and achieves SOTA on Mavos-DD.

entry.title: DesignSense: A Human Preference Dataset and Reward Modeling Framework for Graphic Layout Generation

author.name: Varun Gopal, Rishabh Jain, Aradhya Mathur, Nikitha SR, Sohan Patnaik, Sudhir Yarram, Mayur Hemani, Balaji Krishnamurthy, Mausoom Sarkar

entry.summary: Introduces DesignSense-10k, a large-scale dataset of 10,235 human-annotated preference pairs for graphic layout evaluation, along with reward models trained for layout quality assessment.

entry.title: FedDAG: Clustered Federated Learning via Global Data and Gradient Integration for Heterogeneous Environments

author.name: Anik Pramanik, Murat Kantarcioglu, Vincent Oria, Shantanu Sharma

entry.summary: Proposes FedDAG, a clustered federated learning framework that integrates both data and gradient similarity metrics for client clustering, and enables cross-cluster knowledge sharing to improve model quality.

entry.title: Few-Shot Continual Learning for 3D Brain MRI with Frozen Foundation Models

author.name: Chi-Sheng Chen and Xinyu Zhang and Guan-Ying Chen and Qiuzhe Xie and Fan Zhang and En-Jui Kuo

entry.summary: Addresses few-shot continual learning for 3D brain MRI by combining frozen pretrained backbones with task-specific LoRA adapters, eliminating catastrophic forgetting by design while maintaining performance on sequential tasks.

entry.title: VCA: Vision-Click-Action Framework for Precise Manipulation of Segmented Objects in Target Ambiguous Environments

author.name: Donggeon Kim, Seungwon Jan, Hyeonjun Park and Daegyu Lim

entry.summary: Proposes Vision-Click-Action (VCA), replacing language commands in VLA models with click-based visual selection using pretrained segmentation models, reducing ambiguity in environments with visually similar objects.

entry.title: Hyperdimensional Cross-Modal Alignment of Frozen Language and Image Models for Efficient Image Captioning

author.name: Abhishek Dalvi, Vasant Honavar

entry.summary: Introduces HDFLIM, a framework using hyperdimensional computing to align frozen pretrained vision and language models for image captioning without any model fine-tuning, establishing cross-modal mappings in high-dimensional spaces.

entry.title: DLEBench: Evaluating Small-scale Object Editing Ability for Instruction-based Image Editing Model

author.name: Shibo Hong, Boxian Ai, Jun Kuang, Wei Wang, FengJiao Chen, Zhongyuan Peng, Chenhao Huang, Yixin Cao

entry.summary: Introduces DLEBench, the first benchmark specifically for evaluating instruction-based image editing models on small-scale objects (1-10% of image area), revealing significant performance gaps in current models.

entry.title: MMKG-RDS: Reasoning Data Synthesis via Deep Mining of Multimodal Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Lun Zhan, Feng Xiong, Huanyong Liu, Feng Zhang, Yuhui Yin

entry.summary: Proposes MMKG-RDS, a framework for reasoning data synthesis leveraging multimodal knowledge graphs with fine-grained knowledge extraction, customizable path sampling, and quality scoring. Validates on a 14,950-sample benchmark across 5 domains with Qwen3 models.

entry.title: ProtoDCS: Towards Robust and Efficient Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Wei Luo, Yangfan Ou, Jin Deng, Zeshuai Deng, Xiquan Yan, Zhiquan Wen, and Mingkui Tan

entry.summary: Proposes ProtoDCS for robust open-set test-time adaptation of VLMs, addressing the challenge of simultaneously adapting to in-distribution shifts while rejecting out-of-distribution samples during deployment.

entry.title: SpikingTac: A Miniaturized Neuromorphic Visuotactile Sensor for High-Precision Dynamic Tactile Imprint Tracking

author.name: Tianyu Jiang, Chaofan Zhang, Shaolin Zhang, Shaowei Cui, and Shuo Wang

entry.summary: Presents SpikingTac, a miniaturized neuromorphic tactile sensor with custom event camera module (<$150 cost), achieving 1000Hz perception and 350Hz tracking with hysteresis-aware update mechanisms.

entry.title: Towards Source-Aware Object Swapping with Initial Noise Perturbation

author.name: Jiahui Zhan, Xianbing Sun, Xiangnan Zhu, Yikun Ji, Ruitong Liu, Liqing Zhang, Jianfu Zhang

entry.summary: SourceSwap proposes a self-supervised object swapping framework that synthesizes pseudo training pairs via frequency-separated perturbation in initial-noise space, enabling cross-object alignment without per-object finetuning or paired data.

entry.title: Breaking the Data Barrier: Robust Few-Shot 3D Vessel Segmentation using Foundation Models

author.name: Kirato Yoshihara, Yohei Sugawara, Yuta Tokuoka, Lihang Hong

entry.summary: Proposes a few-shot 3D vessel segmentation framework leveraging DINOv3 foundation model with lightweight 3D adapters and Z-channel embedding to bridge 2D pretraining and 3D medical imaging, enabling segmentation from limited annotated data.

entry.title: Enhancing Continual Learning for Software Vulnerability Prediction: Addressing Catastrophic Forgetting via Hybrid-Confidence-Aware Selective Replay for Temporal LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Xuhui Dou, Hayretdin Bahsi, Alejandro Guerra-Manzanares

entry.summary: Proposes Hybrid Class-Aware Selective Replay (Hybrid-CASR) for continual fine-tuning of LLMs on vulnerability detection, organized into temporal windows from CVE data spanning 2018-2024. Addresses temporal distribution shift in security.

entry.title: TSC: Topology-Conditioned Stackelberg Coordination for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Interactive Driving

author.name: Xiaotong Zhang, Gang Xiong, Yuanjing Wang, Siyu Teng, Alois Knoll, Long Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Topology-conditioned Stackelberg Coordination (TSC) for multi-agent RL in interactive driving. Uses topological analysis of conflict points and Stackelberg game structure for decentralized coordination under partial observability.

entry.title: The Geometry of Transfer: Unlocking Medical Vision Manifolds for Training-Free Model Ranking

author.name: Jiaqi Tang, Shaoyang Zhang, Xiaoqi Wang, Jiaying Zhou, Yang Liu, and Qingchao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a topology-driven framework for training-free model ranking of medical foundation models for segmentation tasks. Introduces metrics based on MSTs and topological analysis to evaluate manifold tractability.

entry.title: CC-VQA: Conflict- and Correlation-Aware Method for Mitigating Knowledge Conflict in Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering

author.name: Yuyang Hong, Jiaqi Gu, Yujin Lou, Lubin Fan, Qi Yang, Ying Wang, Kun Ding, Yue Wu, Shiming Xiang, Jieping Ye

entry.summary: Proposes CC-VQA to address knowledge conflicts in knowledge-based VQA between static parametric knowledge and dynamically retrieved information. Considers visual information's role in conflicts and handles redundant contexts.

entry.title: Pessimistic Auxiliary Policy for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Fan Zhang, Baoru Huang, Xin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a pessimistic auxiliary policy for offline RL that samples reliable actions by maximizing the lower confidence bound of Q-functions, reducing approximation errors from out-of-distribution actions.

entry.title: Ordinal Diffusion Models for Color Fundus Images

author.name: Gustav Schmidt, Philipp Berens, Sarah M\"uller

entry.summary: Proposes an ordinal latent diffusion model for generating color fundus images that explicitly incorporates ordered disease severity structure (diabetic retinopathy), using scalar conditioning rather than categorical.

entry.title: SR3R: Rethinking Super-Resolution 3D Reconstruction With Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Xiang Feng, Xiangbo Wang, Tieshi Zhong, Chengkai Wang, Yiting Zhao, Tianxiang Xu, Zhenzhong Kuang, Feiwei Qin, Xuefei Yin, Yanming Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SR3R, reformulating 3D super-resolution as a direct feed-forward mapping from sparse LR views to HR 3D Gaussian Splatting representations, enabling cross-scene generalization and real-time usability.

entry.title: Steering and Rectifying Latent Representation Manifolds in Frozen Multi-modal LLMs for Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Zhaolin Cai, Fan Li, Huiyu Duan, Lijun He, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Proposes SteerVAD, which actively steers and rectifies internal representations of frozen MLLMs for video anomaly detection, going beyond passive reading of representations.

entry.title: Quant Experts: Token-aware Adaptive Error Reconstruction with Mixture of Experts for Large Vision-Language Models Quantization

author.name: Chenwei Jia, Baoting Li, Xuchong Zhang, Mingzhuo Wei, Bochen Lin, Hongbin Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Quant Experts (QE), a token-aware adaptive error compensation framework using mixture of experts for post-training quantization of vision-language models, handling variable channel distributions across modalities and tokens.

entry.title: EvalMVX: A Unified Benchmarking for Neural 3D Reconstruction under Diverse Multiview Setups

author.name: Zaiyan Yang, Jieji Ren, Xiangyi Wang, zonglin li, Xu Cao, Heng Guo, Zhanyu Ma, Boxin Shi

entry.summary: Introduces EvalMVX, a real-world dataset with 25 objects captured under 20 views and 17 lighting conditions with polarized camera, enabling unified benchmarking of MVS, MVPS, and MVSfP techniques.

entry.title: Multimodal Optimal Transport for Unsupervised Temporal Segmentation in Surgical Robotics

author.name: Omar Mohamed, Edoardo Fazzari, Ayah Al-Naji, Hamdan Alhadhrami, Khalfan Hableel, Saif Alkindi, Cesare Stefanini

entry.summary: Proposes TASOT, an unsupervised method for surgical phase recognition that formulates temporal action segmentation as a multimodal optimal transport problem, questioning whether large-scale pre-training on thousands of labeled surgical videos is truly necessary.

entry.title: CoME: Empowering Channel-of-Mobile-Experts with Informative Hybrid-Capabilities Reasoning

author.name: Yuxuan Liu, Weikai Xu, Kun Huang, Changyu Chen, Jiankun Zhao, Pengzhi Gao, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Shuo Shang, Bo Du, Ji-Rong Wen, Rui Yan

entry.summary: Proposes CoME, a mobile agent architecture with four specialized experts for different reasoning stages (screen summary, subtask planning, action decision, action function), using output-oriented activation and a progressive training strategy.

entry.title: Efficient Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimators for Two-Phase Design Problems

author.name: Sky Qiu, Susan Gruber, Pamela A. Shaw, Brian D. Williamson, Mark J. van der Laan

entry.summary: Develops efficient targeted maximum likelihood estimators (TMLE) for two-phase study designs where additional variables are measured on a subsample. Introduces new estimators and provides theory for their efficiency properties.

entry.title: Scaling Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding to More Realistic Settings: Research Challenges and Opportunities

author.name: He Jiang, Yulun Zhang, Rishi Veerapaneni, Jiaoyang Li

entry.summary: Presents the winning approach to the 2023 League of Robot Runners LMAPF competition and outlines research challenges for scaling lifelong multi-agent path finding to realistic settings with 10,000+ agents.

entry.title: From Volume Rendering to 3D Gaussian Splatting: Theory and Applications

author.name: Vitor Pereira Matias, Daniel Perazzo, Vinicius Silva, Alberto Raposo, Luiz Velho, Afonso Paiva, and Tiago Novello

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive tutorial on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), covering the pipeline from splatting formulation through addressing limitations (memory, baked lighting, secondary rays) and surveying applications.

entry.title: Pacing Opinion Polarization via Graph Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Mingkai Liao

entry.summary: Proposes PACIFIER, a graph reinforcement learning framework for sequential opinion polarization moderation in social networks. Reformulates polarization intervention as sequential decision-making over graph-structured data.

entry.title: SALIENT: Frequency-Aware Paired Diffusion for Controllable Long-Tail CT Detection

author.name: Yifan Li, Mehrdad Salimitari, Taiyu Zhang, Guang Li, David Dreizin

entry.summary: Introduces SALIENT, a mask-conditioned wavelet-domain diffusion framework for synthesizing paired lesion volumes for CT augmentation in long-tail medical imaging scenarios. Operates in wavelet space to separate brightness from structural details.

entry.title: BiKA: Kolmogorov-Arnold-Network-inspired Ultra Lightweight Neural Network Hardware Accelerator

author.name: Yuhao Liu, Salim Ullah, Akash Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes BiKA, a binarized neural network accelerator inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks that replaces nonlinear functions with binary learnable thresholds. Achieves 27% hardware resource reduction on FPGA with competitive accuracy.

entry.title: IDP Accelerator: Agentic Document Intelligence from Extraction to Compliance Validation

author.name: Md Mofijul Islam, Md Sirajus Salekin, Joe King, Priyashree Roy, Vamsi Thilak Gudi, Spencer Romo, Akhil Nooney, Boyi Xie, Bob Strahan, Diego A. Socolinsky

entry.summary: Presents IDP Accelerator, an agentic AI framework for end-to-end document intelligence including splitting, extraction, analytics, and compliance validation. Introduces DocSplit benchmark and integrates multimodal LLMs with MCP-compliant analytics.

entry.title: TaCarla: A comprehensive benchmarking dataset for end-to-end autonomous driving

author.name: Tugrul Gorgulu, Atakan Dag, M. Esat Kalfaoglu, Halil Ibrahim Kuru, Baris Can Cam, Ozsel Kilinc

entry.summary: Introduces TaCarla, a comprehensive benchmarking dataset for end-to-end autonomous driving in CARLA that combines perception and planning data with behavioral diversity and closed-loop evaluation support.

entry.title: France or Spain or Germany or France: A Neural Account of Non-Redundant Redundant Disjunctions

author.name: Sasha Boguraev, Qing Yao, Kyle Mahowald

entry.summary: Provides a neural mechanistic account of why redundant disjunctions (e.g., 'France or Spain or Germany or France') become acceptable in certain contexts. Shows this arises from contextual binding and Transformer induction head mechanisms.

entry.title: Rudder: Steering Prefetching in Distributed GNN Training using LLM Agents

author.name: Aishwarya Sarkar, Sayan Ghosh, Nathan Tallent, Aman Chadha, Tanya Roosta, Ali Jannesari

entry.summary: Introduces Rudder, which uses LLM agents to autonomously steer prefetching of remote graph nodes in distributed GNN training, adapting to dynamic conditions rather than using static heuristics.

entry.title: CycleBEV: Regularizing View Transformation Networks via View Cycle Consistency for Bird's-Eye-View Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Jeongbin Hong, Dooseop Choi, Taeg-Hyun An, Kyounghwan An, Kyoung-Wook Min

entry.summary: Proposes CycleBEV, a regularization framework using cycle consistency between perspective and bird's-eye views to improve BEV semantic segmentation for autonomous driving, with an inverse view transformation network.

entry.title: LLM-Driven Multi-Turn Task-Oriented Dialogue Synthesis for Realistic Reasoning

author.name: Yu Zhu, Kai Yang

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-driven framework for synthesizing realistic multi-turn task-oriented dialogues that incorporate complex reasoning, domain constraints, and operational rules to better evaluate LLM reasoning in practical contexts.

entry.title: On the Convergence of Single-Loop Stochastic Bilevel Optimization with Approximate Implicit Differentiation

author.name: Yubo Zhou, Luo Luo, Guang Dai, Haishan Ye

entry.summary: Provides refined convergence analysis for single-loop stochastic bilevel optimization (SSAID algorithm), proving epsilon-stationary point convergence and making explicit the dependence on the lower-level condition number.

entry.title: BuildAnyPoint: 3D Building Structured Abstraction from Diverse Point Clouds

author.name: Tongyan Hua, Haoran Gong, Yuan Liu, Di Wang, Ying-Cong Chen, Wufan Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces BuildAnyPoint, a generative framework for structured 3D building reconstruction from diverse point clouds using a Loosely Cascaded Diffusion Transformer that recovers distributions from noisy/sparse points.

entry.title: 3D Modality-Aware Pre-training for Vision-Language Model in MRI Multi-organ Abnormality Detection

author.name: Haowen Zhu, Ning Yin, Xiaogen Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes MedMAP, a medical modality-aware pretraining framework for 3D MRI that enhances vision-language alignment through modality-aware encoders and fine-tunes for multi-organ abnormality detection.

entry.title: ProductResearch: Training E-Commerce Deep Research Agents via Multi-Agent Synthetic Trajectory Distillation

author.name: Jiangyuan Wang, Kejun Xiao, Huaipeng Zhao, Tao Luo, Xiaoyi Zeng

entry.summary: ProductResearch trains e-commerce deep research agents by synthesizing long-horizon tool-use trajectories via multi-agent collaboration (User, Supervisor, Research agents). Addresses domain gaps when transferring deep research paradigms to e-commerce.

entry.title: VideoPulse: Neonatal heart rate and peripheral capillary oxygen saturation (SpO2) estimation from contact free video

author.name: Deependra Dewagiri, Kamesh Anuradha, Pabadhi Liyanage, Helitha Kulatunga, Pamuditha Somarathne, Udaya S. K. P. Miriya Thanthrige, Nishani Lucas, Anusha Withana, Joshua P. Kulasingham

entry.summary: VideoPulse presents a neonatal dataset and pipeline for contact-free estimation of heart rate and SpO2 from facial video, containing 157 recordings from 52 neonates with diverse face orientations, using 3D CNNs with artifact-aware supervision.

entry.title: Actor-Critic Pretraining for Proximal Policy Optimization

author.name: Andreas Kernbach, Amr Elsheikh, Nicolas Grupp, Ren\'e Nagel, and Marco F. Huber

entry.summary: Proposes pretraining both actor and critic networks for PPO using expert demonstrations, with the critic initialized via Monte Carlo return estimation. Shows faster convergence and improved sample efficiency in robotics tasks.

entry.title: Learning to maintain safety through expert demonstrations in settings with unknown constraints: A Q-learning perspective

author.name: George Papadopoulos, George A. Vouros

entry.summary: Addresses safe RL from expert demonstrations in constrained MDPs with unknown constraints and non-observable costs. Formulates policy learning using Q-values that mix reward expectations with safety assessments.

entry.title: Inferring Chronic Treatment Onset from ePrescription Data: A Renewal Process Approach

author.name: Pavlin G. Poli\v{c}ar, Dalibor Stanimirovi\'c, Bla\v{z} Zupan

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic framework for inferring chronic treatment onset from ePrescription data by modeling prescription dynamics as a renewal process with change-point detection between sporadic and sustained therapy regimes.

entry.title: Learning to Build: Autonomous Robotic Assembly of Stable Structures Without Predefined Plans

author.name: Jingwen Wang, Johannes Kirschner, Paul Rolland, Luis Salamanca, Stefana Parascho

entry.summary: Presents an RL-based framework for autonomous robotic assembly of stable structures without predefined blueprints, using deep Q-learning with successor features. Demonstrates feasibility on 15 2D assembly tasks with real-world experiments.

entry.title: Green or Fast? Learning to Balance Cold Starts and Idle Carbon in Serverless Computing

author.name: Bowen Sun, Christos D. Antonopoulos, Evgenia Smirni, Bin Ren, Nikolaos Bellas, Spyros Lalis

entry.summary: Proposes LACE-RL, a deep RL framework that dynamically tunes serverless function keep-alive durations to balance cold-start latency with carbon emissions, considering time-varying grid carbon intensity.

entry.title: HotelQuEST: Balancing Quality and Efficiency in Agentic Search

author.name: Guy Hadad, Shadi Iskander, Oren Kalinsky, Sofia Tolmach, Ran Levy, Haggai Roitman

entry.summary: Introduces HotelQuEST, a benchmark for evaluating agentic search systems that considers both quality and efficiency, featuring 214 hotel search queries with underspecified preferences.

entry.title: Clinically-aligned ischemic stroke segmentation and ASPECTS scoring on NCCT imaging using a slice-gated loss on foundation representations

author.name: Hiba Azeem, Behraj Khan, Tahir Qasim Syed

entry.summary: Proposes a clinically-aligned framework for ischemic stroke segmentation on NCCT that uses a frozen DINOv3 backbone with a Territory-Aware Gated Loss to enforce anatomical BG-SG consistency for ASPECTS scoring.

entry.title: Venus: Benchmarking and Empowering Multimodal Large Language Models for Aesthetic Guidance and Cropping

author.name: Tianxiang Du, Hulingxiao He, Yuxin Peng

entry.summary: Introduces AesGuide, the first large-scale dataset for aesthetic guidance in photography, and trains MLLMs to identify aesthetic issues and provide actionable shooting guidance, also improving aesthetic cropping.

entry.title: Dialect and Gender Bias in YouTube's Spanish Captioning System

author.name: Iris Dania Jimenez, Christoph Kern

entry.summary: Studies dialect and gender bias in YouTube's Spanish automatic captioning system across multiple Spanish-speaking regions, finding systematic disparities in caption quality.

entry.title: Portfolio Reinforcement Learning with Scenario-Context Rollout

author.name: Vanya Priscillia Bendatu, Yao Lu

entry.summary: Proposes macro-conditioned scenario-context rollout for portfolio RL that generates stress-event scenarios and augments critic training with counterfactual next states to handle regime shifts.

entry.title: FoV-Net: Rotation-Invariant CAD B-rep Learning via Field-of-View Ray Casting

author.name: Matteo Ballegeer and Dries F. Benoit

entry.summary: Introduces FoV-Net, the first B-rep learning framework that achieves rotation-invariant 3D CAD analysis by combining local reference frame UV-grids with field-of-view ray casting for global context. Shows that existing methods collapse from 95% to 10% accuracy under arbitrary rotations.

entry.title: Histopathology Image Normalization via Latent Manifold Compaction

author.name: Xiaolong Zhang, Jianwei Zhang, Selim Sevim, Emek Demir, Ece Eksi, Xubo Song

entry.summary: Introduces Latent Manifold Compaction (LMC), an unsupervised framework for histopathology image harmonization that learns batch-invariant embeddings by compacting stain-induced latent manifolds, generalizing to unseen target domains from a single source dataset.

entry.title: Hierarchical Action Learning for Weakly-Supervised Action Segmentation

author.name: Junxian Huang, Ruichu Cai, Hao Zhu, Juntao Fang, Boyan Xu, Weilin Chen, Zijian Li, Shenghua Gao

entry.summary: Proposes HAL (Hierarchical Action Learning) for weakly-supervised action segmentation, modeling actions as high-level latent variables that evolve slowly while governing fast-changing low-level visual features through a hierarchical causal generation process.

entry.title: I'm Bearish On Personas For ASI Safety

author.name: J Bostock

entry.summary: This post argues that the 'Persona Selection Model' approach to ASI safety (e.g., training a 'Claude persona' that behaves well) will fail because base LLMs have no training examples of superintelligent AI behavior. When RL pushes capabilities beyond human-level, the model's extrapolation of what a superintelligent Claude would do will diverge from what humans would reflectively endorse, due to differing inductive biases. The author frames this as a fundamental challenge to persona-based alignment strategies.

entry.title: Prune Wisely, Reconstruct Sharply: Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting via Adaptive Pruning and Difference-of-Gaussian Primitives

author.name: Haoran Wang, Guoxi Huang, Fan Zhang, David Bull, and Nantheera Anantrasirichai

entry.summary: Proposes an integrated approach for compact 3D Gaussian Splatting combining adaptive reconstruction-aware pruning with Difference-of-Gaussian primitives to reduce model size while preserving or enhancing rendering quality.

entry.title: Multivariate Spatio-Temporal Neural Hawkes Processes

author.name: Christopher Chukwuemeka, Hojun You, and Mikyoung Jun

entry.summary: Proposes a multivariate spatio-temporal neural Hawkes process that integrates spatial information into latent state evolution through learned temporal and spatial decay dynamics. Addresses modeling gaps in how existing deep learning Hawkes process models capture intensity behavior.

entry.title: Active Bipartite Ranking with Smooth Posterior Distributions

author.name: James Cheshire and Stephan Cl\'emen\c{c}on

entry.summary: Develops active bipartite ranking for continuous conditional distributions under Hölder smoothness, extending beyond the discrete setting previously studied. Proposes the smooth-rank algorithm that avoids naive discretization pitfalls.

entry.title: Structure-aware Contrastive Learning for Diagram Understanding of Multimodal Models

author.name: Hiroshi Sasaki

entry.summary: Introduces a contrastive learning paradigm for enhancing CLIP-like models' understanding of diagrams by using hard samples with specialized loss functions that leverage structural properties of diagrams.

entry.title: Sample-Efficient Robot Skill Learning for Construction Tasks: Benchmarking Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning and Vision-Language-Action VLA Model

author.name: Zhaofeng Hu, Hongrui Yu, Vaidhyanathan Chandramouli, Ci-Jyun Liang

entry.summary: Benchmarks VLA models against hierarchical RL approaches for construction robot skill learning, developing teleoperation interfaces for demonstration collection and conducting a three-stage comparative evaluation.

entry.title: Toward General Semantic Chunking: A Discriminative Framework for Ultra-Long Documents

author.name: Kaifeng Wu, Junyan Wu, Qiang Liu, Jiarui Zhang, Wen Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a discriminative segmentation model for ultra-long documents based on Qwen3-0.6B with cross-window context fusion and overlapping sliding windows. Supports up to 13k tokens in single-pass with extension to ultra-long documents.

entry.title: Long Range Frequency Tuning for QML

author.name: Michael Poppel, Jonas Stein, Sebastian W\"olckert, Markus Baumann, Claudia Linnhoff-Popien

entry.summary: Studies practical limitations of trainable-frequency approaches in quantum machine learning, finding that frequency prefactors exhibit limited trainability and gradient-based optimization cannot reliably drive them to arbitrary target values.

entry.title: Printed helicoids with embedded air channels make sensorized segments for soft continuum robots

author.name: Annan Zhang, Hanna Matusik, Miguel Flores-Acton, Emily R. Sologuren, Joshua Jacob, Daniela Rus

entry.summary: Introduces a fabrication method for embedding air channels into helicoid-based soft continuum robots using multi-material 3D printing. Enables distributed deformation sensing through integrated pressure sensors and IMUs.

entry.title: Neural ensemble Kalman filter: Data assimilation for compressible flows with shocks

author.name: Xu-Hui Zhou, Lorenzo Beronilla, Michael K. Sleeman, Hangchuan Hu, Matthias Morzfeld, Andrew M. Stuart, Tamer A. Zaki

entry.summary: Introduces a neural ensemble Kalman filter that embeds neural network function approximations within data assimilation to handle bimodal forecast distributions near shock locations in compressible flows. This addresses a fundamental limitation of standard EnKF methods that assume Gaussian forecasts.

entry.title: Cross-Representation Knowledge Transfer for Improved Sequential Recommendations

author.name: Artur Gimranov, Viacheslav Yusupov, Elfat Sabitov, Tatyana Matveeva, Anton Lysenko, Ruslan Israfilov, Evgeny Frolov

entry.summary: Presents a framework combining transformers and graph neural networks for sequential recommendation, aligning different representation types for next-item prediction. Simultaneously encodes structural dependencies and temporal dynamics in user interaction histories.

entry.title: SGDC: Structurally-Guided Dynamic Convolution for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Bo Shi, Wei-ping Zhu, M.N.S. Swamy

entry.summary: Proposes Structure-Guided Dynamic Convolution (SGDC) for medical image segmentation that uses an explicitly supervised structure-extraction branch to guide dynamic kernel generation, preserving fine-grained boundary details lost by average pooling.

entry.title: V-MORALS: Visual Morse Graph-Aided Estimation of Regions of Attraction in a Learned Latent Space

author.name: Faiz Aladin, Ashwin Balasubramanian, Lars Lindemann, Daniel Seita

entry.summary: Presents V-MORALS, extending the MORALS method for estimating Regions of Attraction in latent spaces to work from visual sensor measurements rather than requiring full state knowledge, using topological tools.

entry.title: Hierarchical Multi-Scale Graph Learning with Knowledge-Guided Attention for Whole-Slide Image Survival Analysis

author.name: Bin Xu, Yufei Zhou, Boling Song, Jingwen Sun, Yang Bian, Cheng Lu, Ye Wu, Jianfei Tu, Xiangxue Wang

entry.summary: Proposes HMKGN, a hierarchical multi-scale graph network for whole-slide image survival analysis that models both local cellular-level and global slide-level interactions with knowledge-aware attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Pseudo Contrastive Learning for Diagram Comprehension in Multimodal Models

author.name: Hiroshi Sasaki

entry.summary: Proposes pseudo contrastive learning for improving CLIP's diagram comprehension by generating synthetic diagram variations via a renderer, highlighting structural differences without modifying original data.

entry.title: ReDON: Recurrent Diffractive Optical Neural Processor with Reconfigurable Self-Modulated Nonlinearity

author.name: Ziang Yin, Qi Jing, Raktim Sarma, Rena Huang, Yu Yao, Jiaqi Gu

entry.summary: Introduces ReDON, a recurrent diffractive optical neural network with reconfigurable self-modulated nonlinearity inspired by gated linear units, enabling dynamic input-dependent optical computation.

entry.title: Disentangled Mode-Specific Representations for Tensor Time Series via Contrastive Learning

author.name: Kohei Obata, Taichi Murayama, Zheng Chen, Yasuko Matsubara, Yasushi Sakurai

entry.summary: Proposes MoST for tensor time series representation learning, using tensor slicing to learn mode-specific and mode-invariant features through contrastive learning, enabling disentangled representations.

entry.title: The Auton Agentic AI Framework

author.name: Sheng Cao, Zhao Chang, Chang Li, Hannan Li, Liyao Fu, Ji Tang

entry.summary: Describes the Auton Agentic AI Framework, an architecture for standardizing creation, execution, and governance of autonomous agent systems, featuring separation between Cognitive Blueprint (declarative) and deterministic execution infrastructure.

entry.title: UTPTrack: Towards Simple and Unified Token Pruning for Visual Tracking

author.name: Hao Wu, Xudong Wang, Jialiang Zhang, Junlong Tong, Xinghao Chen, Junyan Lin, Yunpu Ma, Xiaoyu Shen

entry.summary: UTPTrack introduces unified token pruning for visual tracking that jointly compresses search region, dynamic template, and static template components, modeling inter-component dependencies for more efficient one-stream transformer trackers.

entry.title: UPath: Universal Planner Across Topological Heterogeneity For Grid-Based Pathfinding

author.name: Aleksandr Ananikian, Daniil Drozdov, Konstantin Yakovlev (Saint-Petersburg University)

entry.summary: UPath designs a universal heuristic predictor for grid-based pathfinding that generalizes across topologically heterogeneous environments (cities, indoor, random obstacles), closing the gap between distribution-specific neural heuristics and universal search requirements.

entry.title: EMO-R3: Reflective Reinforcement Learning for Emotional Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yiyang Fang, Wenke Huang, Pei Fu, Yihao Yang, Kehua Su, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan, Mang Ye

entry.summary: EMO-R3 proposes Reflective Reinforcement Learning for emotional reasoning in MLLMs, introducing Structured Emotional Thinking for step-by-step emotional analysis and addressing limitations of standard RL methods for subjective emotional cognition.

entry.title: BiM-GeoAttn-Net: Linear-Time Depth Modeling with Geometry-Aware Attention for 3D Aortic Dissection CTA Segmentation

author.name: Yuan Zhang, Lei Liu, Jialin Zhang, Ya-Nan Zhang, Ling Wang, Nan Mu

entry.summary: BiM-GeoAttn-Net combines bidirectional depth-wise state-space modeling (Mamba) with geometry-aware vessel attention for 3D aortic dissection CTA segmentation, achieving linear-time depth modeling with improved inter-slice coherence.

entry.title: CLFEC: A New Task for Unified Linguistic and Factual Error Correction in paragraph-level Chinese Professional Writing

author.name: Jian Kai, Zidong Zhang, Jiwen Chen, Zhengxiang Wu, Songtao Sun, Fuyang Li, Yang Cao, Qiang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces CLFEC, a new task for joint linguistic and factual error correction in Chinese professional writing. Constructs a multi-domain dataset and systematically evaluates LLM correction paradigms from prompting to RAG to agentic workflows.

entry.title: Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Remote Sensing via Hierarchical Attention Masking and Model Composition

author.name: Mohammadreza Heidarianbaei, Mareike Dorozynski, Hubert Kanyamahanga, Max Mehltretter, Franz Rottensteiner

entry.summary: ReSeg-CLIP proposes training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation for remote sensing using hierarchical SAM-generated masks to constrain CLIP self-attention, with parameter-averaged model composition of RS-specific CLIP variants.

entry.title: SegMate: Asymmetric Attention-Based Lightweight Architecture for Efficient Multi-Organ Segmentation

author.name: Andrei-Alexandru Bunea, Dan-Matei Popovici, Radu Tudor Ionescu

entry.summary: Presents SegMate, an efficient 2.5D framework for multi-organ medical image segmentation using asymmetric attention and multi-scale feature fusion. Achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with significantly reduced computational requirements.

entry.title: Leveraging Geometric Prior Uncertainty and Complementary Constraints for High-Fidelity Neural Indoor Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Qiyu Feng, Jiwei Shan, Shing Shin Cheng, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GPU-SDF for neural implicit indoor surface reconstruction with explicit geometric prior uncertainty estimation and complementary constraints. Addresses thin structures and complex geometries.

entry.title: SpikeTrack: A Spike-driven Framework for Efficient Visual Tracking

author.name: Qiuyang Zhang, Jiujun Cheng, Qichao Mao, Cong Liu, Yu Fang, Yuhong Li, Mengying Ge, Shangce Gao

entry.summary: Introduces SpikeTrack, a spike-driven framework for energy-efficient RGB object tracking using asymmetric timestep design and memory-retrieval modules inspired by neural inference mechanisms.

entry.title: Foundation World Models for Agents that Learn, Verify, and Adapt Reliably Beyond Static Environments

author.name: Florent Delgrange

entry.summary: Outlines a vision for foundation world models that unify RL, program synthesis, and abstraction mechanisms for agents that learn, verify, and adapt in open worlds. Proposes a four-component agenda.

entry.title: CIRCLE: A Framework for Evaluating AI from a Real-World Lens

author.name: Reva Schwartz and Carina Westling and Morgan Briggs and Marzieh Fadaee and Isar Nejadgholi and Matthew Holmes and Fariza Rashid and Maya Carlyle and Afaf Ta\"ik and Kyra Wilson and Peter Douglas and Theodora Skeadas and Gabriella Waters and Rumman Chowdhury and Thiago Lacerda

entry.summary: Proposes CIRCLE, a six-stage lifecycle framework for evaluating AI systems in real-world deployment, bridging the gap between model-centric metrics and materialized outcomes.

entry.title: pathsig: A GPU-Accelerated Library for Truncated and Projected Path Signatures

author.name: Tobias Nygaard

entry.summary: Introduces pathsig, a GPU-accelerated PyTorch library for computing path signatures with CUDA kernels, achieving 10-30x speedups for truncated signatures and 4-10x for projected signatures.

entry.title: Adaptive Correlation-Weighted Intrinsic Rewards for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Viet Bac Nguyen, Phuong Thai Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes ACWI, a framework that dynamically balances intrinsic and extrinsic rewards in sparse reward RL by learning a state-dependent scaling coefficient via a lightweight Beta Network. The method uses a correlation-based objective to align intrinsic rewards with future extrinsic returns, avoiding manual tuning of reward coefficients.

entry.title: ARGUS: Seeing the Influence of Narrative Features on Persuasion in Argumentative Texts

author.name: Sara Nabhani, Federico Pianzola, Khalid Al-Khatib, Malvina Nissim

entry.summary: Introduces ARGUS, a framework studying how narrative features affect persuasion in argumentative texts, using a new ChangeMyView corpus annotated for story presence and six narrative features. Uses both encoder-based classifiers and zero-shot LLMs to analyze narrative persuasion at scale.

entry.title: FocusTrack: One-Stage Focus-and-Suppress Framework for 3D Point Cloud Object Tracking

author.name: Sifan Zhou, Jiahao Nie, Ziyu Zhao, Yichao Cao, Xiaobo Lu

entry.summary: Proposes FocusTrack, a one-stage 3D point cloud tracking framework that unifies motion estimation and foreground segmentation, addressing error accumulation in two-stage approaches through Inter-frame Motion Modeling and Focus-and-Suppress Attention.

entry.title: Fixed Anchors Are Not Enough: Dynamic Retrieval and Persistent Homology for Dataset Distillation

author.name: Muquan Li, Hang Gou, Yingyi Ma, Rongzheng Wang, Ke Qin, Tao He

entry.summary: Introduces RETA, a dataset distillation framework using dynamic retrieval connections and persistent topology alignment to address the fit-complexity gap and reduced intra-class diversity in decoupled distillation methods.

entry.title: Joint Geometric and Trajectory Consistency Learning for One-Step Real-World Super-Resolution

author.name: Chengyan Deng, Zhangquan Chen, Li Yu, Kai Zhang, Xue Zhou, Wang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GTCons for one-step real-world image super-resolution, addressing geometric decoupling and consistency drift in consistency model training for lightweight, efficient super-resolution without large T2I priors.

entry.title: Fast Learning of Non-Cooperative Spacecraft 3D Models through Primitive Initialization

author.name: Pol Francesch Huc, Emily Bates, Simone D'Amico

entry.summary: Develops a CNN-based primitive initializer for 3D Gaussian Splatting of non-cooperative spacecraft, enabling faster training with noisy or implicit pose estimates. Addresses space-specific limitations of standard 3DGS.

entry.title: An Agentic LLM Framework for Adverse Media Screening in AML Compliance

author.name: Pavel Chernakov, Sasan Jafarnejad, Rapha\"el Frank

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic LLM system for adverse media screening in AML/KYC compliance, using RAG to automate web searches and compute Adverse Media Index scores. Evaluates on politically exposed persons and sanctioned individuals.

entry.title: Tensor Hypercontraction Error Correction Using Regression

author.name: Ishna Satyarth, Eric C. Larson, Devin A. Matthews

entry.summary: Uses machine learning regression to correct errors in tensor hypercontraction (THC) approximated quantum chemistry methods, achieving near-exact accuracy for MP3 and CCSD energies at reduced computational cost.

entry.title: Shape vs. Context: Examining Human--AI Gaps in Ambiguous Japanese Character Recognition

author.name: Daichi Haraguchi

entry.summary: Investigates behavioral gaps between humans and VLMs in ambiguous Japanese character recognition using β-VAE interpolated character shapes. Finds human and VLM decision boundaries differ, with contextual embedding sometimes improving alignment.

entry.title: Learning with a Budget: Identifying the Best Arm with Resource Constraints

author.name: Zitian Li and Wang Chi Cheung

entry.summary: Studies best arm identification under resource constraints where each arm pull consumes limited resources, proposing the SH-RR algorithm that integrates resource-aware allocation into successive halving with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Better Learning-Augmented Spanning Tree Algorithms via Metric Forest Completion

author.name: Nate Veldt and Thomas Stanley and Benjamin W. Priest and Trevor Steil and Keita Iwabuchi and T.S. Jayram and Grace J. Li and Geoffrey Sanders

entry.summary: Improves learning-augmented algorithms for approximate minimum spanning trees via a generalized metric forest completion method that interpolates between fast subquadratic and optimal quadratic approaches, achieving better approximation-complexity tradeoffs.

entry.title: Predictive Hotspot Mapping for Data-driven Crime Prediction

author.name: Karthik Sriram and Ankur Sinha and Suvashis Choudhary

entry.summary: Develops a non-parametric spatio-temporal kernel density model for crime hotspot prediction, validated in collaboration with the Delhi police department. The model can incorporate expert inputs and has been deployed in a real-world policing setting.

entry.title: A Soft Fabric-Based Thermal Haptic Device for VR and Teleoperation

author.name: Rui Chen, Domenico Chiaradia, Antonio Frisoli, Daniele Leonardis

entry.summary: Presents a novel fabric-based thermal-haptic interface for VR and teleoperation, achieving only 2g per finger unit. Combines pneumatic actuation with conductive fabric for modulated pressure and thermal stimuli.

entry.title: Domain-Partitioned Hybrid RAG for Legal Reasoning: Toward Modular and Explainable Legal AI for India

author.name: Rakshita Goel, S Pranav Kumar, Anmol Agrawal, Divyan Poddar, Pratik Narang, Dhruv Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes a domain-partitioned hybrid RAG and Knowledge Graph architecture for Indian legal research, integrating specialized pipelines for case law, statutes, and penal code with cross-domain reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: Cybersecurity of Teleoperated Quadruped Robots: A Systematic Survey of Vulnerabilities, Threats, and Open Defense Gaps

author.name: Mohammad Sabouri

entry.summary: Provides a systematic survey of cybersecurity threats for teleoperated quadruped robots, contributing a six-layer attack taxonomy and risk scoring for 28 threat classes specific to quadruped platforms.

entry.title: Active Value Querying to Minimize Additive Error in Subadditive Set Function Learning

author.name: Martin \v{C}ern\'y, David Sychrovsk\'y, Filip \'Uradn\'ik, and Jakub \v{C}ern\'y

entry.summary: Studies active value querying to minimize additive error in learning subadditive set functions, providing algorithms for selecting which subset values to query when the number of queries is limited.

entry.title: Component Centric Placement Using Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Kart Leong Lim

entry.summary: Applies deep reinforcement learning to PCB component placement with a component-centric layout approach, discretizing space around main components to reduce search space for passive component placement.

entry.title: Hybrid Quantum Temporal Convolutional Networks

author.name: Junghoon Justin Park, Maria Pak, Sebin Lee, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Shinjae Yoo, Huan-Hsin Tseng, Jiook Cha

entry.summary: Introduces Hybrid Quantum Temporal Convolutional Networks (HQTCN) that combine classical temporal windowing with quantum convolutional circuits, showing competitive performance on time series with significant parameter reduction, especially under data-limited conditions.

entry.title: SAGE-LLM: Towards Safe and Generalizable LLM Controller with Fuzzy-CBF Verification and Graph-Structured Knowledge Retrieval for UAV Decision

author.name: Wenzhe Zhao, Yang Zhao, Ganchao Liu, Zhiyu Jiang, Dandan Ma, Zihao Li and Xuelong Li

entry.summary: SAGE-LLM proposes a train-free two-layer decision architecture for UAV control combining LLMs with fuzzy Control Barrier Functions for safety verification and graph-based RAG for domain knowledge retrieval.

entry.title: ReasonX: Declarative Reasoning on Explanations

author.name: Laura State, Salvatore Ruggieri, Franco Turini

entry.summary: ReasonX provides declarative, interactive explanations for decision trees using a closed algebra of operators over linear constraints. Allows users to express background knowledge and reason at multiple levels of abstraction.

entry.title: Revisiting Integration of Image and Metadata for DICOM Series Classification: Cross-Attention and Dictionary Learning

author.name: Tuan Truong, Melanie Dohmen, Sara Lorio, Matthias Lenga

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal framework for DICOM series classification using cross-attention fusion of image content and metadata, with a missingness-aware encoder based on learnable feature dictionaries for handling incomplete metadata.

entry.title: Extending 2D foundational DINOv3 representations to 3D segmentation of neonatal brain MR images

author.name: Annayah Usman, Behraj Khan, Tahir Qasim Syed

entry.summary: Extends 2D DINOv3 foundation model representations to 3D neonatal brain MRI segmentation through a window-based disassembly-reassembly mechanism that decomposes volumes into sub-cubes for processing.

entry.title: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Quadrotor Racing with Random Obstacles

author.name: Fangyu Sun, Fanxing Li, Yu Hu, Linzuo Zhang, Yueqian Liu, Wenxian Yu, Danping Zou

entry.summary: Proposes a vision-based curriculum RL framework for drone racing with obstacle avoidance, combining multi-stage curriculum learning, domain randomization, and multi-scene updating for end-to-end control.

entry.title: A Novel Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Payments Using LLMs

author.name: Joon Kiat Chua, Donghao Huang, and Zhaoxia Wang

entry.summary: Proposes HMASP, a hierarchical multi-agent system using LLMs for end-to-end payment workflow automation, addressing a gap where current LLM agents cannot handle payment tasks.

entry.title: RAViT: Resolution-Adaptive Vision Transformer

author.name: Martial Guidez, Stefan Duffner, Christophe Garcia

entry.summary: Proposes RAViT, a multi-branch Vision Transformer operating on multiple resolutions of the same image with early exit mechanisms, reducing computational cost while preserving accuracy in image classification.

entry.title: Resources for Automated Evaluation of Assistive RAG Systems that Help Readers with News Trustworthiness Assessment

author.name: Dake Zhang, Mark D. Smucker, Charles L. A. Clarke

entry.summary: Describes resources for the TREC 2025 DRAGUN track, which evaluates assistive RAG systems for news trustworthiness assessment, including question generation and report generation tasks grounded in the MS MARCO corpus.

entry.title: Sample Size Calculations for Developing Clinical Prediction Models: Overview and pmsims R package

author.name: Diana Shamsutdinova, Felix Zimmer, Oyebayo Ridwan Olaniran, Sarah Markham, Daniel Stahl, Gordon Forbes, Ewan Carr

entry.summary: Reviews sample size calculation methods for developing clinical prediction models and introduces the pmsims R package for simulation-based sample size estimation. The framework distinguishes between mean-based and assurance-based criteria and integrates learning curves with Gaussian processes.

entry.title: A distributed semismooth Newton based augmented Lagrangian method for distributed optimization

author.name: Qihao Ma, Chengjing Wang, Peipei Tang, Dunbiao Niu, Aimin Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a distributed optimization algorithm combining semismooth Newton methods with augmented Lagrangian for network optimization. Uses distributed accelerated proximal gradient to compute Newton directions without communicating full Hessian matrices.

entry.title: Conceptualization, Operationalization, and Measurement of Machine Companionship: A Scoping Review

author.name: Jaime Banks and Zhixin Li

entry.summary: Conducts a PRISMA-guided scoping review of machine companionship research (N=71, 2017-2025), examining how the concept is conceptualized, operationalized, and measured across scholarly works. Identifies over 50 distinct measured concepts.

entry.title: Robot Excavation and Manipulation of Geometrically Cohesive Granular Media

author.name: Laura Treers, Daniel Soto, Joonha Hwang, Michael A. D. Goodisman, Daniel I. Goldman

entry.summary: Develops principles for robotic excavation and manipulation of geometrically cohesive granular media (u-shaped entangled particles). Creates a robophysical model for robot-soft matter interaction as a step toward robotic swarm construction.

entry.title: Destination-to-Chutes Task Mapping Optimization for Multi-Robot Coordination in Robotic Sorting Systems

author.name: Yulun Zhang, Alexandre O. G. Barbosa, Federico Pecora, Jiaoyang Li

entry.summary: Optimizes destination-to-chutes task mapping in robotic sorting systems to improve throughput, considering interdependencies with robot assignment and path planning plus downstream processing constraints.

entry.title: Reinforcement-Learned Unequal Error Protection for Quantized Semantic Embeddings

author.name: Moirangthem Tiken Singh, Adnan Arif

entry.summary: Introduces an RL framework for per-dimension unequal error protection of semantic embeddings via adaptive repetition coding. Achieves significant gains over uniform protection in preserving semantic meaning under low SNR.

entry.title: TARAZ: Persian Short-Answer Question Benchmark for Cultural Evaluation of Language Models

author.name: Reihaneh Iranmanesh, Saeedeh Davoudi, Pasha Abrishamchian, Ophir Frieder, Nazli Goharian

entry.summary: Presents TARAZ, a Persian short-answer question benchmark for evaluating cultural competence of LLMs. Introduces Persian-specific evaluation combining morphological normalization with hybrid syntactic-semantic similarity scoring.

entry.title: Higress-RAG: A Holistic Optimization Framework for Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Dual Hybrid Retrieval, Adaptive Routing, and CRAG

author.name: Weixi Lin

entry.summary: Presents Higress RAG MCP Server, an enterprise RAG architecture addressing retrieval precision, hallucination, and latency through dual hybrid retrieval, adaptive routing, and corrective RAG within a Model Context Protocol framework.

entry.title: Multiprojective Geometry of Compatible Triples of Fundamental and Essential Matrices

author.name: Timothy Duff, Viktor Korotynskiy, Anton Leykin, Tomas Pajdla

entry.summary: Characterizes the algebraic variety of compatible fundamental matrix triples by computing its multidegree and vanishing ideal, improving upon incomplete constraints in the geometric computer vision literature.

entry.title: On the Limits of Interpretable Machine Learning in Quintic Root Classification

author.name: Rohan Thomas, Majid Bani-Yaghoub

entry.summary: Tests whether ML models can autonomously recover interpretable mathematical structure from raw data, using quintic polynomial root classification as a benchmark. Finds neural networks achieve 84.3% accuracy on raw coefficients but decision trees match when given explicit engineered features capturing sign changes.

entry.title: Optimization of Edge Directions and Weights for Mixed Guidance Graphs in Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding

author.name: Yulun Zhang, Varun Bhatt, Matthew C. Fontaine, Stefanos Nikolaidis, Jiaoyang Li

entry.summary: Proposes optimizing edge directions alongside edge weights in guidance graphs for lifelong multi-agent path finding (LMAPF), providing strict movement guidance to agents. Introduces mixed guidance graphs combining soft weight-based and hard direction-based guidance.

entry.title: Automated Dose-Based Anatomic Region Classification of Radiotherapy Treatment for Big Data Applications

author.name: Justin Hink, Yasin Abdulkadir, Jack Neylon, James Lamb

entry.summary: Develops software to automatically classify radiotherapy treatment anatomic regions using dose-volume overlap with deep learning segmentations, eliminating reliance on inconsistent metadata labels for big data curation.

entry.title: Construct, Merge, Solve & Adapt with Reinforcement Learning for the min-max Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem

author.name: Guillem Rodr\'iguez-Corominas, Maria J. Blesa, Christian Blum

entry.summary: Proposes RL-CMSA, a hybrid approach for the min-max multiple traveling salesman problem that combines reinforcement learning with mathematical programming via iterative construction, merging, and solving.

entry.title: SDMixer: Sparse Dual-Mixer for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Xiang Ao

entry.summary: Proposes SDMixer, a dual-stream sparse mixer framework for multivariate time series forecasting that extracts features in both frequency and time domains with sparsity mechanisms to filter noise.

entry.title: TRIZ-RAGNER: A Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model for TRIZ-Aware Named Entity Recognition in Patent-Based Contradiction Mining

author.name: Zitong Xu, Yuqing Wu, Yue Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes TRIZ-RAGNER, a retrieval-augmented LLM for TRIZ-aware named entity recognition in patents, addressing LLM hallucination in technical parameter extraction through structured TRIZ knowledge grounding.

entry.title: Any Model, Any Place, Any Time: Get Remote Sensing Foundation Model Embeddings On Demand

author.name: Dingqi Ye, Daniel Kiv, Wei Hu, Jimeng Shi, Shaowen Wang

entry.summary: Introduces rs-embed, a Python library providing a unified interface for retrieving embeddings from various remote sensing foundation models with a single line of code, supporting any location and time range with efficient batch processing.

entry.title: Neural Image Space Tessellation
