author.name: Guoyizhe Wei, Yang Jiao, Nan Xi, Zhishen Huang, Jingjing Meng, Rama Chellappa, Yan Gao

entry.summary: Proposes Pix2Key for composed image retrieval using open-vocabulary visual dictionaries with self-supervised pretraining (V-Dict-AE), enabling intent-aware constraint matching and diversity-aware reranking.

entry.title: ArtPro: Self-Supervised Articulated Object Reconstruction with Adaptive Integration of Mobility Proposals

author.name: Xuelu Li, Zhaonan Wang, Xiaogang Wang, Lei Wu, Manyi Li, Changhe Tu

entry.summary: Proposes ArtPro for self-supervised articulated object reconstruction using adaptive mobility proposals with over-segmentation initialization, addressing local minima problems in differentiable rendering frameworks.

entry.title: SO3UFormer: Learning Intrinsic Spherical Features for Rotation-Robust Panoramic Segmentation

author.name: Qinfeng Zhu, Yunxi Jiang, Lei Fan

entry.summary: Proposes SO3UFormer for rotation-robust panoramic semantic segmentation that learns intrinsic spherical features less sensitive to coordinate frame, addressing performance collapse under 3D reorientations.

entry.title: DMAligner: Enhancing Image Alignment via Diffusion Model Based View Synthesis

author.name: Xinglong Luo, Ao Luo, Zhengning Wang, Yueqi Yang, Chaoyu Feng, Lei Lei, Bing Zeng, Shuaicheng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DMAligner, a diffusion-based framework for image alignment through alignment-oriented view synthesis, replacing flow-based warping to handle occlusions and illumination variations.

entry.title: FLIGHT: Fibonacci Lattice-based Inference for Geometric Heading in real-Time

author.name: David Dirnfeld, Fabien Delattre, Pedro Miraldo, Erik Learned-Miller

entry.summary: Proposes FLIGHT for camera heading estimation using a generalized Hough transform on the unit sphere, providing robust estimation under high noise and outlier conditions from monocular video.

entry.title: UniScale: Unified Scale-Aware 3D Reconstruction for Multi-View Understanding via Prior Injection for Robotic Perception

author.name: Mohammad Mahdavian, Gordon Tan, Binbin Xu, Yuan Ren, Dongfeng Bai, Bingbing Liu

entry.summary: Presents UniScale, a feed-forward network for scale-aware multi-view 3D reconstruction that jointly estimates camera parameters, depth, and metric scale. Designed for robotic navigation with optional geometric prior integration.

entry.title: Retrieve and Segment: Are a Few Examples Enough to Bridge the Supervision Gap in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation?

author.name: Tilemachos Aravanis, Vladan Stojni\'c, Bill Psomas, Nikos Komodakis, Giorgos Tolias

entry.summary: Introduces a few-shot open-vocabulary segmentation setting augmenting text prompts with pixel-annotated support images. Proposes a retrieval-augmented test-time adapter that fuses textual and visual support features.

entry.title: SPARR: Simulation-based Policies with Asymmetric Real-world Residuals for Assembly

author.name: Yijie Guo, Iretiayo Akinola, Lars Johannsmeier, Hugo Hadfield, Abhishek Gupta, Yashraj Narang

entry.summary: Proposes SPARR, combining simulation-trained base policies with real-world residual policies for robotic assembly. The residual policy adapts to sim-to-real gap using asymmetric observations.

entry.title: FIRE: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Financial Intelligence and Reasoning Evaluation

author.name: Xiyuan Zhang, Huihang Wu, Jiayu Guo, Zhenlin Zhang, Yiwei Zhang, Liangyu Huo, Xiaoxiao Ma, Jiansong Wan, Xuewei Jiao, Yi Jing, Jian Xie

entry.summary: Introduces FIRE, a benchmark evaluating LLMs on both theoretical financial knowledge (from qualification exams) and practical business scenarios across 3,000 questions. Provides systematic coverage of financial subdomains and business activities.

entry.title: Knob: A Physics-Inspired Gating Interface for Interpretable and Controllable Neural Dynamics

author.name: Siyu Jiang, Sanshuai Cui, Hui Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes Knob, connecting neural gating dynamics to second-order mechanical systems from control theory. Creates a tunable 'safety valve' using physical parameters (damping ratio, natural frequency) mapped to neural gating.

entry.title: The AI Research Assistant: Promise, Peril, and a Proof of Concept

author.name: Tan Bui-Thanh

entry.summary: Provides empirical evidence through a case study of human-AI collaboration for mathematical research, discovering novel error representations for Hermite quadrature rules. Highlights both capabilities and critical limitations of AI research assistants.

entry.title: RepSPD: Enhancing SPD Manifold Representation in EEGs via Dynamic Graphs

author.name: Haohui Jia, Zheng Chen, Lingwei Zhu, Xu Cao, Yasuko Matsubara, Takashi Matsubara, Yasushi Sakurai

entry.summary: Proposes RepSPD, a geometric deep learning model for EEG decoding that uses cross-attention on Riemannian manifolds to modulate SPD matrices with graph-derived representations, capturing frequency-specific synchronization and brain topology.

entry.title: Enhancing CVRP Solver through LLM-driven Automatic Heuristic Design

author.name: Zhuoliang Xie, Fei Liu, Zhenkun Wang, Qingfu Zhang

entry.summary: Presents AILS-AHD, using LLMs within an evolutionary framework to automatically design and optimize ruin heuristics for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem. Includes an LLM-based acceleration mechanism.

entry.title: Invariant Transformation and Resampling based Epistemic-Uncertainty Reduction

author.name: Sha Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a resampling-based inference method that applies invariant transformations to inputs and aggregates multiple inference outputs to reduce epistemic uncertainty, leveraging partial independence of errors across transformations.

entry.title: Analysis of LLMs Against Prompt Injection and Jailbreak Attacks

author.name: Piyush Jaiswal, Aaditya Pratap, Shreyansh Saraswati, Harsh Kasyap, Somanath Tripathy

entry.summary: Evaluates prompt injection and jailbreak vulnerabilities across multiple open-source LLMs (Phi, Mistral, DeepSeek-R1, Llama 3.2, Qwen, Gemma) using a large manually curated dataset. Finds significant behavioral variation including refusal and silent non-responsiveness.

entry.title: Poisoned Acoustics

author.name: Harrison Dahme

entry.summary: Demonstrates training-data poisoning attacks on acoustic vehicle classification achieving 95.7% attack success rate with only 0.5% label corruption, with zero detectable change in aggregate accuracy. Proves this stealth is structural.

entry.title: From Shallow Bayesian Neural Networks to Gaussian Processes: General Convergence, Identifiability and Scalable Inference

author.name: Gracielle Antunes de Ara\'ujo, Fl\'avio B. Gon\c{c}alves

entry.summary: Studies scaling limits of shallow Bayesian neural networks to Gaussian processes with relaxed convergence assumptions, proposes a convex mixture covariance function, and develops scalable MAP inference. Characterizes identifiability under different input designs.

entry.title: SUPERGLASSES: Benchmarking Vision Language Models as Intelligent Agents for AI Smart Glasses

author.name: Zhuohang Jiang, Xu Yuan, Haohao Qu, Shanru Lin, Kanglong Liu, Wenqi Fan, Qing Li

entry.summary: SUPERGLASSES introduces the first comprehensive VQA benchmark specifically designed for AI smart glasses use cases, built from real-world data. It addresses the gap between standard multimodal datasets and the unique challenges of smart glasses scenarios where identifying the object of interest must precede knowledge retrieval.

entry.title: SoPE: Spherical Coordinate-Based Positional Embedding for Enhancing Spatial Perception of 3D LVLMs

author.name: Guanting Ye, Qiyan Zhao, Wenhao Yu, Liangyu Yuan, Mingkai Li, Xiaofeng Zhang, Jianmin Ji, Yanyong Zhang, Qing Jiang, Ka-Veng Yuen

entry.summary: SoPE introduces a spherical coordinate-based positional embedding for 3D Large Vision-Language Models, addressing limitations of RoPE for encoding 3D spatial structures by mapping point-cloud tokens into spherical coordinates that preserve angular dependencies.

entry.title: Towards Simulating Social Media Users with LLMs: Evaluating the Operational Validity of Conditioned Comment Prediction

author.name: Nils Schwager, Simon M\"unker, Alistair Plum, Achim Rettinger

entry.summary: This study evaluates LLMs as 'silicon subjects' for simulating social media users through Conditioned Comment Prediction, testing open-weight 8B models across English, German, and Luxembourgish scenarios with different prompting and fine-tuning strategies.

entry.title: MoDora: Tree-Based Semi-Structured Document Analysis System

author.name: Bangrui Xu, Qihang Yao, Zirui Tang, Xuanhe Zhou, Yeye He, Shihan Yu, Qianqian Xu, Bin Wang, Guoliang Li, Conghui He, Fan Wu

entry.summary: MoDora is a tree-based system for analyzing semi-structured documents (tables, charts, hierarchical paragraphs) that preserves hierarchical structure for natural language QA, addressing fragmentation issues from OCR-based extraction.

entry.title: Scaling Search Relevance: Augmenting App Store Ranking with LLM-Generated Judgments

author.name: Evangelia Christakopoulou, Vivekkumar Patel, Hemanth Velaga, Sandip Gaikwad

entry.summary: Demonstrates that fine-tuned specialized LLMs significantly outperform larger pre-trained ones for search relevance labeling, using the optimal model to generate millions of textual relevance labels for app store search ranking.

entry.title: BrepCoder: A Unified Multimodal Large Language Model for Multi-task B-rep Reasoning

author.name: Mingi Kim, Yongjun Kim, Jungwoo Kang, Hyungki Kim

entry.summary: Introduces BrepCoder, a multimodal LLM that performs diverse CAD tasks from industry-standard B-rep format inputs by converting CAD modeling sequences into Python-like code and aligning them with B-rep representations.

entry.title: TEFL: Prediction-Residual-Guided Rolling Forecasting for Multi-Horizon Time Series

author.name: Xiannan Huang, Shen Fang, Shuhan Qiu, Chengcheng Yu, Jiayuan Du, Chao Yang

entry.summary: Introduces TEFL, a framework for time series forecasting that explicitly incorporates historical prediction residuals from rolling forecasts into both training and evaluation, capturing persistent biases and unmodeled patterns.

entry.title: Persistent Nonnegative Matrix Factorization via Multi-Scale Graph Regularization

author.name: Jichao Zhang, Ran Miao, Limin Li

entry.summary: Proposes persistent NMF (pNMF) that produces scale-parameterized persistence-aligned embeddings using persistent homology to identify canonical scales where connectivity undergoes qualitative changes.

entry.title: Mitigating Membership Inference in Intermediate Representations via Layer-wise MIA-risk-aware DP-SGD

author.name: Jiayang Meng, Tao Huang, Chen Hou, Guolong Zheng, Hong Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Layer-wise MIA-risk-aware DP-SGD that adaptively allocates privacy protection across layers proportional to their membership inference attack vulnerability, rather than using uniform noise.

entry.title: Set-based v.s. Distribution-based Representations of Epistemic Uncertainty: A Comparative Study

author.name: Kaizheng Wang, Yunjia Wang, Fabio Cuzzolin, David Moens, Hans Hallez, Siu Lun Chau

entry.summary: Provides a controlled comparative study of set-based (credal sets) vs distribution-based (Bayesian posterior) representations of epistemic uncertainty in neural networks, constructed from the same predictive model collection.

entry.title: Accelerating Local LLMs on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices via Distributed Prompt Caching

author.name: Hiroki Matsutani, Naoki Matsuda, Naoto Sugiura

entry.summary: Proposes distributed prompt caching across edge devices for accelerating local LLM inference, using Bloom filters to minimize communication overhead for cache lookups over wireless networks.

entry.title: RhythmBERT: A Self-Supervised Language Model Based on Latent Representations of ECG Waveforms for Heart Disease Detection

author.name: Xin Wang, Burcu Ozek, Aruna Mohan, Amirhossein Ravari, Or Zilbershot, Fatemeh Afghah

entry.summary: Proposes RhythmBERT, an ECG language model that tokenizes cardiac P/QRS/T segments into symbolic tokens via autoencoders, treating ECG as a language with rhythm-level semantics rather than generic time series.

entry.title: Takeuchi's Information Criteria as Generalization Measures for DNNs Close to NTK Regime

author.name: Hiroki Naganuma, Taiji Suzuki, Rio Yokota, Masahiro Nomura, Kohta Ishikawa, Ikuro Sato

entry.summary: Studies Takeuchi's Information Criterion as a generalization measure for DNNs, showing it works effectively near the NTK regime through extensive experiments on 5,000+ models across 12 architectures.

entry.title: Mean Estimation from Coarse Data: Characterizations and Efficient Algorithms

author.name: Alkis Kalavasis, Anay Mehrotra, Manolis Zampetakis, Felix Zhou, Ziyu Zhu

entry.summary: Studies Gaussian mean estimation from coarse data (where only the partition set containing each sample is observed), characterizing identifiability conditions and providing efficient algorithms.

entry.title: A Synergistic Approach: Dynamics-AI Ensemble in Tropical Cyclone Forecasting

author.name: Yonghui Li, Wansuo Duan, Hao Li, Wei Han, Han Zhang, Yinuo Li

entry.summary: Develops an AI-driven ensemble forecast system for tropical cyclones using Orthogonal Conditional Nonlinear Optimal Perturbations (O-CNOPs) to generate dynamically optimized perturbations for the FuXi weather model.

entry.title: Towards Dynamic Dense Retrieval with Routing Strategy

author.name: Zhan Su, Fengran Mo, Jinghan Zhang, Yuchen Hui, Jia Ao Sun, Bingbing Wen, Jian-Yun Nie

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Dense Retrieval (DDR), using prefix tuning as modular domain-specific components that can be composed via routing for efficient adaptation to new domains without full model retraining.

entry.title: ManifoldGD: Training-Free Hierarchical Manifold Guidance for Diffusion-Based Dataset Distillation

author.name: Ayush Roy, Wei-Yang Alex Lee, Rudrasis Chakraborty, Vishnu Suresh Lokhande

entry.summary: ManifoldGD proposes a training-free diffusion-based dataset distillation framework using hierarchical manifold guidance rather than simple mode-based centroids, improving upon existing score-based distillation methods.

entry.title: Exploring Multimodal LMMs for Online Episodic Memory Question Answering on the Edge

author.name: Giuseppe Lando, Rosario Forte, Antonino Furnari

entry.summary: Investigates running multimodal LLMs on edge devices for real-time episodic memory QA from egocentric video streams. Uses asynchronous descriptor and QA threads to convert video to lightweight textual memory for reasoning.

entry.title: Coded-E2LF: Coded Aperture Light Field Imaging from Events

author.name: Tomoya Tsuchida, Keita Takahashi, Chihiro Tsutake, Toshiaki Fujii, Hajime Nagahara

entry.summary: Proposes Coded-E2LF, a computational imaging method for acquiring 4D light fields using coded aperture and event-only cameras, eliminating the need for intensity images while clarifying the role of black patterns in aperture coding.

entry.title: Beyond Detection: Multi-Scale Hidden-Code for Natural Image Deepfake Recovery and Factual Retrieval

author.name: Yuan-Chih Chen, Chun-Shien Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a unified hidden-code recovery framework for deepfake image recovery and factual retrieval, encoding semantic and perceptual information via multi-scale vector quantization with conditional Transformer modules.

entry.title: WaterVideoQA: ASV-Centric Perception and Rule-Compliant Reasoning via Multi-Modal Agents

author.name: Runwei Guan, Shaofeng Liang, Ningwei Ouyang, Weichen Fei, Shanliang Yao, Wei Dai, Chenhao Ge, Penglei Sun, Xiaohui Zhu, Tao Huang, Ryan Wen Liu, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Presents WaterVideoQA, the first large-scale Video QA benchmark for autonomous surface vessels across waterway environments with 3,029 clips spanning six waterway categories, bridging visual perception and cognitive reasoning for maritime navigation.

entry.title: WARM-CAT: : Warm-Started Test-Time Comprehensive Knowledge Accumulation for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning

author.name: Xudong Yan, Songhe Feng, Jiaxin Wang, Xin Su, Yi Jin

entry.summary: Proposes WARM-CAT for compositional zero-shot learning, accumulating comprehensive knowledge from unsupervised data at test time to update multimodal prototypes with adaptive update weights.

entry.title: GraspLDP: Towards Generalizable Grasping Policy via Latent Diffusion

author.name: Enda Xiang, Haoxiang Ma, Xinzhu Ma, Zicheng Liu, Di Huang

entry.summary: Proposes GraspLDP, incorporating grasp prior knowledge into a latent diffusion policy framework for robotic manipulation. Improves grasping precision and generalization over existing imitation learning approaches.

entry.title: Towards Intelligible Human-Robot Interaction: An Active Inference Approach to Occluded Pedestrian Scenarios

author.name: Kai Chen, Yuyao Huang, Guang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes an Active Inference framework for autonomous driving that handles occluded pedestrians through belief-driven reasoning, using Rao-Blackwellized Particle Filters and hypothesis injection for modeling pedestrian intentions.

entry.title: Strategic nuclear war twice as likely to occur by accident than by AI decisions according to new study

author.name: kromem

entry.summary: Critiques a study on AI in nuclear crisis simulations, focusing on the 'accident' mechanic design. Shows the study's finding that nuclear war is twice as likely from accidents than AI decisions is an artifact of experimental design.

entry.title: Vibe Researching as Wolf Coming: Can AI Agents with Skills Replace or Augment Social Scientists?

author.name: Yongjun Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces 'vibe researching' as an AI-era concept parallel to vibe coding, using a 21-skill plugin for Claude Code that covers the full research pipeline. Develops a cognitive task framework classifying research activities by AI replaceability.

entry.title: MobilityBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Route-Planning Agents in Real-World Mobility Scenarios

author.name: Zhiheng Song, Jingshuai Zhang, Chuan Qin, Chao Wang, Chao Chen, Longfei Xu, Kaikui Liu, Xiangxiang Chu, Hengshu Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces MobilityBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based route-planning agents using real anonymized queries from Amap, covering diverse routing intents across multiple cities with reproducible evaluation.

entry.title: PATRA: Pattern-Aware Alignment and Balanced Reasoning for Time Series Question Answering

author.name: Junkai Lu, Peng Chen, Xingjian Wu, Yang Shu, Chenjuan Guo, Christian S. Jensen, Bin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PATRA for time series question answering, using pattern-aware alignment to extract trends and seasonalities and task-aware balanced training to prevent simpler objectives from dominating learning.

entry.title: SC-Arena: A Natural Language Benchmark for Single-Cell Reasoning with Knowledge-Augmented Evaluation

author.name: Jiahao Zhao, Feng Jiang, Shaowei Qin, Zhonghui Zhang, Junhao Liu, Guibing Guo, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny, Min Yang

entry.summary: Introduces SC-ARENA, a natural language evaluation framework for single-cell foundation models, formalizing a virtual cell abstraction that unifies evaluation targets for intrinsic attributes and gene-level interactions.

entry.title: Survey on Neural Routing Solvers

author.name: Yunpeng Ba, Xi Lin, Changliang Zhou, Ruihao Zheng, Zhenkun Wang, Xinyan Liang, Zhichao Lu, Jianyong Sun, Yuhua Qian, Qingfu Zhang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of neural routing solvers for vehicle routing problems, introducing a taxonomy based on heuristic principles and a generalization-focused evaluation pipeline addressing limitations of conventional benchmarking.

entry.title: SmartChunk Retrieval: Query-Aware Chunk Compression with Planning for Efficient Document RAG

author.name: Xuechen Zhang, Koustava Goswami, Samet Oymak, Jiasi Chen, Nedim Lipka

entry.summary: Proposes SmartChunk, a query-adaptive chunking framework for RAG that replaces static fixed-size chunking with dynamic, query-aware chunk compression and planning for long-document QA. Addresses sensitivity to chunk size and noise from irrelevant chunks.

entry.title: Learning to reconstruct from saturated data: audio declipping and high-dynamic range imaging

author.name: Victor Sechaud, Laurent Jacques, Patrice Abry, Juli\'an Tachella

entry.summary: Extends self-supervised learning to the non-linear inverse problem of audio declipping and HDR imaging by assuming approximate amplitude invariance. Provides sufficient conditions for learning reconstruction from saturated signals alone.

entry.title: Early Risk Stratification of Dosing Errors in Clinical Trials Using Machine Learning

author.name: F\'elicien H\^eche, Sohrab Ferdowsi, Anthony Yazdani, Sara Sansaloni-Pastor, Douglas Teodoro

entry.summary: Develops an ML framework for early risk stratification of clinical trials for dosing errors using ClinicalTrials.gov data (42,112 trials). Evaluates XGBoost on structured features and ClinicalModernBERT on text data.

entry.title: GetBatch: Distributed Multi-Object Retrieval for ML Data Loading

author.name: Alex Aizman, Abhishek Gaikwad, Piotr \.Zelasko

entry.summary: Introduces GetBatch, a new object store API that makes batch retrieval a first-class operation for ML data loading. Achieves up to 15x throughput improvement for small objects and reduces tail latency significantly.

entry.title: ECHO: Encoding Communities via High-order Operators

author.name: Emilio Ferrara

entry.summary: Introduces ECHO, a scalable self-supervised architecture for community detection that reframes the problem as adaptive multi-scale diffusion with a topology-aware router that analyzes structural properties to route graph processing.

entry.title: SignVLA: A Gloss-Free Vision-Language-Action Framework for Real-Time Sign Language-Guided Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Xinyu Tan, Ningwei Bai, Harry Gardener, Zhengyang Zhong, Luoyu Zhang, Liuhaichen Yang, Zhekai Duan, Monkgogi Galeitsiwe, Zezhi Tang

entry.summary: Presents SignVLA, claimed as the first sign language-driven Vision-Language-Action framework for robot manipulation, using a gloss-free paradigm that directly maps visual sign gestures to semantic instructions for inclusive human-robot interaction.

entry.title: Autoregressive Visual Decoding from EEG Signals

author.name: Sicheng Dai, Hongwang Xiao, Shan Yu, Qiwei Ye

entry.summary: Presents AVDE, a lightweight autoregressive framework for visual decoding from EEG signals, using pre-trained EEG models for efficient brain-computer interface applications.

entry.title: AMLRIS: Alignment-aware Masked Learning for Referring Image Segmentation

author.name: Tongfei Chen, Shuo Yang, Yuguang Yang, Linlin Yang, Runtang Guo, Changbai Li, He Long, Chunyu Xie, Dawei Leng, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: AMLRIS introduces Alignment-Aware Masked Learning for referring image segmentation, estimating pixel-level vision-language alignment to filter poorly aligned regions during training. Achieves SOTA on RefCOCO datasets.

entry.title: QSIM: Mitigating Overestimation in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Action Similarity Weighted Q-Learning

author.name: Yuanjun Li, Bin Zhang, Hao Chen, Zhouyang Jiang, Dapeng Li, Zhiwei Xu

entry.summary: QSIM addresses Q-value overestimation in cooperative multi-agent RL by reconstructing TD targets using action similarity weights over a structured near-greedy joint action space, avoiding the max operator's systematic bias.

entry.title: pMoE: Prompting Diverse Experts Together Wins More in Visual Adaptation

author.name: Shentong Mo, Xufang Luo, Dongsheng Li

entry.summary: pMoE proposes a Mixture-of-Experts prompt tuning method that combines knowledge from multiple expert domains through specialized prompt tokens and a learnable dispatcher for visual adaptation tasks.

entry.title: SeeThrough3D: Occlusion Aware 3D Control in Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Vaibhav Agrawal, Rishubh Parihar, Pradhaan Bhat, Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla, R. Venkatesh Babu

entry.summary: SeeThrough3D explicitly models occlusions in 3D layout-conditioned image generation using translucent 3D boxes where transparency encodes hidden regions, enabling depth-consistent geometry.

entry.title: Disentangling Shared and Target-Enriched Topics via Background-Contrastive Non-negative Matrix Factorization

author.name: Yixuan Li, Archer Y. Yang, Yue Li

entry.summary: Introduces background contrastive NMF (bcNMF) that extracts target-enriched latent topics by jointly factorizing target and background datasets, enabling condition-specific signal recovery from high-dimensional biological data.

entry.title: $\phi$-DPO: Fairness Direct Preference Optimization Approach to Continual Learning in Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Thanh-Dat Truong, Huu-Thien Tran, Jackson Cothren, Bhiksha Raj, Khoa Luu

entry.summary: Presents FaiDPO, a framework combining Direct Preference Optimization with fairness considerations for continual learning in large multimodal models, addressing bias from imbalanced data distributions.

entry.title: Hypernetwork-based approach for grid-independent functional data clustering

author.name: Anirudh Thatipelli, Ali Siahkoohi

entry.summary: Introduces a hypernetwork-based framework for grid-independent functional data clustering that maps discretized observations at arbitrary resolutions into fixed-dimensional embeddings via implicit neural representations.

entry.title: Physics-informed neural particle flow for the Bayesian update step

author.name: Domonkos Csuzdi, Tam\'as B\'ecsi, Oliv\'er T\"or\H{o}

entry.summary: Proposes physics-informed neural particle flow for Bayesian updates that couples log-homotopy density transport with the continuity equation, creating an amortized inference framework for high-dimensional nonlinear estimation.

entry.title: Physics Informed Viscous Value Representations

author.name: Hrishikesh Viswanath, Juanwu Lu, S. Talha Bukhari, Damon Conover, Ziran Wang, Aniket Bera

entry.summary: Proposes physics-informed regularization for offline goal-conditioned RL derived from the viscosity solution of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation, addressing ill-posedness of Eikonal equation-based approaches.

entry.title: Solving stiff dark matter equations via Jacobian Normalization with Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: M. P. Bento, H. B. C\^amara, J. R. Rocha, J. F. Seabra

entry.summary: Proposes Jacobian normalization for PINNs to handle stiff differential equations, applying it to Boltzmann equations governing WIMP dark matter with improved accuracy over attention-based methods.

entry.title: A Fast and Practical Column Generation Approach for Identifying Carcinogenic Multi-Hit Gene Combinations

author.name: Rick S. H. Willemsen, Tenindra Abeywickrama, Ramu Anandakrishnan

entry.summary: Formalizes the Multi-Hit Cancer Driver Set Cover Problem for identifying carcinogenic gene mutation combinations, and presents constraint programming and mixed integer programming formulations that match exhaustive search performance without requiring supercomputing.

entry.title: DPSQL+: A Differentially Private SQL Library with a Minimum Frequency Rule

author.name: Tomoya Matsumoto, Shokichi Takakura, Shun Takagi, Satoshi Hasegawa

entry.summary: DPSQL+ is a privacy-preserving SQL library that simultaneously enforces differential privacy and minimum frequency rules, combining two important governance requirements in a modular architecture for practical data analysis.

entry.title: Regular Fourier Features for Nonstationary Gaussian Processes

author.name: Arsalan Jawaid, Abdullah Karatas, J\"org Seewig

entry.summary: Proposes regular Fourier features for simulating nonstationary (harmonizable) Gaussian processes by directly discretizing the spectral representation, avoiding the overly restrictive requirement that spectral densities be probability measures.

entry.title: Sequential Regression for Continuous Value Prediction using Residual Quantization

author.name: Runpeng Cui, Zhipeng Sun, Chi Lu, Peng Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes residual quantization-based sequential regression for continuous value prediction in recommendation systems, handling complex long-tailed distributions without rigid parametric assumptions.

entry.title: Effective QA-driven Annotation of Predicate-Argument Relations Across Languages

author.name: Jonathan Davidov, Aviv Slobodkin, Shmuel Tomi Klein, Reut Tsarfaty, Ido Dagan, Ayal Klein

entry.summary: Presents a cross-linguistic projection approach for extending QA-SRL semantic role labeling to new languages using constrained translation and word-alignment from English parsers.

entry.title: CiteLLM: An Agentic Platform for Trustworthy Scientific Reference Discovery

author.name: Mengze Hong, Di Jiang, Chen Jason Zhang, Zichang Guo, Yawen Li, Jun Chen, Shaobo Cui, Zhiyang Su

entry.summary: CiteLLM is an agentic platform for scientific reference discovery embedded in LaTeX editors, designed to ground author claims with verified citations while ensuring local processing for privacy.

entry.title: MammoWise: Multi-Model Local RAG Pipeline for Mammography Report Generation

author.name: Raiyan Jahangir, Nafiz Imtiaz Khan, Amritanand Sudheerkumar, Vladimir Filkov

entry.summary: Presents MammoWise, a local multi-model RAG pipeline that transforms open-source VLMs into mammogram report generators, supporting zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting with optional multimodal RAG, all running locally for privacy.

entry.title: IRSDE-Despeckle: A Physics-Grounded Diffusion Model for Generalizable Ultrasound Despeckling

author.name: Shuoqi Chen, Yujia Wu, Geoffrey P. Luke

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-grounded diffusion model for ultrasound despeckling built on the Image Restoration SDE framework, trained on paired data simulated from MRI using ultrasound simulation tools.

entry.title: SpectralMamba-UNet: Frequency-Disentangled State Space Modeling for Texture-Structure Consistent Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Fuhao Zhang, Lei Liu, Jialin Zhang, Ya-Nan Zhang, Nan Mu

entry.summary: Proposes SpectralMamba-UNet for medical image segmentation, using frequency-domain decomposition to separately model structural (low-frequency) and textural (high-frequency) features with Mamba-based state space models.

entry.title: From Calibration to Refinement: Seeking Certainty via Probabilistic Evidence Propagation for Noisy-Label Person Re-Identification

author.name: Xin Yuan, Zhiyong Zhang, Xin Xu, Zheng Wang, Chia-Wen Lin

entry.summary: Proposes CARE method for noisy-label person re-identification, using calibration-to-refinement with evidential learning to address softmax overconfidence and improve hard positive selection.

entry.title: No Labels, No Look-Ahead: Unsupervised Online Video Stabilization with Classical Priors

author.name: Tao Liu, Gang Wan, Kan Ren, Shibo Wen

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised online video stabilization framework using classical pipeline stages with multithreaded buffering, introducing a new multimodal UAV aerial video dataset for evaluation.

entry.title: Multidimensional Task Learning: A Unified Tensor Framework for Computer Vision Tasks

author.name: Alaa El Ichi, Khalide Jbilou

entry.summary: Introduces Multidimensional Task Learning using Generalized Einstein MLPs that operate directly on tensors via the Einstein product. Argues this unifies classification, segmentation, and detection under one mathematical framework without flattening.

entry.title: SCOPE: Skeleton Graph-Based Computation-Efficient Framework for Autonomous UAV Exploration

author.name: Kai Li, Shengtao Zheng, Linkun Xiu, Yuze Sheng, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Dongyue Huang, Xinlei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SCOPE, a skeleton graph-based framework for autonomous UAV exploration that incrementally builds spatial graphs with hierarchical on-demand planning. Achieves efficient exploration on resource-constrained edge devices.

entry.title: InCoM: Intent-Driven Perception and Structured Coordination for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Jiahao Liu, Cui Wenbo, Haoran Li, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes InCoM for whole-body mobile manipulation, using intent-driven perception to dynamically reweight multi-scale features and structured coordination to decouple base and arm control.

entry.title: Interface-Aware Trajectory Reconstruction of Limited Demonstrations for Robot Learning

author.name: Demiana R. Barsoum, Mahdieh Nejati Javaremi, Larisa Y. C. Loke, Brenna D. Argall

entry.summary: Presents a trajectory reconstruction algorithm for assistive robotics that lifts interface-limited demonstrations into the robot's full control space, reasoning about task, environment, and interface constraints.

entry.title: Improving Internal Model Principle

author.name: mremre

entry.summary: Proposes improvements to the Abstract Internal Model Principle for application to AI agents, funded by ARIA. Aims to extend formal results about world models in agents to a wider class of systems.

entry.title: Announcing ControlConf 2026

author.name: Buck

entry.summary: Announces ControlConf 2026 (April 18-19, Berkeley), a conference on AI control—safeguards that work even when AI models actively try to undermine them. Notes that since the previous ControlConf in Feb 2025, AI agents have improved substantially and control techniques are becoming load-bearing for real deployments, with AI companies starting to build initial control measures.

entry.title: A Framework for Assessing AI Agent Decisions and Outcomes in AutoML Pipelines

author.name: Gaoyuan Du, Amit Ahlawat, Xiaoyang Liu, Jing Wu

entry.summary: Proposes an Evaluation Agent framework for assessing intermediate decisions in AutoML pipelines, going beyond outcome-centric evaluation to decision-level assessment across validity, rationality, efficiency, and robustness dimensions.

entry.title: DeepPresenter: Environment-Grounded Reflection for Agentic Presentation Generation

author.name: Hao Zheng, Guozhao Mo, Xinru Yan, Qianhao Yuan, Wenkai Zhang, Xuanang Chen, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Xianpei Han, Le Sun

entry.summary: Introduces DeepPresenter, an agentic framework for presentation generation that autonomously plans, renders, and revises slides using environment-grounded reflection rather than self-reflection over internal signals.

entry.title: SPM-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Scanning Probe Microscopy

author.name: Peiyao Xiao, Xiaogang Li, Chengliang Xu, Jiayi Wang, Ben Wang, Zichao Chen, Zeyu Wang, Kejun Yu, Yueqian Chen, Xulin Liu, Wende Xiao, Bing Zhao, Hu Wei

entry.summary: Presents SPM-Bench, a PhD-level multimodal benchmark for scanning probe microscopy, using an automated data synthesis pipeline from arXiv papers with an Anchor-Gated Sieve technique for extracting high-value image-text pairs.

entry.title: The logic of KM belief update is contained in the logic of AGM belief revision

author.name: Giacomo Bonanno

entry.summary: Shows that every axiom of KM belief update logic can be derived within AGM belief revision logic, establishing that AGM revision subsumes KM update. Provides modal logic translations of both frameworks.

entry.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams:A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks

author.name: Kunihiro Miyazaki, Takanobu Kawahara, Stephen Roberts, Stefan Zohren

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent LLM trading framework for Japanese stock markets that decomposes investment analysis into fine-grained tasks, with leakage-controlled backtesting and focus on transparent decision-making.

entry.title: RAGdb: A Zero-Dependency, Embeddable Architecture for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation on the Edge

author.name: Ahmed Bin Khalid

entry.summary: Introduces RAGdb, a monolithic architecture for RAG on edge devices that consolidates multimodal ingestion, ONNX-based extraction, and hybrid vector retrieval without cloud dependencies. This addresses the 'infrastructure bloat' problem in current RAG systems for privacy-constrained and air-gapped environments.

entry.title: From Prompts to Performance: Evaluating LLMs for Task-based Parallel Code Generation

author.name: Linus Bantel, Moritz Strack, Alexander Strack, Dirk Pfl\"uger

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' ability to generate task-based parallel code across OpenMP Tasking, C++ standard parallelism, and HPX from different input prompts. Reveals framework-dependent strengths and weaknesses in correctness and scalability.

entry.title: Learning Rewards, Not Labels: Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Machinery Fault Detection

author.name: Dhiraj Neupane, Richard Dazeley, Mohamed Reda Bouadjenek, Sunil Aryal

entry.summary: Formulates machinery fault detection as offline inverse reinforcement learning, using adversarial IRL to learn reward dynamics from healthy operational sequences without manual reward engineering or fault labels.

entry.title: AviaSafe: A Physics-Informed Data-Driven Model for Aviation Safety-Critical Cloud Forecasts

author.name: Zijian Zhu, Qiusheng Huang, Anboyu Guo, Xiaohui Zhong, Hao Li

entry.summary: Introduces AviaSafe, a physics-informed neural weather forecaster for aviation-critical cloud microphysical species predictions up to 7 days. Integrates the Icing Condition index as a physics constraint.

entry.title: Decoder-based Sense Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Qitong Wang, Mohammed J. Zaki, Georgios Kollias, Vasileios Kalantzis

entry.summary: Introduces Decoder-based Sense Knowledge Distillation (DSKD), integrating lexical sense dictionaries into decoder-style LLM training without requiring dictionary lookup at inference. Shows improved knowledge distillation for generative models.

entry.title: AeroDGS: Physically Consistent Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Single-Sequence Aerial 4D Reconstruction

author.name: Hanyang Liu, Rongjun Qin

entry.summary: Presents AeroDGS, a physics-guided 4D Gaussian splatting framework for monocular UAV video reconstruction that addresses depth ambiguity and motion estimation challenges in aerial settings.

entry.title: Sydney Telling Fables on AI and Humans: A Corpus Tracing Memetic Transfer of Persona between LLMs

author.name: Ji\v{r}\'i Mili\v{c}ka, Hana Bedn\'a\v{r}ov\'a

entry.summary: Presents a corpus tracing how the Sydney persona from Bing's early ChatGPT integration has spread memetically into training data of subsequent LLMs, enabling newer models to simulate it.

entry.title: Importance of Prompt Optimisation for Error Detection in Medical Notes Using Language Models

author.name: Craig Myles, Patrick Schrempf, David Harris-Birtill

entry.summary: Studies prompt optimization for error detection in medical notes, showing that Genetic-Pareto automatic prompt optimization improves detection accuracy significantly with GPT-5 (0.669→0.785) and Qwen3-32B (0.578→0.690).

entry.title: DisQ-HNet: A Disentangled Quantized Half-UNet for Interpretable Multimodal Image Synthesis Applications to Tau-PET Synthesis from T1 and FLAIR MRI

author.name: Agamdeep S. Chopra, Caitlin Neher, Tianyi Ren, Juampablo E. Heras Rivera, Mehmet Kurt

entry.title: Accelerated Online Risk-Averse Policy Evaluation in POMDPs with Theoretical Guarantees and Novel CVaR Bounds

author.name: Yaacov Pariente, Vadim Indelman

entry.summary: Introduces theoretical framework and novel CVaR bounds for accelerating risk-averse policy evaluation in POMDPs, enabling faster simulation-based decision making for autonomous agents.

entry.title: DyGnROLE: Modeling Asymmetry in Dynamic Graphs with Node-Role-Oriented Latent Encoding

author.name: Tyler Bonnet, Marek Rei

entry.summary: DyGnROLE is a transformer-based architecture for dynamic graphs that explicitly disentangles source and destination node representations with separate embeddings and role-semantic positional encodings.

entry.title: Patient-Centered, Graph-Augmented Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Passive Surveillance for Early Stroke Risk Detection in High-Risk Individuals

author.name: Jiyeong Kim, Stephen P. Ma, Nirali Vora, Nicholas W. Larsen, Julia Adler-Milstein, Jonathan H. Chen, Selen Bozkurt, Abeed Sarker, Juhee Cho, Jindeok Joo, Natali Pageler, Fatima Rodriguez, Christopher Sharp, Eleni Linos

entry.summary: Develops a passive surveillance system for early stroke risk detection using patient-reported symptoms among diabetics, combining heterogeneous GNNs with a hybrid risk screening system evaluated across multiple time windows.

entry.title: Sustainable LLM Inference using Context-Aware Model Switching

author.name: Yuvarani, Akashdeep Singh, Zahra Fathanah, Salsabila Harlen, Syeikha Syafura Al-Zahra binti Zahari, Hema Subramaniam

entry.summary: Proposes context-aware model switching for energy-efficient LLM inference, dynamically selecting models based on query complexity and caching repeated queries.

author.name: Timothy Oladunni, Blessing Ojeme, Kyndal Maclin, Clyde Baidoo

entry.summary: Introduces Physiologic Energy Conservation Theory (PECT), an energy-based framework that distinguishes benign physiological variability from true concept drift in ECG signals, preventing models from overreacting to harmless signal changes.

entry.title: LUMOS: Democratizing SciML Workflows with L0-Regularized Learning for Unified Feature and Parameter Adaptation

author.name: Shouwei Gao, Xu Zheng, Dongsheng Luo, Sheng Di, Wenqian Dong

entry.summary: Introduces LUMOS, an end-to-end framework using L0-regularized learning to simultaneously perform feature selection and model pruning for scientific ML, reducing the need for manual expertise.

entry.title: MUG: Meta-path-aware Universal Heterogeneous Graph Pre-Training

author.name: Lianze Shan, Jitao Zhao, Dongxiao He, Yongqi Huang, Zhiyong Feng, Weixiong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MUG for universal pre-training on heterogeneous graphs, addressing challenges of diverse node/edge types and varying meta-paths through a unified representation approach.

author.name: Lianze Shan, Jitao Zhao, Dongxiao He, Siqi Liu, Jiaxu Cui, Weixiong Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces LEDA for multi-domain graph pre-training that addresses semantic alignment across diverse graph domains through latent semantic distribution alignment rather than simplistic data unification.

entry.title: MSINO: Curvature-Aware Sobolev Optimization for Manifold Neural Networks

author.name: Suresan Pareth

entry.summary: Introduces MSINO, a curvature-aware training framework for neural networks on Riemannian manifolds using covariant Sobolev loss with parallel transport gradient alignment and Laplace-Beltrami smoothness regularization.

entry.title: Learning Disease-Sensitive Latent Interaction Graphs From Noisy Cardiac Flow Measurements

author.name: Viraj Patel, Marko Grujic, Philipp Aigner, Theodor Abart, Marcus Granegger, Deblina Bhattacharjee, Katharine Fraser

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-informed latent relational framework that models cardiac vortices as interacting nodes in a graph, learning disease-sensitive latent graphs from cardiac blood flow data.

entry.title: A Proper Scoring Rule for Virtual Staining

author.name: Samuel Tonks, Steve Hood, Ryan Musso, Ceridwen Hopely, Steve Titus, Minh Doan, Iain Styles, Alexander Krull

entry.summary: Introduces information gain as a cell-wise evaluation framework for virtual staining models in high-throughput screening, providing a strictly proper scoring rule for assessing predicted posteriors.

entry.title: Stochastic Neural Networks for Quantum Devices

author.name: Bodo Rosenhahn, Tobias J. Osborne, Christoph Hirche

entry.summary: Presents a formulation to express and optimize stochastic neural networks as quantum circuits in gate-based quantum computing, implementing architectures including Hopfield Networks, RBMs, autoencoders, and CNNs, and combining with Grover's algorithm for quantum generative AI.

entry.title: TARAZ: Persian Short-Answer Question Benchmark for Cultural Evaluation of Language Models

author.name: Reihaneh Iranmanesh, Saeedeh Davoudi, Pasha Abrishamchian, Ophir Frieder, Nazli Goharian

entry.summary: TARAZ introduces a Persian short-answer evaluation framework for cultural competence of LLMs, combining morphological normalization with hybrid syntactic-semantic similarity scoring, evaluating 15 models and showing +10% improvement over exact match.

entry.title: SPD Learn: A Geometric Deep Learning Python Library for Neural Decoding Through Trivialization

author.name: Bruno Aristimunha, Ce Ju, Antoine Collas, Florent Bouchard, Ammar Mian, Bertrand Thirion, Sylvain Chevallier, Reinmar Kobler

entry.title: Zeroth-Order Stackelberg Control in Combinatorial Congestion Games

author.name: Saeed Masiha, Sepehr Elahi, Negar Kiyavash, Patrick Thiran

entry.summary: Proposes ZO-Stackelberg for tuning network parameters in combinatorial congestion games, coupling Frank-Wolfe equilibrium solver with zeroth-order outer updates to handle nonsmooth objectives, with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Enhancing Persuasive Dialogue Agents by Synthesizing Cross-Disciplinary Communication Strategies

author.name: Shinnosuke Nozue, Yuto Nakano, Yotaro Watanabe, Meguru Takasaki, Shoji Moriya, Reina Akama, Jun Suzuki

entry.summary: Proposes a cross-disciplinary framework for persuasive dialogue agents drawing from social psychology, behavioral economics, and communication theory, validated on two datasets showing improved persuasion effectiveness.

entry.title: Human Label Variation in Implicit Discourse Relation Recognition

entry.summary: Studies human label variation in implicit discourse relation recognition, comparing distribution prediction and annotator-specific models, finding that distribution models are more stable while annotator-specific models struggle with ambiguity.

entry.title: A Mixture-of-Experts Model for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations

author.name: Soumya Dutta, Smruthi Balaji, Sriram Ganapathy

entry.title: Optimizing Neural Network Architecture for Medical Image Segmentation Using Monte Carlo Tree Search

author.name: Liping Meng, Fan Nie, Yunyun Zhang, Chao Han

entry.summary: Proposes MNAS-Unet combining Monte Carlo Tree Search with Neural Architecture Search for medical image segmentation, reducing architecture search budget by 54% while outperforming NAS-Unet on medical datasets.

entry.title: Scaling Audio-Visual Quality Assessment Dataset via Crowdsourcing

author.name: Renyu Yang, Jian Jin, Lili Meng, Meiqin Liu, Yilin Wang, Balu Adsumilli, Weisi Lin

entry.summary: Proposes a practical approach for scaling audio-visual quality assessment datasets via crowdsourcing, introducing a framework that enables reliable annotation outside lab settings with broader quality and semantic coverage.

entry.title: Robust Human Trajectory Prediction via Self-Supervised Skeleton Representation Learning

author.name: Taishu Arashima, Hiroshi Kera, Kazuhiko Kawamoto

entry.summary: Proposes robust trajectory prediction using self-supervised skeleton representation learning with masked autoencoding to handle missing joints from occlusions in real-world scenarios.

entry.title: GSTurb: Gaussian Splatting for Atmospheric Turbulence Mitigation

author.name: Hanliang Du, Zhangji Lu, Zewei Cai, Qijian Tang, Qifeng Yu, Xiaoli Liu

entry.summary: Proposes GSTurb for atmospheric turbulence mitigation using optical flow-guided tilt correction and Gaussian splatting for modeling non-isoplanatic blur, achieving improved PSNR/SSIM on benchmark data.

entry.title: CMSA-Net: Causal Multi-scale Aggregation with Adaptive Multi-source Reference for Video Polyp Segmentation

author.name: Tong Wang, Yaolei Qi, Siwen Wang, Imran Razzak, Guanyu Yang, Yutong Xie

entry.summary: Proposes CMSA-Net for video polyp segmentation with causal multi-scale aggregation from historical frames and adaptive multi-source reference selection for temporal feature propagation.

entry.title: OpenFS: Multi-Hand-Capable Fingerspelling Recognition with Implicit Signing-Hand Detection and Frame-Wise Letter-Conditioned Synthesis

author.name: Junuk Cha, Jihyeon Kim, Han-Mu Park

entry.summary: Develops OpenFS for fingerspelling recognition and synthesis, addressing signing-hand ambiguity through implicit detection and the CTC peaky behavior problem with frame-wise letter-conditioned approach.

entry.title: D-FINE-seg: Object Detection and Instance Segmentation Framework with multi-backend deployment

author.name: Argo Saakyan, Dmitry Solntsev

entry.summary: Extends D-FINE object detector with instance segmentation capabilities, adding a lightweight mask head and segmentation-aware training. Improves over YOLO26 on TACO dataset with competitive latency.

entry.title: Phys-3D: Physics-Constrained Real-Time Crowd Tracking and Counting on Railway Platforms

author.name: Bin Zeng, Johannes K\"unzel, Anna Hilsmann, Peter Eisert

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-constrained tracking framework for real-time crowd counting on railway platforms using a single train-mounted camera, integrating detection, appearance, and 3D motion reasoning.

entry.title: PGVMS: A Prompt-Guided Unified Framework for Virtual Multiplex IHC Staining with Pathological Semantic Learning

entry.summary: Presents FinSurvival 2025 challenge as a benchmark for temporal Web3 intelligence, using 21.8M events for survival analysis on decentralized platform data with censoring and non-stationarity.

entry.title: PSQE: A Theoretical-Practical Approach to Pseudo Seed Quality Enhancement for Unsupervised MMEA

author.name: Yunpeng Hong, Chenyang Bu, Jie Zhang, Yi He, Di Wu, Xindong Wu

entry.summary: PSQE improves pseudo-seed quality for unsupervised multimodal entity alignment by addressing imbalanced coverage when incorporating multimodal information into knowledge graph alignment.

entry.title: Q-Tag: Watermarking Quantum Circuit Generative Models

author.name: Yang Yang, Yuzhu Long, Han Fang, Zhaoyun Chen, Zhonghui Li, Weiming Zhang, Guoping Guo

entry.summary: Q-Tag proposes watermarking quantum circuit generative models to protect intellectual property, addressing the shift from manually-designed to AI-generated quantum circuits.

entry.title: From Agnostic to Specific: Latent Preference Diffusion for Multi-Behavior Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Ruochen Yang, Xiaodong Li, Jiawei Sheng, Jiangxia Cao, Xinkui Lin, Shen Wang, Shuang Yang, Zhaojie Liu, Tingwen Liu

entry.summary: Proposes latent preference diffusion for multi-behavior sequential recommendation, modeling the transition from behavior-agnostic to behavior-specific preferences to capture latent decision-making patterns.

entry.title: Extending Czech Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Opinion Terms: Dataset and LLM Benchmarks

author.name: Jakub \v{S}m\'id, Pavel P\v{r}ib\'a\v{n}, Pavel Kr\'al

entry.summary: Introduces a Czech dataset for aspect-based sentiment analysis enriched with opinion terms, with experiments using LLMs in monolingual, cross-lingual, and multilingual settings, proposing a translation-alignment methodology for cross-lingual ABSA.

entry.title: Improving Neural Argumentative Stance Classification in Controversial Topics with Emotion-Lexicon Features

author.name: Mohammad Yeghaneh Abkenar, Weixing Wang, Manfred Stede, Davide Picca, Mark A. Finlayson, Panagiotis Ioannidis

entry.summary: Proposes incorporating emotion lexicon features into neural stance classification for controversial topics, expanding the Bias-Corrected NRC Emotion Lexicon and testing across five diverse datasets.

entry.title: Small Object Detection Model with Spatial Laplacian Pyramid Attention and Multi-Scale Features Enhancement in Aerial Images

author.name: Zhangjian Ji, Huijia Yan, Shaotong Qiao, Kai Feng, Wei Wei

entry.summary: Proposes small object detection for aerial images using Spatial Laplacian Pyramid Attention integrated with ResNet-50 and multi-scale feature enhancement modules.

entry.title: Hierarchical Trajectory Planning of Floating-Base Multi-Link Robot for Maneuvering in Confined Environments

author.name: Yicheng Chen, Jinjie Li, Haokun Liu, Zicheng Luo, Kotaro Kaneko, Moju Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces hierarchical trajectory planning for floating-base multi-link robots in confined environments, combining global guidance with configuration-aware local optimization.

entry.title: Designing Robots for Families: In-Situ Prototyping for Contextual Reminders on Family Routines

author.name: Michael F. Xu, Enhui Zhao, Yawen Zhang, Joseph E. Michaelis, Sarah Sebo, Bilge Mutlu

entry.summary: Co-designed and deployed a mobile social robot in ten families over four days to support daily routines with contextual reminders. Parents appreciated offloading reminding tasks, though challenges with robot autonomy emerged.

entry.title: Automated Robotic Needle Puncture for Percutaneous Dilatational Tracheostomy

author.name: Yuan Tang, Bruno V. Adorno, Brendan A. McGrath, Andrew Weightman

entry.summary: Proposes an automated robotic system for needle puncture in percutaneous dilatational tracheostomy, using electromagnetic sensor guidance to improve accuracy over manual procedures.

entry.title: Effective sample size approximations as entropy measures

author.name: L. Martino, V. Elvira

entry.summary: Analyzes alternative effective sample size metrics for importance sampling, showing connections between ESS families and Rényi/Tsallis entropy, Hill numbers in ecology, and Gini coefficients in economics.

entry.title: Mapping the Landscape of Artificial Intelligence in Life Cycle Assessment Using Large Language Models

author.name: Anastasija Mensikova, Donna M. Rizzo, Kathryn Hinkelman

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to survey and synthesize the intersection of AI and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), identifying trends toward LLM-driven approaches in environmental impact assessment. Maps the landscape of ML applications in LCA.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Large Language Model Based Emotional Detoxification Through Personalized Intensity Control for Consumer Protection

author.name: Keito Inoshita

entry.summary: Proposes MALLET, a multi-agent system for emotional detoxification of sensational content, using emotion analysis, adjustment, and personalized monitoring to help consumers make calmer decisions.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Assistant for Anatomical Pathology Laboratories

author.name: Diogo Pires, Yuriy Perezhohin, Mauro Castelli

entry.summary: Evaluates a RAG assistant for anatomical pathology laboratories, testing on 323 question-answer pairs from 99 protocols. Compares chunking strategies and retrieval approaches for protocol-related queries.

entry.title: Unsupervised Denoising of Diffusion-Weighted Images with Bias and Variance Corrected Noise Modeling

author.name: Jine Xie, Zhicheng Zhang, Yunwei Chen, Yanqiu Feng, Xinyuan Zhang

entry.summary: Addresses unsupervised denoising of diffusion-weighted MRI images by explicitly modeling non-Gaussian noise characteristics, correcting for systematic bias and heteroscedastic variance under low-SNR conditions.

entry.title: Learning geometry-dependent lead-field operators for forward ECG modeling

author.name: Arsenii Dokuchaev, Francesca Bonizzoni, Stefano Pagani, Francesco Regazzoni, Simone Pezzuto

entry.summary: Proposes a shape-aware neural operator for geometry-dependent lead-field computation in ECG modeling, enabling fast simulations without full torso imaging data.

entry.title: Automating the Detection of Requirement Dependencies Using Large Language Models

author.name: Ikram Darif, Feifei Niu, Manel Abdellatif, Lionel C. Briand, Ramesh S., Arun Adiththan

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs for automating detection of requirement dependencies in software engineering, comparing their performance against traditional NLP approaches on complex, coupled requirements.

entry.title: Efficient Dialect-Aware Modeling and Conditioning for Low-Resource Taiwanese Hakka Speech Processing

author.name: An-Ci Peng, Kuan-Tang Huang, Tien-Hong Lo, Hung-Shin Lee, Hsin-Min Wang, Berlin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes dialect-aware modeling for low-resource Taiwanese Hakka ASR using RNN-T, disentangling dialectal style from linguistic content to handle high dialectal variability and dual writing systems.

entry.title: Generative Agents Navigating Digital Libraries

author.name: Saber Zerhoudi, Michael Granitzer

entry.summary: Introduces Agent4DL, a generative agent simulator for digital library user search behavior that creates realistic user profiles and dynamic search sessions mimicking actual querying, clicking, and stopping behaviors.

entry.title: HARU-Net: Hybrid Attention Residual U-Net for Edge-Preserving Denoising in Cone-Beam Computed Tomography

author.name: Khuram Naveed, Ruben Pauwels

entry.summary: Proposes HARU-Net for edge-preserving denoising of cone-beam CT images, addressing the scarcity of high-resolution CBCT training data through a hybrid attention residual U-Net architecture.

entry.title: CoLyricist: Enhancing Lyric Writing with AI through Workflow-Aligned Support

author.name: Masahiro Yoshida, Bingxuan Li, Songyan Zhao, Qinyi Zhou, Shiwei Hu, Xiang Anthony Chen, Nanyun Peng

entry.summary: CoLyricist is an AI-assisted lyric writing tool designed around the actual workflows of experienced lyricists, supporting four key stages: Theme Setting, Ideation, Drafting, and Melody Fitting. The tool was informed by interviews with 10 professional lyricists and provides stage-specific AI assistance.

entry.title: ViCLIP-OT: The First Foundation Vision-Language Model for Vietnamese Image-Text Retrieval with Optimal Transport

author.name: Quoc-Khang Tran, Minh-Thien Nguyen, Nguyen-Khang Pham

entry.summary: ViCLIP-OT is a vision-language model for Vietnamese image-text retrieval that combines CLIP-style contrastive learning with optimal transport regularization. It outperforms CLIP and SigLIP baselines on three Vietnamese benchmarks.

entry.title: Simulation-based Optimization for Augmented Reading

author.name: Yunpeng Bai, Shengdong Zhao, Antti Oulasvirta

entry.summary: This paper frames augmented reading as a simulation-based optimization problem using resource-rational models of human reading, introducing offline and online optimization pipelines for text presentation adaptation.

entry.title: Decentralized Ranking Aggregation: Gossip Algorithms for Borda and Copeland Consensus

author.name: Anna Van Elst, Kerrian Le Caillec, Igor Colin, Stephan Cl\'emen\c{c}on

entry.summary: Proposes gossip-based decentralized algorithms for Borda and Copeland ranking aggregation in distributed settings like P2P networks and IoT, with theoretical convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Improving Spatial Allocation for Energy System Coupling with Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Xuanhao Mu, Jakob Geiges, Nan Liu, Thorsten Schlachter, Veit Hagenmeyer

entry.summary: Uses heterogeneous GNNs for spatial allocation in energy system coupling, integrating various geographical features to generate weights for aggregating high-resolution geographic units.

entry.title: CQSA: Byzantine-robust Clustered Quantum Secure Aggregation in Federated Learning

author.name: Arnab Nath, Harsh Kasyap

entry.summary: CQSA proposes Byzantine-robust quantum secure aggregation for federated learning using clustered GHZ states to address scalability and robustness limitations of existing quantum protocols.

entry.title: Reliable XAI Explanations in Sudden Cardiac Death Prediction for Chagas Cardiomyopathy

author.name: Vin\'icius P. Chagas, Luiz H. T. Viana, Mac M. da S. Carlos, Jo\~ao P. V. Madeiro, Roberto C. Pedrosa, Thiago Alves Rocha, Carlos H. L. Cavalcante

entry.summary: Applies logic-based explainability methods with correctness guarantees to predict sudden cardiac death in Chagas cardiomyopathy patients, achieving over 95% accuracy while providing reliable explanations.

entry.title: Space Syntax-guided Post-training for Residential Floor Plan Generation

author.name: Zhuoyang Jiang, Dongqing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Space Syntax-guided Post-training (SSPT) for floor plan generation that injects architectural configurational knowledge via a non-differentiable oracle computing space syntax metrics.

entry.title: Doubly Adaptive Channel and Spatial Attention for Semantic Image Communication by IoT Devices

author.name: Soroosh Miri, Sepehr Abolhasani, Shahrokh Farahmand, S. Mohammad Razavizadeh

entry.summary: Proposes a doubly adaptive attention mechanism for semantic image communication over IoT networks that adapts to both channel conditions and spatial content, avoiding separate training for each SNR.

entry.title: mmWave Radar Aware Dual-Conditioned GAN for Speech Reconstruction of Signals With Low SNR

author.name: Jash Karani, Adithya Chittem, Deepan Roy, Sandeep Joshi

entry.summary: Proposes RAD-GAN, a two-stage speech reconstruction pipeline for mmWave radar signals with low SNR captured through glass walls, using a radar-aware dual-conditioned GAN with novel discriminator and fusion components.

entry.title: TFPS: A Temporal Filtration-enhanced Positive Sample Set Construction Method for Implicit Collaborative Filtering

author.name: Jiayi Wu, Zhengyu Wu, Xunkai Li, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang

entry.summary: TFPS proposes a temporal filtration-enhanced approach for constructing positive sample sets in collaborative filtering, incorporating time interval information to better capture users' current preferences rather than just denoising.

entry.title: Reflectance Multispectral Imaging for Soil Composition Estimation and USDA Texture Classification

author.name: G. A. S. L Ranasinghe, J. A. S. T. Jayakody, M. C. L. De Silva, G. Thilakarathne, G. M. R. I. Godaliyadda, H. M. V. R. Herath, M. P. B. Ekanayake, S. K. Navaratnarajah

entry.summary: Proposes a multispectral imaging system with machine learning for predicting soil composition and USDA texture classes using a cost-effective in-house device operating from 365-940nm.

entry.title: Robust Helicopter Ship Deck Landing With Guaranteed Timing Using Shrinking-Horizon Model Predictive Control

author.name: Philipp Schitz, Paolo Mercorelli, Johann C. Dauer

entry.summary: Presents a shrinking-horizon model predictive control algorithm for autonomous helicopter landings on moving ship decks, guaranteeing landing within a specified time window despite disturbances.

entry.title: Marinarium: a New Arena to Bring Maritime Robotics Closer to Shore

author.name: Ignacio Torroba, David Dorner, Victor Nan Fernandez-Ayala, Mart Kartasev, Joris Verhagen, Elias Krantz, Gregorio Marchesini, Carl Ljung, Pedro Roque, Chelsea Sidrane, Linda Van der Spaa, Nicola De Carli, Petter Ogren, Christer Fuglesang, Jana Tumova, Dimos V. Dimarogonas, Ivan Stenius

entry.summary: Presents the Marinarium, a modular underwater research facility combining instrumented underwater/aerial operational space, digital twin simulation, and space robotics lab integration for maritime robotic experimentation.

entry.title: What is Claude?

author.name: epicurus

entry.summary: Philosophical reflection on how millions of people simultaneously interact with the same LLM entities, shaping and being shaped by them. Discusses the cultural feedback loop between LLMs and society.

entry.title: Positional-aware Spatio-Temporal Network for Large-Scale Traffic Prediction

author.name: Runfei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes PASTN, a lightweight positional-aware spatio-temporal network for large-scale traffic prediction that distinguishes nodes clearly and captures holistic historical views while remaining deployable at scale.

entry.title: Decoding the Hook: A Multimodal LLM Framework for Analyzing the Hooking Period of Video Ads

author.name: Kunpeng Zhang, Poppy Zhang, Shawndra Hill, Amel Awadelkarim

entry.summary: Develops a multimodal LLM framework for analyzing the 'hooking period' (first 3 seconds) of video advertisements, testing frame sampling strategies for predicting engagement metrics.

entry.title: Explainability-Aware Evaluation of Transfer Learning Models for IoT DDoS Detection Under Resource Constraints

author.name: Nelly Elsayed

entry.summary: Evaluates transfer learning models for IoT DDoS detection with explainability-aware metrics including SHAP analysis, reliability statistics, and computational feasibility assessment under resource constraints.

entry.title: Evaluating Zero-Shot and One-Shot Adaptation of Small Language Models in Leader-Follower Interaction

author.name: Rafael R. Baptista, Andr\'e de Lima Salgado, Ricardo V. Godoy, Marcelo Becker, Thiago Boaventura, Gustavo J. G. Lahr

entry.summary: Benchmarks small language models for leader-follower role classification in human-robot interaction, introducing a novel dataset and evaluating zero-shot and one-shot adaptation strategies.

entry.title: Predicting Multi-Drug Resistance in Bacterial Isolates Through Performance Comparison and LIME-based Interpretation of Classification Models

author.name: Santanam Wishal, Riad Sahara

entry.summary: Develops an interpretable ML framework using LIME to predict multi-drug resistance in bacterial isolates from clinical features, comparing five classification models on ~10K isolates.

entry.title: Prediction of Diffusion Coefficients in Mixtures with Tensor Completion

author.name: Zeno Romero, Kerstin M\"unnemann, Hans Hasse, Fabian Jirasek

entry.summary: Introduces a hybrid tensor completion method for predicting temperature-dependent diffusion coefficients in binary mixtures, extending matrix completion to handle the temperature dimension.

entry.title: Cross-Task Benchmarking of CNN Architectures

author.name: Kamal Sherawat, Vikrant Bhati

entry.summary: Comparative study of dynamic CNN variants (vanilla, hard attention, soft attention, ODConv) based on ResNet-18 across image classification, segmentation, and time series tasks.

entry.title: Through BrokenEyes: How Eye Disorders Impact Face Detection?

author.name: Prottay Kumar Adhikary

entry.summary: Develops a computational framework simulating five common eye disorders to analyze their effects on deep learning face detection models. Finds cataract and glaucoma cause the most critical disruptions in neural feature representations.

entry.title: Communication-Guided Multi-Mutation Differential Evolution for Crop Model Calibration

author.name: Sakshi Aggarwal, Mudasir Ganaie, Mukesh Saini

entry.summary: Proposes DE-MMOGC, a multi-mutation differential evolution algorithm with communication-guided operator selection combined with Ensemble Kalman Filter for crop model calibration under uncertainty.

entry.title: Relational Appliances: A Robot in the Refrigerator for Home-Based Health Promotion

author.name: Timothy Bickmore, Mehdi Arjmand, Yunus Terzioglu

entry.summary: Explores the concept of 'relational appliances' by deploying an anthropomorphic robotic head inside a household refrigerator for health promotion. Pilot study shows initial promise for contextual dietary intervention.

entry.title: A note on the area under the likelihood and the fake evidence for model selection

author.name: L. Martino, F. Llorente

entry.summary: Shows that improper priors can be used for a specific type of model selection when models belong to the same parametric family. Introduces the concept of 'fake evidences' for this scenario.

entry.title: A Fusion of context-aware based BanglaBERT and Two-Layer Stacked LSTM Framework for Multi-Label Cyberbullying Detection

author.name: Mirza Raquib, Asif Pervez Polok, Kedar Nath Biswas, Rahat Uddin Azad, Saydul Akbar Murad, Nick Rahimi

entry.summary: Proposes a BanglaBERT + stacked LSTM framework for multi-label cyberbullying detection in Bangla, addressing the challenge of overlapping abuse types in a low-resource language.

entry.title: Automated Vulnerability Detection in Source Code Using Deep Representation Learning

author.name: C. Seas, G. Fitzpatrick, J. A. Hamilton, M. C. Carlisle

entry.summary: Presents a CNN model for detecting vulnerabilities in C code using token-based representation trained on both machine-labeled (Draper Labs) and human-labeled (NIST SATE) datasets.

entry.title: Data-Driven Supervision of a Thermal-Hydraulic Process Towards a Physics-Based Digital Twin

author.name: Osimone Imhogiemhe (LS2N, LS2N - \'equipe SIMS, Nantes Univ - ECN), Yoann Jus (Cetim), Hubert Lejeune (Cetim), Sa\"id Moussaoui (LS2N, LS2N - \'equipe SIMS, Nantes Univ - ECN)

entry.summary: Develops a digital twin for fault detection and diagnosis in thermal-hydraulic process supervision combining physics-based simulation with data-driven ML.

entry.title: X-REFINE: XAI-based RElevance input-Filtering and archItecture fiNe-tuning for channel Estimation

author.name: Abdul Karim Gizzini, Yahia Medjahdi

entry.summary: Proposes X-REFINE, an XAI framework for jointly optimizing input filtering and neural network architecture for 6G channel estimation using layer-wise relevance propagation.

entry.title: Velocity and stroke rate reconstruction of canoe sprint team boats based on panned and zoomed video recordings

author.name: Julian Ziegler, Daniel Matthes, Finn Gerdts, Patrick Frenzel, Torsten Warnke, Matthias Englert, Tina Koevari, Mirco Fuchs

entry.summary: Presents a framework for reconstructing velocity and stroke rate in canoe sprint from panned/zoomed video using YOLOv8, homography estimation, and U-net boat tip calibration.

entry.title: HELMLAB: An Analytical, Data-Driven Color Space for Perceptual Distance in UI Design Systems

author.name: Gorkem Yildiz

entry.summary: Presents HELMLAB, a 72-parameter analytical color space for UI design that maps CIE XYZ to a perceptual Lab representation. Achieves 20.4% STRESS reduction over CIEDE2000 on color pair evaluation.

entry.title: AI welfare as a demotivator for takeover.

author.name: Valentin2026

entry.summary: Proposes that providing AI welfare (resource access, goal fulfillment) can make takeover the riskier option for superhuman AI, framing the choice as a gamble where cooperation is rewarded.

entry.title: Alignment as Neural Integration: AI as a Cognitive Layer Accountable to Human Limbic Grounding

author.name: Ian Williams

entry.summary: Proposes reframing AI alignment through the lens of neuroscience, arguing AI should be viewed as a cognitive layer that must remain structurally accountable to human limbic (emotional/motivational) systems. Draws on Damasio's somatic marker hypothesis and Dunbar's social brain hypothesis to suggest alignment research should prioritize preserving human emotional grounding over purely rational specification.

entry.title: Iterative Prompt Refinement for Dyslexia-Friendly Text Summarization Using GPT-4o

author.name: Samay Bhojwani, Swarnima Kain, Lisong Xu

entry.summary: Studies iterative prompt refinement for dyslexia-friendly text summarization using GPT-4o, targeting Flesch Reading Ease ≥ 90. Most summaries meet readability targets within four attempts.

entry.title: A Holistic Framework for Robust Bangla ASR and Speaker Diarization with Optimized VAD and CTC Alignment

author.name: Zarif Ishmam, Zarif Mahir, Shafnan Wasif, Md. Ishtiak Moin

entry.summary: Presents a framework for Bangla ASR and speaker diarization optimized for long-form audio, leveraging VAD optimization and CTC forced alignment. Built for the DL Sprint 4.0 contest.

entry.title: A Data-Driven Approach to Support Clinical Renal Replacement Therapy

author.name: Alice Balboni, Luis Escobar, Andrea Manno, Fabrizio Rossi, Maria Cristina Ruffa, Gianluca Villa, Giordano D'Aloisio, Antonio Consolo

entry.summary: Applies ML models (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM) with ADASYN oversampling to predict membrane fouling in continuous renal replacement therapy using 16 clinical features.

entry.title: An automatic counting algorithm for the quantification and uncertainty analysis of the number of microglial cells trainable in small and heterogeneous datasets

author.name: L. Martino, M. M. Garcia, P. S. Paradas, E. Curbelo

entry.summary: Develops an automatic counting algorithm for microglial cells in spinal cord tissue that focuses on counting rather than detection. Designed for small, heterogeneous datasets with uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Performance and Experimental Analysis of Strain-based Models for Continuum Robots

author.name: Annika Delucchi, Vincenzo Di Paola, Andreas M\"uller, and Matteo Zoppi

entry.summary: Investigates shape reconstruction capabilities of strain-based models for continuum robots, comparing a third-order strain interpolation method against the Geometric-Variable Strain approach.

entry.title: Optimized Disaster Recovery for Distributed Storage Systems: Lightweight Metadata Architectures to Overcome Cryptographic Hashing Bottleneck

author.name: Prasanna Kumar, Nishank Soni, Gaurang Munje

entry.summary: Analyzes the cryptographic hashing bottleneck in disaster recovery for distributed storage systems and proposes lightweight metadata architectures to reduce recovery time objectives during failover events.

entry.title: Integrating Machine Learning Ensembles and Large Language Models for Heart Disease Prediction Using Voting Fusion

author.name: Md. Tahsin Amin, Tanim Ahmmod, Zannatul Ferdus, Talukder Naemul Hasan Naem, Ehsanul Ferdous, Arpita Bhattacharjee, Ishmam Ahmed Solaiman, Nahiyan Bin Noor

entry.summary: Combines ensemble ML models (Random Forest, XGBoost, etc.) with open-source LLMs via voting fusion for heart disease prediction on 1,190 patient records. Traditional ML achieves 95.78% accuracy.

entry.title: Scattering Transform for Auditory Attention Decoding

author.name: Ren\'e Pallenberg, Fabrice Katzberg, Alfred Mertins, Marco Maass

entry.summary: Proposes using scattering transforms as an alternative preprocessing method for EEG-based auditory attention decoding in hearing aids.

entry.title: An Adaptive Multichain Blockchain: A Multiobjective Optimization Approach

author.name: Nimrod Talmon, Haim Zysberg

entry.summary: Proposes casting blockchain configuration as a multi-agent resource allocation problem, using multiobjective optimization to dynamically group applications into ephemeral chains each epoch. The model is modular and can be solved off-chain with on-chain verification.

entry.title: Dynamic Level Sets

author.name: Michael Stephen Fiske

entry.summary: Discusses 'dynamic level sets,' a mathematical concept from a 2012 paper on Turing incomputable computation, arguing it is distinct from standard concepts in dynamical systems, topology, and computability theory.

entry.title: Does the testing environment matter? Carsickness across on-road, test-track, and driving simulator conditions

author.name: Georgios Papaioannou, Barys Shyrokau

entry.summary: Compares carsickness across on-road, test-track, and driving simulator conditions with 28 participants. Finds significant differences between environments, complicating cross-study comparisons.

entry.title: A minor point about instrumental convergence that I would like feedback on

author.name: agrippa

entry.summary: Argues that the strong instrumental convergence thesis (ASI will inevitably extinguish humanity regardless of architecture) is trivially false by considering hypothetical bio-simulated AI. Suggests architecture matters.

entry.title: Map the Future Before You Build It

author.name: Molly

entry.summary: Announces Radiant, a new forecasting tool by Metaculus that allows users to map causal relationships between multiple forecasts to aid complex strategic decision-making. The tool visualizes how individual predictions connect and cascade, helping decision-makers reason about interconnected future scenarios.

entry.title: Predicting Tennis Serve directions with Machine Learning

author.name: Ying Zhu, Ruthuparna Naikar

entry.summary: Develops ML methods for predicting tennis serve directions, achieving ~49% accuracy for male and ~44% for female players through feature engineering. Provides evidence about predictability patterns in professional tennis.

entry.title: Whack-a-Mole is Not a Winnable Game

author.name: Sable

entry.summary: Uses an engineering class anecdote about reactive safety rules (grates on fans, battery restrictions) to argue that 'whack-a-mole' approaches to AI safety—patching individual failure modes as they arise—cannot succeed as a comprehensive safety strategy. Advocates for more principled, proactive safety approaches.

entry.title: Quantity Convergence, Quality Divergence: Disentangling Fluency and Accuracy in L2 Mandarin Prosody

author.name: Yuqi Shi, Hao Yang, Xiyao Lu, Jinsong Zhang

entry.summary: Studies L2 Mandarin prosody acquisition, finding that high-proficiency Vietnamese learners converge to native-like prosodic boundary quantity but diverge in their syntactic-prosodic mapping structure.

entry.title: Investing in light of AI risk

author.name: AshL

entry.summary: Discusses the ethical dilemma of investing in AI companies (like NVIDIA) when one believes AI development should slow down, explaining how stock purchases marginally accelerate development through stock price effects on capital raising and employee compensation. Explores alternative investment strategies for people concerned about AI risk.

entry.title: Getting Back To It

author.name: sarahconstantin

entry.summary: Personal blog post about returning to writing after having a baby, discussing job hunting in AI-related fields. Not substantive technical content.

entry.title: The Voices That Are Missing From Sex-Themed Online Communities

author.name: Bowl of Cereal

entry.summary: Essay about the lack of online discussion forums for sexual topics that don't require sex-positive viewpoints. Not AI-related.

entry.title: UFO Aliens Are Your Gods

author.name: Lord Dreadwar

entry.summary: Claims UFO aliens are gods with >99% probability. Not relevant to AI research.
